desc.zh: 2008 年《钢铁侠》开启的电影主线宇宙，电影、流媒体剧集、特别篇与动画共享 Earth-199999 正史。
desc.en: The film-led flagship universe since Iron Man (2008): films, streaming series and specials share the Earth-199999 canon.

medium.zh: 电影 + 流媒体 + 特别篇

zh: MCU频道是漫威电影宇宙的统摄频带：所有共享同一正史的影视作品归于此。
电影、剧集、特别篇与动画皆在此频道内联动。
它是漫威现代影视叙事的绝对主干。
en: MCU channel: the shared-canon film/TV band, everything in one continuity.
Films, series, specials and animation interlock under it.
The absolute trunk of modern Marvel screen narrative.

desc.zh: 电视与流媒体上的漫威改编剧集合：ABC、Netflix 捍卫者系、Freeform 等，各自成宇宙或正史归属存争议。
desc.en: Live-action Marvel TV adaptations (ABC, Netflix Defenders saga, Freeform...), each its own continuum or canon-disputed.

canon.zh: 多宇宙并存 / 正史争议

zh: 电视频道是漫威的老牌剧集宇宙：ABC、Netflix与Freeform的街头与神盾线。
神盾局特工、捍卫者四部曲与离家童盟构成其主要阵容。
它是MCU影视谱系的前电视时代。
en: TV channel: legacy Marvel television, ABC/Netflix street and SHIELD lines.
AoS, Defenders saga and Runaways make its core.
The pre-Disney+ TV era of the MCU lineage.

desc.zh: 漫威动画剧集与动画电影：从 90 年代 X 战警动画到蜘蛛侠平行宇宙系列。
desc.en: Marvel animation: from 90s X-Men TAS to the Spider-Verse films.

medium.zh: 动画剧集 / 动画电影

zh: 动画频道是漫威的二维宇宙：X战警97、蜘蛛侠动画与平行宇宙电影。
动画让多元宇宙与变种人神话自由驰骋。
它是漫威最具实验精神的频道。
en: Animation channel: Marvel 2D cosmos, X-Men 97, Spider cartoons, Spider-Verse films.
Animation lets multiverse and mutant myth roam free.
Marvel most experimental channel.

desc.zh: 漫威漫画正史宇宙 Earth-616 及其家族，一切改编的源头。
desc.en: The comics continuity of Earth-616 and its family — the source of all adaptations.

zh: 漫画频道是漫威的纸面本源：从1941美队到当代连载的所有期刊。
616主宇宙、终极宇宙与平行世界刊皆在此频道。
它是一切影视改编的源头活水。
en: Comics channel: paper root since 1941 Cap to current runs.
616 prime, Ultimate and parallel titles live here.
The source spring of every adaptation.

desc.zh: 非 MCU 的真人电影宇宙：旧福克斯 X 战警系与索尼 SSU 毒液系等。
desc.en: Non-MCU live-action film continuities: legacy Fox X-Men and Sony's SSU.

zh: 其他影视宇宙是漫威的授权分支：福克斯X战警与索尼SSU。
它们各自成系，又与MCU在多元宇宙中暧昧相接。
授权线拓宽了漫威影视的版图。
en: Other-film universe: Marvel licensed branches, Fox X-Men and Sony SSU.
Separate systems, ambiguously touching the MCU multiverse.
Licensed lines widen the Marvel screen map.

desc.zh: 漫威电子游戏：Insomniac 蜘蛛侠系、银河护卫队、漫威争锋等。
desc.en: Marvel video games: Insomniac's Spider-Man saga, GotG, Marvel Rivals and more.

zh: 游戏频道是漫威的交互宇宙：从主机大作到卡牌手游。
Insomniac蜘蛛侠、暗夜之子与终极逆转构成其旗舰。
游戏让英雄可以亲手操控。
en: Game channel: Marvel interactive cosmos, console titles to card mobile.
Insomniac Spider, Midnight Suns and Snap are flagships.
Games put heroes in player hands.

desc.zh: 漫威漫画正史主宇宙，绝大多数经典故事的发生地。
desc.en: The mainstream comics continuity where most classic stories take place.

zh: 地球-616是漫威的主宇宙：所有经典英雄的主场，漫画宇宙的坐标原点。
神奇四侠、X战警、蜘蛛侠、复仇者都在此宇宙并肩。
它是漫威多元宇宙的中心参照系。
en: Earth-616 is Marvel prime universe: classic heroes home, the comic cosmos origin.
FF, X-Men, Spider-Man and Avengers all stand together here.
The central frame of the Marvel multiverse.

desc.zh: MCU 正史宇宙编号，涵盖全部电影、剧集与特别篇。
desc.en: The MCU canon designation covering all films, series and specials.

zh: 地球-199999是漫威电影宇宙：2008年钢铁侠开启的电影主线。
复仇者、守护者与灭霸之战都在此展开，是影视宇宙的绝对核心。
它以电影改写了现代超级英雄叙事。
en: Earth-199999 is the MCU: film canon since Iron Man 2008.
Avengers, Guardians and the Thanos war unfold here, the film-canon heart.
It rewrites modern superhero storytelling on screen.

desc.zh: 漫画"终极"系列 reboot 宇宙，终极蜘蛛侠迈尔斯的故乡，后于秘密战争 2015 中被摧毁合并。
desc.en: The Ultimate comics reboot line; home of Miles Morales, destroyed and merged in Secret Wars (2015).

zh: 地球-1610是终极宇宙：2000年重启的现代版漫威主线，迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯的故乡。
终极蜘蛛侠、终极X战警与终极战队构成其阵容。
1610的消亡在《秘密战争2015》中汇入主宇宙。
en: Earth-1610 is the Ultimate Universe: 2000 modern Marvel reboot, home of Miles Morales.
Ultimate Spider-Man, Ultimate X-Men and Ultimates form its roster.
Its demise merges into 616 at Secret Wars 2015.

desc.zh: 《疯狂多元宇宙》中光照会所在的平行宇宙，被疯狂化的旺达血洗。
desc.en: The Illuminati universe in Multiverse of Madness, ravaged by corrupted Wanda.

zh: 地球-838是《奇异博士2》中的平行宇宙：光照会统治的秩序世界。
838的奇异博士、黑蝠王、神奇先生与卡特队长守护现实。
绯红女巫的入侵让838遭受重创。
en: Earth-838: MoM parallel universe, ruled by the Illuminati order.
838 Strange, Black Bolt, Reed and Captain Carter guard reality.
Scarlet Witch invasion devastates 838.

desc.zh: 《神奇四侠：初露锋芒》的复古未来主义宇宙，神奇四侠对抗行星吞噬者的家园。
desc.en: The retro-futuristic world of The Fantastic Four: First Steps.

zh: 地球-828是神奇四侠的新家：60年代风格宇宙射线起源的平行地球。
巴克斯特大厦与哈德逊湾空间站是这里的坐标。
它是MCU神奇四侠重启的舞台。
en: Earth-828: Fantastic Four universe, retro cosmic-ray origin.
Baxter Building and Hudson space station anchor it.
The MCU FF reboot stage.

name.zh: Earth-10005 (旧福克斯 X 战警)

desc.zh: 旧福克斯 X 战警系列电影宇宙， Deadpool & Wolverine 中被 TVA 标记为"锚点宇宙"。
desc.en: The legacy Fox X-Men film continuity, pruned-by-TVA in Deadpool & Wolverine.

zh: 地球-10005是福克斯X战警宇宙：2000-2019的变种人电影线。
X战警三部曲、金刚狼系列与逆转未来的时间线重启都在此。
死侍与金刚狼(2024)为其画下致敬句点。
en: Earth-10005: Fox X-Men universe, 2000-2019 mutant films.
X trilogy, Wolverine films and DoFP reboot all live here.
Deadpool and Wolverine (2024) gives it a loving farewell.

desc.zh: 托比·马奎尔版蜘蛛侠三部曲宇宙。
desc.en: The Tobey Maguire Spider-Man trilogy universe.

zh: 地球-96283是马奎尔蜘蛛侠宇宙：2002-2007山姆·雷米三部曲。
托比·马奎尔的蜘蛛侠与威廉·达福的绿魔在此对撞。
无路可归中它重聚三代蜘蛛侠。
en: Earth-96283: Raimi Spider-Man trilogy 2002-2007.
Tobey Maguire Spider and Dafoe Goblin clash here.
No Way Home reunites three Spider-Men from it.

desc.zh: 安德鲁·加菲尔德版超凡蜘蛛侠两部曲宇宙。
desc.en: The Andrew Garfield Amazing Spider-Man universe.

zh: 地球-120703是加菲蜘蛛侠宇宙：2012-2014超凡蜘蛛侠两部。
安德鲁·加菲尔德版蜘蛛侠以更忧伤的基调著称。
无路可归中他的蜘蛛侠获得救赎第二幕。
en: Earth-120703: Webb Amazing Spider-Man films 2012-2014.
Andrew Garfield Spider known for melancholy tone.
No Way Home gives his Spider a redemption second act.

desc.zh: 索尼的毒液/莫比亚斯等电影共享宇宙，与 MCU 存在交集暗示。
desc.en: Sony's Venom/Morbius shared film universe, teased to intersect the MCU.

zh: SSU是索尼蜘蛛侠宇宙：2018年起以毒液为中心的共享影视宇宙。
毒液三部曲、莫比亚斯、蜘蛛夫人与克莱文构成其线。
它尝试连接蜘蛛侠正传却始终暧昧。
en: SSU: Sony Spider-Man Universe, Venom-centered shared film cosmos since 2018.
Venom trilogy, Morbius, Madame Web, Kraven form its line.
It courts Spider-Man canon yet stays ambiguous.

desc.zh: 1992 年 X 战警动画及其续作 X 战警 97 的宇宙。
desc.en: The 1992 X-Men animated series continuity continued by X-Men '97.

zh: 地球-92131是X战警动画宇宙：1992-1997经典动画。
X战警97(2024)正是此宇宙的正统续作。
它是90年代一代人的变种人记忆。
en: Earth-92131: X-Men TAS universe 1992-1997.
X-Men 97 (2024) is its canon sequel.
The 90s generation mutant memory.

desc.zh: 所有蜘蛛侠所在的多元宇宙总称，由"织网者"与蜘蛛图腾维系。
desc.en: The web of all Spider-People's realities, bound by the Web of Life and Destiny.

zh: 蜘蛛宇宙群是所有蜘蛛英雄的多元集合：继承者之战与蜘蛛社会。
蜘蛛格温、迈尔斯、2099与无数变体蜘蛛在此交汇。
它是漫威最生动的多元宇宙舞台。
en: The Spider-Verse: all spider-heroes multiverse, Inheritors war and Spider-Society.
Gwen, Miles, 2099 and countless spider variants converge.
Marvel most vivid multiverse stage.

desc.zh: 格温·史黛西被蜘蛛咬伤成为英雄的倒转宇宙。
desc.en: The universe where Gwen Stacy was bitten by the radioactive spider instead.

zh: 地球-65是蜘蛛格温的宇宙：格温·史黛西而非彼得被蜘蛛咬中。
鼓手格温白天乐队、夜晚织网。
它在平行宇宙电影中成为最受欢迎变体之一。
en: Earth-65: Spider-Gwen universe, Gwen Stacy bitten instead of Peter.
Drummer Gwen by day, web-slinger by night.
One of the most beloved variants on screen.

desc.zh: 2099 年的未来宇宙，蜘蛛侠 2099 米格尔·奥哈拉的时代。
desc.en: The far-future year 2099, era of Spider-Man 2099 Miguel O'Hara.

zh: 地球-928是2099宇宙：近未来赛博朋克纽约，米格尔·奥哈拉是蜘蛛侠2099。
穿越宇宙电影让2099成为蜘蛛社会的领袖。
它代表漫威对未来的想象。
en: Earth-928: 2099 cyberpunk future New York, Miguel OHara as Spider-Man 2099.
Across the Spider-Verse makes 2099 the Spider-Society leader.
Marvel future imagination.

desc.zh: 《漫威蜘蛛侠》系列游戏的专属宇宙（Earth-1048）。
desc.en: The dedicated universe of Insomniac's Marvel's Spider-Man games (Earth-1048).

zh: Insomniac游戏宇宙是2018年漫威蜘蛛侠游戏的世界：开放世界纽约与迈尔斯续作。
它与主宇宙并行，让游戏版彼得成为独立叙事主角。
漫威金刚狼游戏也属此线。
en: Insomniac game universe: 2018 Spider-Man open-world New York and Miles sequel.
It parallels 616, giving game Peter an independent arc.
The Wolverine game belongs here too.

desc.zh: TVA 维护的"正确"时间线集合，任何分叉都将被裁剪。
desc.en: The TVA-approved proper flow of time; branches get pruned.

zh: 神圣时间线是TVA维护的唯一主时间线：洛基中的时间秩序核心。
其真相是遗留之人/康变体的人工编排。
洛基最终接掌其守护之责。
en: Sacred Timeline: TVA one true timeline, the Loki time-order core.
Its truth: He Who Remains engineered it.
Loki ends up guarding it.

desc.zh: 《终局之战》结尾揭示的、能俯瞰诸宇宙的神秘观测维度。
desc.en: The mysterious vantage realm glimpsed at the end of Endgame.

zh: 海姆达尔之境是彩虹桥观测者的维度：海姆达尔目光所及的时空。
它以海姆达尔的全视之眼命名，连接九界观测。
在雷神线中它是一个功能性的边缘维度。
en: Heimdall dimension: the Bifrost watcher sight realm.
Named for Heimdall all-seeing eye, linking Nine Realms sight.
A functional edge dimension in Thor line.

desc.zh: 多玛姆统治的混沌维度，古一与奇异博士的力量来源之一。
desc.en: Dormammu's chaotic realm, tapped by the Ancient One and Doctor Strange.

zh: 黑暗维度是多玛姆的领域：没有时间、只有永恒的黑暗。
奇异博士以时间循环在此击败多玛姆。
它是魔法侧最著名的维度威胁。
en: Dark Dimension: Dormammu realm, no time, only eternal darkness.
Strange beat Dormammu here with a time loop.
The mystic side most famous dimensional threat.

desc.zh: 可折叠现实的复制空间，法师用它训练与战斗而不伤现实。
desc.en: A folded copy of reality where sorcerers train and battle safely.

zh: 镜像维度是法师的练武场：现实的重影世界，可倒转与折叠。
奇异博士与卡西利厄斯在其中的追逐是视觉名场面。
它让魔法战斗拥有空间想象力。
en: Mirror Dimension: sorcerer training ground, reality afterimage, reversible and foldable.
Strange and Kaecilius chase is a visual landmark.
It gives magic battles spatial imagination.

desc.zh: 亚原子尺度的奇异空间，时间与空间规则失效，蚁人与征服者康的角力场。
desc.en: The subatomic realm where spacetime breaks down; Ant-Man vs. Kang.

zh: 量子领域是亚原子世界：蚁人系列的时间微尘之海。
无限城与时间漩涡在其中，是终局时间劫持的钥匙。
它在微观尺度连接着多元宇宙。
en: Quantum Realm: subatomic world, Ant-Man series time-dust sea.
Infinity City and time vortices; the Endgame heist key.
It links the multiverse at micro scale.

desc.zh: 宇宙垃圾场行星，外星竞技场的所在地，浩克曾在此称王。
desc.en: The junkyard planet with its gladiator arena; Hulk once ruled here.

zh: 萨卡星是宇宙垃圾场与角斗场：宗师统治的混乱星球。
浩克与托尔在此角斗，构成诸神黄昏的转折。
它代表强者生存的狂野宇宙。
en: Sakaar: cosmic junkyard arena, Grandmaster chaos planet.
Hulk and Thor arena fight pivots Ragnarok.
It embodies survival-of-strong wild cosmos.

desc.zh: 埃及神话的冥界，月亮骑士故事中阿米特与孔苏权柄所及之地。
desc.en: The Egyptian underworld tied to Ammit and Khonshu in Moon Knight.

zh: 杜阿特是埃及神系的冥界：月光骑士中的死后之境。
孔苏的化身在杜阿特之门与审判之间穿行。
它为月光骑士提供神话纵深。
en: Duat: Egyptian underworld, Moon Knight afterlife realm.
Khonshu avatar walks between Duat gate and judgment.
It mythologizes Moon Knight.

desc.zh: 十环背后的东方神话秘境，与地球通过竹林结界相连。
desc.en: The mythic Chinese realm behind the Ten Rings bamboo gate.

zh: 塔罗秘境是尚气的神话之乡：隐藏维度的古代村落。
麒麟、凤凰与守护神龙构成其神兽谱系。
它把东方神话织入漫威宇宙。
en: Ta Lo: Shang-Chi mythic home, hidden-dimension ancient village.
Qilin, fenghuang and the Great Protector dragon line.
It weaves Eastern myth into Marvel.

desc.zh: 北欧神话中的死之雾国，海拉被流放之地。
desc.en: The Norse realm of mist and death where Hela was banished.

zh: 尼福尔海姆是北欧九界的雾之国：死者的寒冷领域。
它与海拉的死神权柄关联。
在雷神神话线中它是边缘领域。
en: Niflheim: Norse Nine Realm of mist and dead.
It ties to Hela death-goddess dominion.
An edge realm in Thor myth line.

desc.zh: 《终局之战》后揭示的、位于时间之外的"万物终点"彼岸。
desc.en: The beyond-time afterlife revealed at the end of Endgame.

zh: 终局虚境是灭霸响指后幸存者的灰色世界？或时间外的残余？
它与TVA虚空之地常被混称，实为不同坐标。
它代表失去与等待的空间。
en: Endgame Void: grey aftermath dimension of the Snap era.
Often conflated with TVA Void, distinct coordinates.
A space of loss and waiting.

desc.zh: TVA 裁剪时间线的终点垃圾场，堆积着被删除的宇宙残骸与"最烂"变体。
desc.en: The TVA's pruning dump piled with deleted timelines and "worst" variants.

zh: 虚空之地是TVA修剪时间线的垃圾场：时间尽头，艾里奥斯徘徊。
被流放的洛基变体在此对抗风暴巨兽。
死侍与金刚狼也在虚空上演重逢。
en: TVA Void: pruned-timeline junkyard at time end, Alioth prowls.
Exiled Loki variants fight Alioth here.
Deadpool and Wolverine reunite in the Void.

desc.zh: 共生体种族的母星，后成为宇宙强大的势力据点。
desc.en: Homeworld of the symbiote race.

zh: 克林塔是共生体母星：黑暗神克努尔的造物之地。
毒液与屠杀的血脉皆源于此。
它与漫威宇宙的黑暗起源相连。
en: Klyntar: symbiote homeworld, Knull creation ground.
Venom and Carnage bloodlines spring from it.
It links to Marvel dark origin.

desc.zh: 遗留之人于时间尽头建立的堡垒所在，一切时间线的交汇之外。
desc.en: The citadel at the end of time where He Who Remains ruled.

zh: 时间线之外是洛基中时间尽头的所在：万物终结后残余的时间王座。
洛基在此成为守护多元宇宙的时间之神。
它象征秩序与自由的终极命题。
en: Outside Time: Loki time-end beyond, the timeline throne after all ends.
Loki becomes the time-god guarding the multiverse here.
The ultimate order-vs-freedom question.

desc.zh: 银河中最常见的智慧生命之一，脆弱却适应力惊人，是绝大多数英雄的起点。
desc.en: The galaxy's most widespread sapient species; fragile but remarkably adaptable.

zh: 人类是漫威最坚韧的种族：没有超能力的凡人英雄的集体。
从美队到鹰眼，凡人身躯屡屡对抗神明。
它是漫威叙事的默认参照系。
en: Humans: Marvel most resilient race, the collective of powerless heroes.
Cap to Hawkeye, mortal frames challenge gods.
The default reference of Marvel narrative.

desc.zh: X 基因觉醒的人类亚种，天生拥有超能力，长期遭受恐惧与迫害。
desc.en: Humans born with an active X-gene granting powers, long feared and persecuted.

zh: 变种人是漫威的基因先驱：X基因赋予千变万化的超能力。
从X战警到兄弟会，变种人是少数群体的隐喻。
它是漫威最成功的种族设定。
en: Mutants: Marvel genetic vanguard, X-gene granting myriad powers.
X-Men to Brotherhood, mutants as minority metaphor.
Marvel most successful race concept.

desc.zh: 克里实验改造的人类后裔，经泰瑞根迷雾蜕变出能力。
desc.en: Kree-engineered human offshoots transformed by Terrigen Mist.

zh: 异人族是泰瑞根迷雾觉醒的种族：黑蝠王统治的隐藏文明。
阿提兰与水晶、锁链犬构成其王国。
他们与变种人争锋同源。
en: Inhumans: Terrigen-awakened race, Black Bolt hidden civilization.
Attilan, Crystal and Lockjaw form its kingdom.
Mutant rivals from another origin.

desc.zh: 天神组造出的不朽人形种族，数百年来隐匿人间引导文明。
desc.en: Immortal humanoids engineered by the Celestials, guiding humanity in secret.

zh: 永恒族是天神组创造的完美种族：不朽、强大、世代守护。
永恒族十人与天神组的造物秘密相连。
他们是人类基因实验的守护面。
en: Eternals: Celestial-made perfect race, immortal, strong, generational guardians.
The ten Eternals tie to Celestial creation secret.
The guardian face of human genetic experiment.

desc.zh: 天神组另一造物，永恒族的宿敌，形态多变被诬为怪物。
desc.en: The Celestials' other creation and Eternal nemeses, maligned as monsters.

zh: 变异族是天神组的失衡创造：基因变异、形态可怖的对手。
它们世代与永恒族为敌。
它是漫威进化实验的阴影面。
en: Deviants: Celestial imbalance creation, mutated, monstrous foils.
Eternal-deviant generational war.
The shadow face of Marvel evolution experiment.

desc.zh: 自称神明的长寿外星种族，驻守九界之树顶端的金城。
desc.en: Long-lived beings worshipped as gods, ruling from golden Asgard atop Yggdrasil.

zh: 阿斯加德人是北欧神系的漫威版：长寿、强壮、可死的神明后裔。
托尔、奥丁与海拉皆属此族。
他们以凡人之眼便是神明。
en: Asgardians: Norse gods Marvel version, long-lived, strong, mortal-death deities.
Thor, Odin, Hela all belong.
Gods to mortal eyes.

desc.zh: 好战的蓝皮肤帝国种族，克里-斯克鲁战争的元凶之一。
desc.en: Militaristic blue-skinned imperials, instigators of the Kree-Skrull War.

zh: 克里人是蓝皮肤的星际帝国种族：宇宙三大势力之一。
卡罗尔·丹弗斯有克里血统，至高智慧统治其文明。
征服与科学是他们的双刃。
en: Kree: blue-skinned interstellar empire race, one of three cosmic powers.
Carol has Kree blood; Supreme Intelligence rules.
Conquest and science their double edge.

desc.zh: 天生变形者，因克里入侵而流亡，后部分与地球结盟。
desc.en: Natural shapeshifters exiled by Kree conquest; some allied with Earth.

zh: 斯克鲁人是绿色变形者种族：可模仿任何形态的星际渗透者。
秘密入侵让斯克鲁恐惧席卷全球。
他们是信任的试金石。
en: Skrulls: green shapeshifters, cosmic infiltrators of any form.
Secret Invasion brings Skrull paranoia worldwide.
The trust touchstone.

desc.zh: 播种生命的宇宙级巨神，其"涌现"会终结所在行星的既有文明。
desc.en: Cosmic titans who seed life; their Emergence ends a planet's existing age.

zh: 天神组是宇宙的创世种族：基因实验者与文明的审判者。
永恒族、变异族与人类皆其造物。
他们是漫威宇宙最古老的裁判。
en: Celestials: cosmic creator race, gene-experimenters and civilizer judges.
Eternals, Deviants and humans their creation.
Marvel oldest judges.

desc.zh: 立誓只观不涉的宇宙古老种族，乌阿图是其中最著名的地球观察者。
desc.en: An ancient race sworn to non-interference; Uatu watches Earth.

zh: 观察者是天神组的观测种族：只记录、不干预的宇宙见证者。
观察者乌阿图是多元宇宙的叙事者。
他们是漫威宇宙的史官。
en: Watchers: Celestial-tier observing race, record-not-intervene witnesses.
Watcher Uatu narrates the multiverse.
The Marvel cosmos chroniclers.

desc.zh: 克伦塔星的液态寄生生命，与宿主结合赋予力量也放大暴虐。
desc.en: Amorphous parasites from Klyntar that empower and corrupt their hosts.

zh: 共生体种族是克林塔的液态族：与宿主融合的外星生命。
毒液、屠杀与共生体之树繁衍不息。
他们既是武器也是诅咒。
en: Symbiote race: Klyntar liquid kind, host-fusing alien life.
Venom, Carnage and the symbiote tree thrive.
Weapon and curse alike.

desc.zh: 格鲁特所属的植物智慧种族，语言只余"我是格鲁特"。
desc.en: Groot's sapient plant species; their speech reduces to "I am Groot".

zh: 植物巨体族是格鲁特的树人族：行星级的再生生命。
格鲁特族语只有一句：我是格鲁特。
他们是宇宙的移动森林。
en: Flora Colossus: Groot tree race, planet-scale regenerative life.
Groot tongue: I am Groot only.
The cosmos walking forest.

desc.zh: 约顿海姆的巨兽，约顿海姆之战中涌现的古老力量。
desc.en: Primeval beasts of Jotunheim unleashed in its war.

zh: 冰霜巨兽是约顿海姆的野兽：霜巨人驯养的猛兽。
它们在雷神1约顿海姆之战中登场。
它们是寒冰领域的爪牙。
en: Frost Beasts: Jotunheim beasts, Frost Giant war animals.
They appear in Thor 1 Jotunheim battle.
Frozen realm fangs.

desc.zh: 玛勒基斯领导的太初种族，欲以以太重归宇宙黑暗。
desc.en: Malekith's primordial race seeking to return all to darkness via the Aether.

zh: 黑暗精灵是瓦特阿尔海姆的古老种族：以以太为核心的暗影一族。
马勒基斯试图以以太重归永恒黑暗。
他们是九界最古老的敌人之一。
en: Dark Elves: Svartalfheim ancient race, Aether-bound shadow kind.
Malekith seeks eternal darkness via Aether.
Among Nine Realm oldest foes.

desc.zh: 宙斯所在的希腊神族，与阿斯加德并存的地球信仰体系。
desc.en: Zeus's Greek pantheon, a parallel divine house to Asgard.

zh: 奥林匹斯神族是希腊神话的漫威版：宙斯统领的天庭。
雷神4中奥林匹斯与众神议会登场。
他们是神话侧的高位神明。
en: European myth gods: Marvel Greek pantheon under Zeus.
Olympus and god-summit appear in Thor 4.
Myth-side high deities.

desc.zh: 埃及九柱神，孔苏与阿米特所属的神话权柄体系。
desc.en: The Egyptian Ennead — Khonshu and Ammit's divine order.

zh: 九柱神是埃及神话的漫威版：孔苏所属的埃及神庭。
月光骑士中的月神契约源于此族。
他们是杜阿特冥界的守卫。
en: Ennead: Marvel Egyptian pantheon, Khonshu home court.
Moon Knight Khonshu pact springs here.
Duat underworld keepers.

desc.zh: 科恩格所属的岩石巨种族，意志坚定力大无穷。
desc.en: Korg's rock-skinned humanoid species.

zh: 石头人族是异星工程种族：奎尔母系相关的建筑生命。
银护线中他们是宇宙工匠。
体表由致密岩石与熔铸金属构成，寿命近乎不朽，是宇宙中最古老的建筑工匠之一。
en: Kakarantharaians: alien builder race.
Guardians-line cosmic craftsmen.
Dense rock and forged metal forms make them near-immortal — among the universe's oldest builders.

desc.zh: 卡魔拉与星云的种族，被灭霸屠戮殆尽。
desc.en: Gamora and Nebula's species, butchered by Thanos.

zh: 泽霍贝雷族是和平的外星种族：卡魔拉的故乡。
灭霸屠星后卡魔拉成为最后幸存者之一。
他们的毁灭是卡魔拉的起源之痛。
en: Zen-Whoberi: peaceful alien race, Gamora homeworld.
After Thanos cull, Gamora among last.
Their fall is Gamora origin wound.

desc.zh: 回收者塔纳斯·莱恩所属的殖民种族。
desc.en: The colonizing race of the Recycler Taneleer Tivan's era.

zh: 瑞杰尔人是银河护卫队相关的宇宙商人种族。
火箭浣熊的宇宙漫游常与瑞杰尔星域交界。
它是宇宙线常见背景种族。
en: Rigellians: cosmic trader race tied to Guardians.
Rocket roamings touch Rigel sectors.
A cosmic-line background race.

desc.zh: 灭霸的种族，母星泰坦星因资源枯竭而崩溃。
desc.en: Thanos's race; their homeworld Titan collapsed from ruin.

zh: 泰坦族是永恒族的分支：灭霸与星狐的种族。
泰坦星因资源枯竭而灭。
它塑成了灭霸的宇宙哲学。
en: Titan race: Eternal offshoot, Thanos and Starfox kin.
Titan fell to resource collapse.
It forged Thanos cosmic creed.

desc.zh: 超出常人极限的肌体力量，从美队到浩克构成完整强度光谱。
desc.en: Strength beyond human limits, from Cap to Hulk.

origin.zh: 血清 / 辐射 / 血统等

zh: 身体力量远超人类极限的通用能力。
浩克、灭霸与永恒族都以此为战力核心，但彼此的力量层级相差悬殊。
在漫威宇宙中，它常与坚不可摧的体魄相伴出现，是衡量战力的基准线。
en: Superhuman physical might — the most common superpower in the universe.
Hulk, Thanos and the Eternals all fight on this foundation — yet tiers of might differ wildly.
Usually paired with unbreakable durability — the yardstick of combat power.

desc.zh: 依靠科技、魔法或天生能力实现自由飞行。
desc.en: Free flight via tech, magic or birthright.

zh: 摆脱重力束缚、凌空高速飞行的能力。
雷神、惊奇队长乃至钢铁战衣都能飞行，速度差距可逾百倍。
有的只达亚音速，有的接近曲速，机动性往往改写空战结局。
en: The ability to defy gravity and fly through the air.
Thor, Captain Marvel and even Iron Man suits take to the sky; speed gaps can exceed a hundredfold.
From subsonic to near-warp speeds, mobility rewrites air battles.

desc.zh: 以光束、爆炸等形式释放能量攻击。
desc.en: Projecting energy as beams or blasts.

zh: 以光束或冲击波形式放出能量的攻击方式。
惊奇队长的光子炮与钢铁侠的掌心炮皆属此类，输出上限常定胜负。
从掌心炮到宇宙射线，能量释放是最直接也最常见的攻击语言。
en: Offensive projection of energy as beams or shockwaves.
Carol's photon blasts and Tony's repulsors belong here; output ceilings often decide battles.
Palm blasts to cosmic rays: the most direct combat language.

desc.zh: 读取与影响他人心智，X 教授与白皇后为代表。
desc.en: Reading and influencing minds — Xavier's domain.

zh: 读取、发送甚至改写他人思维的精神能力。
乌木喉与X教授都以此入侵他人意识，可绕过一切物理防御直达思维。
高段心灵感应还能植入记忆或精神控制，令对手防不胜防。
en: Reading and broadcasting minds — mental power beyond words.
Ebony Maw and Professor X breach minds directly, bypassing any physical defense.
Masters can implant memories or control minds outright.

desc.zh: 以意念操控物质运动。
desc.en: Moving matter with the mind.

zh: 以意念驱动物体移动或变形的心灵能力。
旺达与琴·葛蕾都兼擅念力，强者甚至能举起整栋楼宇。
念动力的精细程度随修行而变，可细至发丝也可撼动山岳。
en: Moving and reshaping objects with the mind alone.
Wanda and Jean Grey wield it too; the strongest can lift whole buildings.
Fine enough for a strand of hair, strong enough to move mountains.

desc.zh: 改变外貌形体，斯克鲁人天生的生存技能。
desc.en: Altering one's form — the Skrull survival gift.

zh: 改变自身外形、质地甚至密度的能力。
斯库鲁人的拟态与幻视的密度变换皆属变形，常被用于渗透与谍战。
变形越彻底越难识破，多数英雄只能依靠行为习惯辨识伪装。
en: Altering one's own form, substance, or density at will.
Skrull mimicry and Vision's density shifting count; it fuels infiltration and espionage.
Perfect mimicry is nearly undetectable; habits give heroes away.

desc.zh: 冻结、回溯或剪裁时间流，时间宝石与 TVA 的权柄。
desc.en: Freezing, rewinding or pruning time — the Time Stone and TVA.

origin.zh: 时间宝石 / TVA 科技

zh: 加速、放慢、倒带乃至冻结时间流的能力。
奇异博士曾以阿戈摩托之眼演算时间线，时间宝石是它最著名的载体。
擅自改动时间线会撕裂现实，因此常被视作禁忌领域。
en: Controlling the flow of time — its speed, reversal, or freeze.
Strange once charted timelines with the Eye of Agamotto — the Time Stone is its famous vessel.
Tampering tears reality — hence treated as forbidden ground.

desc.zh: 改写现实规则的最高阶力量，属于天神与无限宝石级别。
desc.en: Rewriting reality itself — Celestial and Infinity-grade power.

zh: 将主观想象直接覆盖为客观现实的能力。
旺达的混沌魔法与梦境的现实重塑皆属此类，被公认为最危险的能力。
现实改写者一念之间即可创造或抹消万物，连宇宙法则也为其让路。
en: Overwriting objective reality with one's own imagination.
Wanda's chaos magic and dream rewrites qualify; it is widely called the most dangerous power.
One thought creates or erases; even cosmic law gives way.

desc.zh: 卡玛泰姬法师以悬戒开启的空间之门。
desc.en: Sling Ring gates taught at Kamar-Taj.

zh: 撕裂空间维度、瞬间连接两地的能力。
奇异博士的悬戒与洛基的魔方传送都依赖它，战术上可绕开一切防线。
传送门也用于撤退与增援，交战双方都会争夺这一战略制高点。
en: Tearing space to link two places in an instant.
Strange's sling rings and Loki's Tesseract gates rely on it, outflanking any defense.
Portals also serve retreat and reinforcement — strategic high ground.

desc.zh: 意识脱离肉体的古一标志性魔法。
desc.en: The Ancient One's signature out-of-body art.

zh: 灵魂脱离肉身、进入灵界维度漫游的能力。
古一与奇异博士以出窍完成星界侦查，肉身在出窍期间则脆弱无防。
灵体可穿墙越界、与人隔空交谈，是法师特有的侦查与沟通方式。
en: Sending one's soul beyond the body into astral planes.
The Ancient One and Strange scout the astral plane while their bodies lie vulnerable.
Ghosts through walls for scouting and far-distance communion.

desc.zh: 奇异博士的西托伦火焰鞭与武器构造。
desc.en: Doctor Strange's Crimson Bands and whip constructs.

zh: 卡玛泰姬秘术凝成的橙红能量鞭刃。
奇异博士、王与莫度皆以此近身作战，能拘束实体亦能切割空间。
鞭刃以橙红火花为标志，只有受过训练的法师才能驾驭自如。
en: The orange energy lashes forged by Kamar-Taj sorcery.
Strange, Wong and Mordo fight up close with them, binding bodies or cutting space itself.
Marked by orange sparks; only trained sorcerers wield them well.

desc.zh: 以自身灵魂为代价借用暗黑维度的禁术。
desc.en: Forbidden sorcery borrowed from the Dark Dimension at a soul's price.

zh: 源自黑暗维度冥神的禁忌腐化魔法。
旺达与阿加莎都曾研习此书，它诱人堕落并逐渐腐化使用者的心智。
《暗神之书》记载的咒术强大却危险，总在诱使研读者堕入黑暗。
en: Forbidden magic borrowed from the Dark Dimension's ruler.
Wanda and Agatha both studied the book; it seduces and slowly corrupts its readers.
Powerful yet corrupting, always tempting readers into darkness.

desc.zh: 洛基的幻术与奥丁的权能所代表的北欧神术。
desc.en: Norse godcraft — Loki's illusions, Odin's might.

zh: 九界阿斯加德血脉所传承的符文神术。
雷神、洛基与海拉各显其能，神术与九界的王座血脉紧密相连。
神术可附魔兵器、编织幻象，是阿斯加德战士战斗技艺的一部分。
en: The runic sorcery woven into Asgardian royal bloodlines.
Thor, Loki and Hela each channel it — the sorcery bound to the Nine Realms' thrones.
Enchants weapons and weaves illusions within warrior craft.

desc.zh: 造就浩克一族的能量源头，愤怒越强力量越强。
desc.en: The force behind the Hulk line; rage feeds power.

zh: 以伽马能量改造肉体并解锁愤怒之力的源头。
浩克以它为愤怒引擎，情绪失控时力量反噬同样惊人。
伽马能量还让浩克拥有近乎无限的恢复潜力，越战越强。
en: Gamma energy that rebuilds flesh and unlocks raw fury.
The Hulk runs on it as an engine of rage; lost control turns the backlash deadly.
Also grants the Hulk near-limitless recovery — angrier, stronger.

desc.zh: 改变原子间距实现缩小/放大的神奇粒子。
desc.en: Size-changing wonder particles shrinking atomic spacing.

zh: 汉克·皮姆发现的能改变物体尺度的亚原子粒子。
蚁人与黄蜂女靠它自由缩放，量子领域的探索也依赖这项技术。
粒子同样能够放大物体，巨人化一度成为皮姆科技最危险的秘密。
en: Subatomic particles discovered by Hank Pym that bend scale.
Ant-Man and the Wasp shrink and grow at will; Quantum Realm travel depends on the tech.
Enlargement once made Pym tech the most dangerous secret.

desc.zh: 瓦坎达以陨落振金构建的科技树，从黑豹战衣到舒芮实验室。
desc.en: Wakanda's tech tree grown from fallen vibranium.

zh: 以吸音金属振金为核心打造的瓦坎达科技。
黑豹的战衣可吸收动能并使来袭利刃钝化，堪称坚不可摧。
振金还可导能储能，瓦坎达的隐形与医疗科技都建立在它之上。
en: Wakandan technology built around the sound-absorbing metal.
Black Panther's suit absorbs kinetic force and blunts blades — all but impenetrable.
Conducts and stores energy; Wakandan cloaking and healing rely on it.

desc.zh: AIM 研发的再生强化剂，亦伴随爆炸风险。
desc.en: A.I.M.'s regenerative serum with explosive side effects.

zh: 改写人体基因、赋予高热与再生的纳米科技。
基里安赋予它人体高热与自愈，但失控时会引发人体自燃。
绝境病毒后期甚至能赋予人体高热释放，使徒手亦成致命武器。
en: A nanotech program that rewrites genes for heat and healing.
Kilian grafted heat and healing onto human tissue; failure ignites the body itself.
Later grants heat discharge, making bare hands lethal.

desc.zh: 将凡人推向体能巅峰的血清，美队与红骷髅同源异果。
desc.en: The serum perfecting human peaks — Cap and Red Skull's common root.

zh: 厄斯金博士研制的、放大人性本质的强化血清。
它把瘦弱的史蒂夫·罗杰斯锻造成美国队长，人的善恶皆被一同放大。
血清从未被完美复刻，后续所有仿制品都伴随难以预料的副作用。
en: Erskine's formula that turns the frail into peak humans.
It forged frail Steve Rogers into Captain America — and amplified his virtue just as much.
Never perfectly replicated; every copy carries side effects.

desc.zh: 托尼·斯塔克的微型清洁能源心脏，驱动一切钢铁战甲。
desc.en: Tony Stark's clean-energy heart powering every suit.

zh: 托尼·斯塔克设计的小型冷聚变洁净能源。
它曾为战衣供能，也延续过托尼的生命，如同钢铁侠的第二颗心脏。
方舟反应堆后来发展出纳米装甲技术，成为马克战甲迭代的能源基石。
en: Tony Stark's miniature cold-fusion reactor and clean power source.
It powered the suits and once kept Tony alive, a second heart of iron.
Evolved into nanotech armor — the energy bedrock of later suits.

desc.zh: 文武千年来吸取天界能量的神秘指环，其来源成谜。
desc.en: Wenwu's millennium-old rings siphoning unknown power.

zh: 十枚神秘铁环所赋予的能量、愈伤与延寿之力。
文武执掌十环千载，连环的来历与真正用途他本人也未曾参透。
十环发射的能量束可摧毁整支军团，也可精准得只伤一人。
en: The mystic rings' power of energy, healing, and long life.
Wenwu ruled with the rings for a millennium; even he never fathomed their origin.
Blasts can level armies, or land with surgical precision.

desc.zh: 宇宙创生之初的原始力量，宿主将成为毁灭与新生的化身。
desc.en: A primordial cosmic force turning hosts into destroyers and rebearers.

zh: 多元宇宙级毁灭与重生俱存的原始宇宙之力。
它择主而栖，既予毁灭也予新生，琴·葛蕾是它最著名的宿主。
凤凰之力一旦失控便会化身黑凤凰，焚尽途经的一切星系。
en: A primal cosmic force of both annihilation and rebirth.
It chooses hosts, granting ruin and rebirth alike; Jean Grey is its most famous vessel.
Uncontrolled, it becomes the Dark Phoenix and burns whole galaxies.

desc.zh: 六颗宝石齐聚可随意改写现实的宇宙终极力量。
desc.en: The six-stone zenith of power over reality itself.

zh: 六颗各掌宇宙法则的宝石聚合而成的支配之力。
六颗宝石分别对应宇宙的一种基本法则，集齐便可支配整个寰宇。
手套只是容器，真正承载法则的是持有者意志与宝石的共鸣。
en: Command over cosmic law gathered from six Infinity Stones.
Six stones govern six fundamentals of existence; assembled, they command the cosmos.
The gauntlet is a vessel; will and resonance wield the law.

desc.zh: 神明血统赋予的雷霆、神性与不朽。
desc.en: Thunder, divinity and immortality of godly blood.

zh: 超越常理、足以撼动世界根基的神级力量。
雷神、海拉与奥丁皆立足此列，凡人妄图染指只会被其压垮。
神明的力量往往伴随漫长寿命与广袤疆域，凡人视角难以衡量。
en: God-tier strength that can shake the foundations of worlds.
Thor, Hela and Odin stand on this rung; mortals who reach for it are crushed.
Gods trade in longevity and dominion beyond mortal measure.

desc.zh: 从量子领域获得或源自其中的超常能力。
desc.en: Powers drawn from or granted by the Quantum Realm.

zh: 源于量子领域的穿物、相位偏移等奇异能力。
幽灵因量子纠缠而能穿行实体，蚁人则借此窥见了时空的奥秘。
量子法则不受经典物理约束，是科技与魔法之外的第三极力量。
en: Strange abilities born of the Quantum Realm — phasing, flux, more.
Ghost phases through matter via quantum entanglement; Ant-Man glimpsed spacetime's secrets there.
A third pole beyond tech and magic, free of classical physics.

desc.zh: 以咒语、法器与维度借力实现超常效果的体系总称。
desc.en: The umbrella of spells, relics and dimensional borrowings.

zh: 以咒语与法器调动维度能量的神秘学体系。
卡玛泰姬与圣所体系是地球维度的防线，每种魔法都有源头与代价。
法师以手势与法器成咒，魔力越强者越需要心性与之匹配。
en: Mysticism that channels dimensional power through spells.
Kamar-Taj and the Sanctums guard Earth's dimension; every school has sources and prices.
Spells rise from gesture and focus; power demands matching will.

desc.zh: 以头脑为武器的天才：钢铁侠、毁灭博士、月亮骑士的双人格皆属此类。
desc.en: Genius as a weapon: Stark, Doom, and fractured minds alike.

zh: 超越人类极限的智力、工程与推演天赋。
托尼、班纳与苏睿皆属此类，智慧是驾驭其他一切能力的关键。
超级智慧者往往以十年时间完成别人一个世纪的发明。
en: Genius-level intellect for science, engineering, and strategy.
Tony, Banner and Shuri belong here; intellect is the lever for every other power.
Geniuses finish in years what others take a century to imagine.

desc.zh: 金刚狼与死侍的招牌：伤势飞速愈合乃至不死。
desc.en: Wolverine and Deadpool's trademark rapid healing.

zh: 快速修复肉体损伤、近乎不死的恢复能力。
死侍、金刚狼与格鲁特皆能快速复原，战斗于是常常沦为消耗战。
再生并非无敌，魔法与振金武器依旧能造成难以愈合的重创。
en: Rapid tissue repair that makes wounds close before they bleed out.
Deadpool, Wolverine and Groot heal in moments, turning fights into wars of attrition.
Not absolute — magic and vibranium still leave lasting wounds.

desc.zh: 隐形女苏珊的力场魔法之一，也可源于科技。
desc.en: Sue Storm's signature, also achievable by tech.

zh: 使自身或附着物从视线中完全隐没的能力。
苏睿的隐身斗篷与幽灵的量子穿物皆可达成，常配合潜行与侦察。
隐形同样遮蔽声息与热源时，才是真正完美的潜行。
en: Fading oneself or objects completely out of sight.
Shuri's cloak and Ghost's phasing achieve it; both pair with stealth and recon.
Perfect stealth also hides sound and heat.

desc.zh: 生物蛛丝或发射器织就的空中网络，蜘蛛侠的机动核心。
desc.en: Organic or mechanical webbing — the webhead's mobility.

zh: 彼得·帕克自研的蛛丝装置及其摆荡战术。
蛛丝既能封敌、织盾也能急救摆荡，是蜘蛛侠最顺手的战术工具。
蛛网配方是彼得的独门秘密，不同场景有对应强度的网型。
en: Peter Parker's web-shooters and the acrobatics built around them.
Webline binds, shields, rescues and swings — Spider-Man's handiest tactical kit.
Web formulas are Peter's secret; each scenario has a weave.

desc.zh: 为器物注入魔法属性：雷神之锤的"配得上者"即奥丁附魔。
desc.en: Imbuing objects with magic — Mjolnir's worthiness is Odin's enchantment.

zh: 以咒语为武器或个体附加魔法性质的技艺。
奥丁以咒语封印雷神之锤，附魔后的兵刃因而足以伤及神明。
被附魔的器物会忠于施法者的意志，跨越时间等待合格的主人。
en: Laying lasting magic onto weapons, objects, or people.
Odin sealed Mjolnir with a spell; enchanted steel can wound gods.
Enchanted items stay loyal across ages, awaiting worthy hands.

desc.zh: 2008 年托尼·斯塔克被俘后打造战甲自我救赎，开启整个漫威电影宇宙的第一块多米诺。
desc.en: Tony Stark builds a suit in captivity (2008), the domino that starts the MCU.

zh: 《钢铁侠》（2008）是漫威电影宇宙的开山之作：托尼·斯塔克在阿富汗被俘后于山洞打造首套战甲逃出生天，从此从军火商蜕变为超级英雄。
影片确立了 MCU 的核心公式——凡人智慧加科技对抗超规格威胁，并以彩蛋植入神盾局与复仇者计划的伏笔。
小罗伯特·唐尼的演绎让斯塔克成为银幕最具魅力的英雄之一，《钢铁侠》的成功直接开启了此后十余年的漫威电影宇宙。
作为 MCU 开山之作，本片以 5.85 亿美元成本撬动全球市场，片尾彩蛋从此成为超英电影标配。
影片核心是‘技术救赎’：山洞造甲与‘我是钢铁侠’的公然出柜，奠定小罗伯特·唐尼的影史地位。
en: Iron Man (2008) launched the MCU: Tony Stark, captured in Afghanistan, forges his first suit in a cave and transforms from arms dealer to hero.
It set the MCU formula — mortal wit plus tech against super-scale threats — and planted S.H.I.E.L.D./Avengers seeds in post-credits.
Robert Downey Jr. made Stark one of the most magnetic screen heroes; its success opened the decade-spanning MCU.
The MCU's launchpad grossed $585M worldwide and made the post-credits scene an industry standard.
Cave-built armor and the public 'I am Iron Man' define tech-redemption — and Downey's legend.

desc.zh: 布鲁斯· banner 躲避军方追捕并与憎恶对决的孤狼式绿灯之作。
desc.en: Bruce Banner evades the military and battles the Abomination (2008).

zh: 《无敌浩克》（2008）讲述班纳博士在伽马事故后被通缉流亡，罗斯将军与憎恶的追击迫使他直面浩克身份。
爱德华·诺顿版班纳与终战浩克在哈莱姆区爆发大战，最终班纳选择继续流亡。
作为 MCU 第二部电影，它确立了浩克-罗斯线，并在彩蛋中预告复仇者集结。
en: The Incredible Hulk (2008) follows a fugitive Banner hunted by Ross and Blonsky, forced to confront the Hulk.
Edward Norton's Banner faces the Abomination in Harlem and chooses exile again.
As the MCU's second film it seeded the Hulk-Ross dynamic and teased the Avengers.

desc.zh: 钯中毒与军备听证内外交困，托尼直面惠普与寡妇的登场。
desc.en: Palladium poisoning and Whiplash; Black Widow debuts (2010).

zh: 《钢铁侠2》（2010）让托尼同时面对钯中毒的死亡倒计时、父亲留下的新元素谜题，以及鞭锁的复仇。
影片引入黑寡妇与尼克·弗瑞的神盾局布局，托尼以合成新元素治愈心脏并完成新反应堆。
它深化了斯塔克工业与军火政治的叙事，并正式拉开复仇者前夜的大幕。
en: Iron Man 2 (2010): Stark races palladium poisoning, decodes his father's legacy, and fights Whiplash.
It introduced Black Widow and Fury's scheming; Stark synthesized a new element and rebuilt his chest reactor.
It deepened the arms-politics thread and set the stage for the Avengers.

desc.zh: 被放逐人间的雷神王子学会谦卑，九界格局首次展开。
desc.en: The exiled thunder god learns humility on Earth (2011).

zh: 《雷神》（2011）呈现阿斯加德王子的放逐与成长：托尔因傲慢被奥丁逐至地球，在凡人岁月中习得谦卑。
洛基的背叛、毁灭者的袭击与雷神之锤的资格考验交织成北欧神话与科幻的混响。
影片奠定九界世界观，并让洛基成为 MCU 最迷人的反派，彩蛋引出宇宙魔方。
en: Thor (2011): the Asgardian prince is exiled to Earth for hubris and learns humility among mortals.
Loki's betrayal, the Destroyer, and Mjolnir's worthiness test blend myth with sci-fi.
It built the Nine Realms cosmology and made Loki iconic; the Tesseract teaser followed.

desc.zh: 二战 skinny Steve 注射血清成为超级士兵，为挫败红骷髅长眠冰海。
desc.en: Skinny Steve becomes the super soldier and sleeps in ice to stop Red Skull (2011).

zh: 《美国队长：复仇者先锋》（2011）回溯二战：瘦弱的史蒂夫·罗杰斯注射超级士兵血清成为美国队长。
他与咆哮突击队对抗红骷髅的九头蛇，最终为阻止战机坠毁而冰封七十年。
影片确立了美队的信念内核——正义不因时代而立，并为其解冻后的复仇者时代铺垫。
en: Captain America: TFA (2011) returns to WWII: scrawny Steve Rogers becomes the Super-Soldier.
He battled Red Skull's HYDRA with the Howling Commandos and froze saving the day.
It forged Cap's creed — right over what's easy — and set up his thawed Avenger era.

desc.zh: 宇宙魔方危机迫使群雄首次集结，纽约之战奠定复联传奇。
desc.en: The Tesseract crisis assembles Earth's Mightiest Heroes; the Battle of New York (2012).

zh: 《复仇者联盟》（2012）是 MCU 第一阶段收官：洛基携齐塔瑞大军入侵纽约，六位英雄首次集结。
从磨合冲突到科尔森之死的催化剂，影片呈现"集结"从口号到信念的转变。
它以纽约之战确立复仇者范式和共享宇宙的商业奇迹，是 MCU 的历史性节点。
首次让多位独立英雄同框，以 15 亿美元成为影史第三卖座片，证明‘共享宇宙’商业模型的可行。
纽约之战确立了 MCU 的‘事件化’叙事：城市级灾难、团队磨合与彩蛋体系从此成为公式。
en: The Avengers (2012) closes Phase One: Loki's Chitauri invade New York and six heroes assemble.
From bickering to Coulson's fall, "assemble" became creed, not slogan.
The Battle of New York defined the shared-universe model — a commercial watershed.
First team-up grossed $1.5B, third-highest ever — proving the shared-universe model at the box office.
The Battle of New York set the MCU's event formula: city-scale stakes, team dynamics, credit scenes.

desc.zh: 焦虑症缠身的托尼在满大人迷局中证明"我就是钢铁侠"。
desc.en: A rattled Tony proves "I am Iron Man" in the Mandarin mystery (2013).

zh: 《钢铁侠3》（2013）让托尼在战后创伤中剥离战甲：满大人恐袭、绝境病毒与基里安的反派棋局。
影片以"我就是钢铁侠"的心境回归——即使没有战甲，托尼仍是英雄；满大人被反转成演员傀儡。
它完成托尼的角色弧线第一阶段，并以小辣椒获绝境之力开启新变数。
en: Iron Man 3 (2013): a traumatized Stark, stripped of suits, faces the Mandarin bombings and Killian's Extremis.
It ends with Stark proving he is the hero even without armor; the Mandarin twist landed shockingly.
It closed Stark's first arc and gifted Pepper Extremis powers.

desc.zh: 以太（现实宝石）现世，黑暗精灵欲令宇宙重归黑暗。
desc.en: The Aether surfaces; Dark Elves seek eternal darkness (2013).

zh: 《雷神2：黑暗世界》（2013）围绕以太（现实宝石）展开：黑暗精灵马勒基斯欲以它重归永恒黑暗。
洛基以诈死与反派的身份完成一场救赎式合作，九界之战在格林尼治展开。
影片首次让无限宝石成为主线，彩蛋中收藏者亮相并引出宇宙魔方藏匿之谜。
en: Thor: The Dark World (2013) revolves around the Aether as Malekith seeks eternal darkness.
Loki's fake-death redemption arc culminates in the Greenwich convergence battle.
It made the Infinity Stones a through-line; the Collector teaser extended the saga.

desc.zh: 神盾局被九头蛇渗透，冬兵身份揭晓的现代谍战经典。
desc.en: Hydra eats S.H.I.E.L.D. from within; the Winter Soldier revealed (2014).

zh: 《美国队长2：冬日战士》（2014）把美队带入现代谍战：神盾局实为九头蛇渗透数十年的巢穴。
巴基以冬日战士身份回归，三艘洞察航母的屠杀计划被粉碎，神盾局随之解体。
影片确立"信任与自由"的母题，并让巴基成为贯穿后续十年的情感线。
en: Captain America: TWS (2014) drops Cap into modern espionage: S.H.I.E.L.D. has been HYDRA all along.
Bucky returns as the Winter Soldier; the Insight helicarriers fall and S.H.I.E.L.D. collapses.
It set the trust-vs-freedom theme and anchored Bucky's decade-long thread.

desc.zh: 星爵率乌合之众夺取宇宙灵球（力量宝石），首支太空超英团成立。
desc.en: Star-Lord's misfits secure the Power Stone; a spacefaring team is born (2014).

zh: 《银河护卫队》（2014）将 MCU 带入宇宙：星爵、卡魔拉、毁灭者、火箭与格鲁特组成问题英雄团队。
力量宝石争夺战贯穿全片，五人从互相算计到为友情而战，纽约之战级别的宇宙危机被四人组化解。
影片以配乐与喜剧重塑宇宙线气质，成为 MCU 最具辨识度的美学分支。
en: Guardians of the Galaxy (2014) takes the MCU to space: Quill, Gamora, Drax, Rocket and Groot.
The Power Stone chase blends heist and cosmic stakes; they choose friendship over greed.
Its mixtape-and-comedy energy became the MCU's most distinct aesthetic.

desc.zh: 托尼的维和 AI 奥创失控，绯红女巫与幻视登场，索科维亚坠落。
desc.en: Tony's peacekeeping AI goes rogue; Wanda and Vision debut as Sokovia falls (2015).

zh: 《复仇者联盟2：奥创纪元》（2015）让托尼打造全球防御 AI 奥创，却制造出几乎毁灭人类的机器。
快银之死、幻视诞生、索科维亚升空坠落——复仇者以惨胜保全世界，也付出道德代价。
影片直接催生索科维亚协议，为内战埋下伏笔，也确立幻视-旺达的情感线。
en: Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015): Stark's peacekeeping AI Ultron nearly ends humanity.
Pietro falls, Vision is born, Sokovia falls — a costly victory with moral toll.
It birthed the Sokovia Accords, priming Civil War, and the Vision-Wanda romance.

desc.zh: 前科惯偷斯科特·朗穿上皮姆战衣，微观世界的大门打开。
desc.en: Ex-con Scott Lang dons the Pym suit and shrinks into a heist (2015).

zh: 《蚁人》（2015）以窃贼斯科特·朗为主角：汉克·皮姆的縮小战衣、量子领域的惊鸿一瞥。
斯科特在黄蜂战甲危机中击退达伦·克罗斯，并首次进入量子领域，为终局埋下伏笔。
影片以小博大，将皮姆科技与家庭温情注入 MCU 的微观维度。
en: Ant-Man (2015) makes thief Scott Lang its hero: Pym's shrinking suit and a quantum glimpse.
Scott stops Darren Cross's Yellowjacket and enters the Quantum Realm — an Endgame seed.
It adds scale-shifting heist charm and Pym-family warmth to the MCU.

desc.zh: 索科维亚协议撕裂复联，机场大战成为宇宙分水岭。
desc.en: The Sokovia Accords split the Avengers over the airport battlefield (2016).

zh: 《美国队长3：内战》（2016）让复仇者因索科维亚协议分裂：钢铁侠主张监管、美国队长主张自由。
机场大战集结双方阵营，西伯利亚的真相让斯塔克与巴基/美队彻底决裂。
影片引入黑豹与蜘蛛侠，并让复仇者名存实亡——直至灭霸降临才被迫重聚。
以‘索科维亚协议’引爆英雄理念之争，全片动作戏密度与阵营撕裂的戏剧性都达系列巅峰。
机场大战让钢铁侠与美队正面决裂，也首次引入黑豹与蜘蛛侠，成为 MCU 转折的枢纽。
en: Civil War (2016) splits the Avengers over the Accords: Stark for oversight, Rogers for conscience.
The Leipzig airport battle and Siberia's reveal shatter Stark's trust permanently.
It debuts Black Panther and Spider-Man and hollows out the Avengers until Thanos.
The Sokovia Accords split the heroes — the saga's densest action and sharpest ideological fracture.
The airport clash fractures Cap and Tony while debuting Black Panther and Spider-Man — a pivotal hinge.

desc.zh: 外科天才断手后求医卡玛泰姬，从傲慢医生到法师守门人。
desc.en: A surgeon's ruined hands lead him to Kamar-Taj and the mystic arts (2016).

zh: 《奇异博士》（2016）讲述顶尖外科医生斯特兰奇车祸后双手尽毁，转投卡玛泰姬修习秘法。
多玛姆的永恒谈判、阿戈摩托之眼的时间法术、镜像维度的视觉奇观定义 MCU 的魔法侧。
影片确立至尊法师体系与至圣所，为多元宇宙的后续展开铺设神秘学地基。
en: Doctor Strange (2016): the brilliant surgeon loses his hands and finds Kamar-Taj.
Dormammu's loop, the Eye's time magic and mirror dimensions define MCU sorcery.
It establishes the Sorcerer Supreme and Sanctums — the mystic bedrock of the multiverse.

desc.zh: 星爵生父活体星球伊戈的父爱陷阱与家族和解。
desc.en: Star-Lord meets his celestial father Ego — a paternal trap (2017).

zh: 《银河护卫队2》（2017）聚焦星爵的生父之谜：伊戈以活体行星之姿现身，却藏毁灭宇宙的野心。
勇度以牺牲证明"父亲是养育之人"，掠夺者葬礼成为 MCU 最催泪场面之一。
影片深化护卫队的家庭主题，并介绍至高族与术士亚当的伏笔。
en: Guardians Vol. 2 (2017) reveals Ego the Living Planet as Quill's father — and a cosmic threat.
Yondu's sacrifice defines fatherhood; his Ravager funeral is an MCU tearjerker.
It deepens the found-family theme and seeds Ayesha's Adam Warlock.

desc.zh: 少年帕克在托尼的 mentorship 下对上拾荒反派秃鹫。
desc.en: Teenage Peter balances homework and the Vulture under Stark's wing (2017).

zh: 《蜘蛛侠：英雄归来》（2017）让 MCU 版彼得·帕克回归高中日常：托尼做导师、秃鹫做对手。
影片以"邻家英雄"为纲，彼得拒绝托尼的入队邀请，选择先做好街区的小蜘蛛。
它确立 MCU 蜘蛛侠的少年成长线，并让秃鹫成为罕见的"平民反派"。
en: Spider-Man: Homecoming (2017) grounds Peter in high school: Stark as mentor, Vulture as foe.
Peter turns down Avengers membership to be the friendly neighborhood Spider-Man first.
It anchors Peter's coming-of-age and makes the Vulture a rare working-class villain.

desc.zh: 海拉归来毁灭阿斯加德，雷神在萨卡星失去锤子找回自己。
desc.en: Hela destroys Asgard; Thor loses the hammer and finds himself (2017).

zh: 《雷神3：诸神黄昏》（2017）让托尔在萨卡星失去锤子与家园：海拉归来、阿斯加德命悬一线。
浩克角斗、女武神重拾勇气、洛基选择王冠——影片以喜剧外壳讲末日悲剧。
托尔觉醒本源雷霆，以"阿斯加德是人民"的信念带幸存者启程——直通无限战争。
以 80 年代喜剧美学重造雷神，票房口碑双丰收，让‘诸神黄昏’成为 MCU 风格转向的标杆。
雷神之锤的毁灭与阿斯加德的覆灭逼出角色的成长，证明幽默之下可以藏住真正的失去。
en: Thor: Ragnarok (2017): Thor loses his hammer and realm — Hela returns and Asgard hangs by a thread.
Hulk arena fights, Valkyrie's courage, Loki's choice — comedy shell, doom core.
Thor awakens his true lightning and sails off — straight into Infinity War.
80s-comedy reinvention revived Thor critically and commercially — Ragnarok the MCU's style pivot.
Losing the hammer and Asgard forces growth — humor masking genuine loss, done right.

desc.zh: 特查拉继位瓦坎达国王，Killmonger 逼问孤立主义的代价。
desc.en: T'Challa's throne challenged by Killmonger and Wakanda's isolation (2018).

zh: 《黑豹》（2018）呈现瓦坎达的加冕与抉择：特查拉继位后直面表兄基尔蒙格的篡权挑战。
影片以振金之国为舞台探讨殖民创伤与开放议题，基尔蒙格之死成为深刻注脚。
作为首部黑人超级英雄电影，它成为文化事件，并让瓦坎达进入 MCU 主舞台。
全球 13.4 亿美元与奥斯卡多项提名，让黑人超级英雄电影第一次成为文化事件而非类型点缀。
克尔芒戈的‘反殖民复仇’让反派成为思想载体，瓦坎达的开放与孤立之争延续到现实议题。
en: Black Panther (2018): T'Challa's coronation faces Killmonger's claim and Wakanda's isolation question.
Vibranium Wakanda debates colonialism and openness; Killmonger's death lands hard.
A cultural landmark that put Wakanda at the MCU's center.
$1.34B and Oscar nominations made Black-led superhero cinema a cultural event, not a niche.
Killmonger's anti-colonial fury carries the film's argument — Wakanda's openness debate echoes real politics.

desc.zh: 灭霸集齐六宝石一个响指抹除半个宇宙生命，史诗级惨败。
desc.en: Thanos completes the Gauntlet and dusts half of all life (2018).

zh: 《复仇者联盟3：无限战争》（2018）让灭霸集齐六枚宝石：瓦坎达与泰坦两线决战皆是绝望之战。
幻视之死、卡魔拉献祭、洛基海姆达尔之殁——灭霸以"平衡"之名完成响指。
影片以反派叙事结构颠覆英雄片公式，留下五年的灰烬纪元。
灭霸的‘响指’让一半生命灰飞烟灭，反派首次以‘获胜’姿态结束超英电影，颠覆类型惯例。
多线叙事将 23 名英雄拧进 149 分钟，泰坦与瓦坎达双战场把‘宇宙级’第一次拍出实感。
en: Infinity War (2018): Thanos collects all six Stones; Wakanda and Titan are twin defeats.
Vision falls, Gamora is sacrificed — and the Snap erases half of all life.
It upends the hero formula via Thanos's arc, leaving five years of dust.
The Snap dusts half of life — a villain winning outright upends superhero convention.
Twenty-three heroes, two battlefields, 149 minutes — cosmic stakes made visceral at last.

desc.zh: 营救量子领域中的初代黄蜂女，与响指擦肩的彩蛋结局。
desc.en: Rescuing Janet from the Quantum Realm — seconds from the Snap (2018).

zh: 《蚁人2：黄蜂女现身》（2018）让斯科特与霍普深入量子领域救回珍妮特·凡·戴恩。
幽灵艾娃的量子病痛成为主题，影片以家庭温情冲淡量子危机。
斯科特困于量子领域的彩蛋直接衔接终局之战的时间劫持。
en: Ant-Man and the Wasp (2018) sends Scott and Hope into the Quantum Realm to rescue Janet.
Ghost's quantum affliction adds pathos beneath the heist-comedy.
Scott's stranded-QR post-credit ties directly into Endgame's heist.

desc.zh: 90 年代卡罗尔的失忆与觉醒，宇宙魔方的另一段旅程。
desc.en: Carol Danvers rediscovers herself in 1995, Tesseract in tow (2019).

zh: 《惊奇队长》（2019）回溯 1990 年代：卡罗尔·丹弗斯在克里-斯克鲁战争中找回记忆与力量。
影片揭示"Vers"即卡罗尔本人，斯克鲁难民的真相翻转克里叙事——惊奇队长以光速崛起。
它确立 MCU 女性英雄旗舰，彩蛋中卡罗尔回应弗瑞传呼——直通终局。
en: Captain Marvel (2019) flashes back to the 1990s: Carol rediscovers herself amid the Kree-Skrul war.
The Vers twist and Skrull refugee truth reframe the Kree narrative; Carol rises at light-speed.
It anchors the MCU's female hero flagship; the pager callback ties into Endgame.

desc.zh: 时间劫持逆转响指，"Avengers, assemble"下的最后一战。
desc.en: The Time Heist undoes the Snap; the last "Avengers assemble" (2019).

zh: 《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》（2019）让残部复仇者以时间劫持逆转响指：宝石重聚、绿巨人打响逆转之指。
灭霸再临的终局之战中，美队举锤、惊奇队长拆舰、托尼最后打响指——"我是钢铁侠"成为绝唱。
影片以三代情感的收束（美队回到过去、娜塔莎沃米尔牺牲、托尼之殁）为无限传奇画下句点。
以 27.9 亿美元登顶影史票房，用时间劫持、五年前史与‘复仇者集结’为十年旧账收尾。
钢铁侠的响指与美队的老年谢幕构成双重告别，让商业巨制第一次以‘挽歌’作结。
en: Endgame (2019): the survivors time-heist the Stones, Hulk reverse-snaps, and the dusted return.
Cap lifts Mjolnir, Carol shreds the ship, and Stark's final snap closes the saga.
It closes the Infinity Saga with Cap's dance, Natasha's fall and Tony's farewell.
The all-time box-office champ at $2.79B closes a decade with time heists and 'Avengers assemble'.
Tony's Snap and Cap's farewell turn a blockbuster into an elegy — the saga's true finale.

desc.zh: 后终局时代的欧洲之旅，神秘客的幻象骗局与身份暴露。
desc.en: Peter's European trip undone by Mysterio's illusions and a doxxed identity (2019).

zh: 《蜘蛛侠：英雄远征》（2019）在钢铁侠身后重启青春：彼得·帕克的欧洲修学旅行被神秘客搅局。
神秘客以幻术冒充多元宇宙英雄，最终身份揭穿——彼得获得伊迪丝眼镜却失去一切。
影片在"能力越大责任越大"的追问中拉开第四阶段，彩蛋引爆多元宇宙裂缝。
en: Far From Home (2019) reboots Peter's teen life post-Stark: Europe, a school trip, and Mysterio.
Mysterio fakes a multiverse hero; exposure costs Peter the E.D.I.T.H. and his innocence.
It opens Phase Four on a responsibility note — and a multiverse breach tease.

desc.zh: 娜塔莎直面红房与德雷科夫，妹妹叶莲娜接过衣钵。
desc.en: Natasha torched the Red Room; Yelena inherits the mantle (2021).

zh: 《黑寡妇》（2021）回溯娜塔莎的过去：布达佩斯往事、红房总部与其"家庭"——叶莲娜、红色卫士与梅丽娜。
影片瓦解德雷科夫将军的红房帝国，姐妹情谊贯穿始终——娜塔莎的牺牲因此更显分量。
作为她的告别前传，影片完成黑寡妇的补完，彩蛋中叶莲娜接过下一棒。
en: Black Widow (2021) returns to Natasha's past: Budapest, the Red Room, and her "family" — Yelena, Red Guardian, Melina.
It dismantles Dreykov's Red Room; the sisterhood makes Natasha's later sacrifice heavier.
A prequel farewell completing Natasha's story; the post-credit passes the baton to Yelena.

name.en: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

desc.zh: 文武之子尚气逃离十环，最终在塔罗直面父亲与噬魂兽。
desc.en: Wenwu's son escapes the Ten Rings and faces him at Ta Lo (2021).

zh: 《尚气与十环传奇》（2021）把漫威东方线搬上银幕：尚气逃离十环帮后，被卷回父亲的千年阴谋。
塔罗秘境的神话决战中，父亲文武释放心魔，尚气以十环之力守护秘境并继承十环。
影片以功夫美学重塑 MCU 动作戏，十环与塔罗秘境为东方神话线奠基。
en: Shang-Chi (2021) brings Marvel's Eastern line to screen: Shang-Chi flees the Ten Rings, then returns.
At Ta Lo's mythic battle, Wenwu unleashes the Dweller; Shang-Chi claims the Rings.
Its martial-arts language reboots MCU action; Ta Lo and the Rings seed Eastern myth.

desc.zh: 天神组造物七千年后聚首，抉择阻止"涌现"还是牺牲地球。
desc.en: The Eternals reunite to stop the Emergence — or let Earth die (2021).

zh: 《永恒族》（2021）聚焦天神组创造的不朽种族：十位永恒族在七千年后重聚，面对天神涌现的真相。
影片揭示永恒族的使命实为培育天神蒂亚姆，团队分裂为守护派与自由派——伊卡利斯陨落。
它扩展 MCU 宇宙学（天神组/变异族），让地球危机与宇宙秩序首次正面相逢。
en: Eternals (2021) follows the Celestial-made immortals: ten Eternals reunite after 7,000 years.
The mission is revealed as breeding Tiamut; the team splits — Ikaris falls.
It expands MCU cosmology — Celestials, Deviants — and humanity's place between them.

desc.zh: 身份暴露引发多元裂缝，三代蜘蛛侠同框拯救彼此。
desc.en: A botched spell cracks the multiverse open; three Spider-Men unite (2021).

zh: 《蜘蛛侠：英雄无归》（2021）让彼得求助奇异博士遗忘身份，却撕开多元宇宙裂缝——三代蜘蛛侠同框。
章鱼博士、绿魔、电光人等宿敌穿越而来；梅姨之死让彼得以"独自承担"收场。
影片以多元宇宙彩蛋狂欢纪念二十年蜘蛛侠历史，并开启 MCU 魔法侧的新裂缝。
三代蜘蛛侠同框的‘多元宇宙’狂欢创下 19 亿美元票房，成为疫情时代影院复苏的最大引擎。
结尾记忆抹除让彼得回归‘友好邻居’起点，把商业娱乐收束成关于责任与孤独的成人礼。
en: No Way Home (2021): Peter asks Strange to erase his identity, breaking the multiverse — three Spider-Men unite.
Villains cross over; Aunt May's death leaves Peter to carry on alone.
A multiverse celebration of twenty spider-years, cracking open the MCU's mystic side.
Three Spider-Men in one film grossed $1.9B — the pandemic-era's biggest theater revival engine.
The memory wipe returns Peter to the friendly neighbor — blockbuster as a coming-of-age on duty and solitude.

name.zh: 奇异博士2：疯狂多元宇宙
name.en: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

desc.zh: 美国·查维兹的逃亡之旅，绯红女巫追逐暗神之书的疯狂巡游。
desc.en: America Chavez on the run from a Darkhold-corrupted Wanda (2022).

zh: 《奇异博士2：疯狂多元宇宙》（2022）让斯特兰奇与旺达在多元宇宙竞逐黑暗神书与穿越少女。
光照会（838 宇宙）覆灭、旺达以混沌魔法吞噬多重宇宙——最终她亲手毁书，孤独赎罪。
影片以恐怖片语法重构超级英雄电影，确立多元宇宙危机的代价逻辑。
en: Multiverse of Madness (2022): Strange and Wanda race across universes for the Darkhold and America Chavez.
The Illuminati falls; Wanda's chaos magic scars reality until she destroys the book alone.
Horror grammar meets superhero cinema, pricing multiversal crisis with grief.

desc.zh: 屠神者格尔追杀众神，简·福斯特举起重锤成为女雷神。
desc.en: Gorr the God Butcher hunts gods; Jane lifts Mjolnir (2022).

zh: 《雷神4：爱与雷霆》（2022）让屠神者戈尔以弑神黑剑猎杀众神，简·福斯特以女雷神之姿回归。
影片以喜剧糖衣包裹癌症与信仰的沉重内核：简在战斗中消逝，戈尔在愿望前释然。
它以女雷神的传承与永恒之门的承诺，让托尔在失去中走向新的守护。
en: Love and Thunder (2022): Gorr hunts gods with the Necrosword while Jane returns as the Mighty Thor.
Comedy coats a cancer-and-faith core: Jane fades mid-battle as Gorr's wish is granted.
Jane's legacy and Eternity's gift let Thor guard anew amid loss.

desc.zh: 特查拉身后，舒芮接棒黑豹，深海王国塔罗坎浮出水面。
desc.en: Shuri takes the mantle as Talokan surfaces from the deep (2022).

zh: 《黑豹2：瓦坎达万岁》（2022）在特查拉逝世后聚焦苏睿：塔罗坎之王纳摩为振金浮出深海。
影片以悼念开启，以复仇与和解收尾——苏睿服下心形药草继任黑豹，两国缔结盟约。
作为查德维克·博斯曼的银幕道别，它同时为新黑豹与海王线奠基。
en: Wakanda Forever (2022) centers Shuri after T'Challa's passing; Namor's Talokan rises for vibranium.
Grief opens, vengeance-and-peace closes: Shuri takes the herb, Wakanda and Talokan ally.
A screen farewell to Chadwick Boseman and the foundation for a new Panther and Namor.

desc.zh: 卡罗尔、莫妮卡与卡玛拉的光互换轨迹，领袖气场的接力。
desc.en: Carol, Monica and Kamala swap places with every light jump (2023).

zh: 《惊奇队长2》（2023）让卡罗尔·丹弗斯、莫妮卡·兰博与卡玛拉·汗因纠缠之力被迫组队。
三人的"位置互换"设定与音乐星球、哈拉解放交织，完成一次轻快的宇宙接力。
影片以三人组队点燃惊奇家族，多元宇宙线的串联让彩蛋直通下一代。
en: The Marvels (2023): Carol, Monica and Kamala are entangled by their intertwined powers.
Body-swap shenanigans, a musical planet and Hala's liberation — a cosmic relay with heart.
It sparks the Marvel family; multiversal teases point to the next generation.

name.zh: 蚁人与黄蜂女：量子狂潮

desc.zh: 一家三口误入量子领域，征服者康的帝国初露獠牙。
desc.en: The Lang-Van Dyne family meets Kang the Conqueror in the Quantum Realm (2023).

zh: 《蚁人与黄蜂女：量子狂潮》（2023）让蚁人一家坠入量子领域：征服者康的分体在此统治。
影片以微观宇宙的奇观对抗康的征服者野心，斯科特以平凡意志击退"时间尽头的暴君"。
它正式为多元宇宙传奇引入康，成为第五阶段的叙事枢纽。
en: Quantumania (2023): the Pym-Lang family falls into the Quantum Realm, ruled by a Kang variant.
Quantum spectacle meets Kang's conquest; Scott's ordinary grit repels the time-tyrant.
It introduces Kang properly as the Multiverse Saga's pivot.

desc.zh: 火箭浣熊的出身悲剧与至高进化的高塔，护卫队温情告别。
desc.en: Rocket's tragic origin vs. the High Evolutionary; a heartfelt farewell (2023).

zh: 《银河护卫队3》（2023）揭开火箭浣熊的创生史：至高进化者的实验室地狱与"火箭计划"。
护卫队为救火箭冒险攻入反地球与心灵，最终解放实验动物、送别卡魔拉之变体。
作为古恩告别之作，影片让护卫队正式分道扬镳，火箭接任队长。
以火箭的身世为轴，本片把太空喜剧翻转为对‘创造与造物主’的沉痛追问。
护卫队各自告别的结局让漫威第一次拍出‘团队解散’的体面，也为角色独立线铺路。
en: Vol. 3 (2023) reveals Rocket's creation below the High Evolutionary's lab-hell.
The team storms Counter-Earth and Orgocorp, freeing test subjects and saying goodbye.
Gunn's farewell: the Guardians part ways with Rocket taking the lead.
Centered on Rocket's origin, Vol. 3 turns space comedy into a grief-stricken query on creators and creations.
The Guardians' dignified disbanding is a Marvel first — seeding their solo futures.

desc.zh: 韦德为救自己的时间线拖上"最烂金刚狼"，大战卡珊德拉与TVA。
desc.en: Wade drags the "worst Wolverine" against Cassandra Nova and the TVA (2024).

zh: 《死侍与金刚狼》（2024）让福克斯时代的两位反英雄穿越进 TVA 的虚空之地。
死侍为救宇宙绑架金刚狼，对抗卡珊德拉·诺娃，以"自我牺牲"修好时间线裂缝。
影片以彩蛋狂欢为福克斯X战警宇宙送别，并为 MCU 多元宇宙开辟新通道。
en: Deadpool & Wolverine (2024) drags Fox-era anti-heroes through the TVA's Void.
Deadpool kidnaps Wolverine to save his universe, fights Cassandra Nova and mends the timeline.
An Easter-egg carnival farewell to Fox X-Men and a new multiverse door.

desc.zh: 山姆·威尔逊首部个人队长电影，与红色浩克的对决。
desc.en: Sam Wilson's first solo Cap film against Red Hulk (2025).

zh: 《美国队长4：美丽新世界》（2025）聚焦接盾后的山姆·威尔逊：新美队直面红浩克与总统阴谋。
超级士兵阴谋、天神岛权力交接让山姆在"不靠血清"的信念中证明自己配得上盾牌。
影片让罗斯总统化身红浩克，确立第四阶段后的政治惊悚基调。
en: Brave New World (2025) centers Sam Wilson after the shield: the new Cap faces Red Hulk and a presidential plot.
A supersoldier conspiracy and celestial-island politics test Sam's serum-less faith in the shield.
It turns President Ross into Red Hulk and sets a political-thriller tone.

desc.zh: 一队边缘反英雄被瓦伦蒂娜拼凑成"新复仇者"。
desc.en: Valentina assembles misfit antiheroes into the "New Avengers" (2025).

zh: 《雷霆特攻队*》（2025）集结瓦尔、巴基、叶莲娜等反英雄组成官方小队。
政府以赦免为饵驱使"半坏英雄"办脏活，影片在黑色幽默中拷问英雄定义。
它承接冬日战士与黑寡妇线，成为"反英雄集结"的第五阶段收官。
en: Thunderbolts* (2025) assembles Val, Bucky, Yelena and other quasi-villains into an official team.
Amnesties buy dirty work from broken heroes — a black-comic question on heroism.
Drawing on Winter Soldier and Black Widow threads, it closes Phase Five with anti-hero flair.

desc.zh: Earth-828 的初代家庭迎战行星吞噬者与银影侠莎拉·巴尔。
desc.en: Earth-828's first family faces Galactus and Shalla-Bal (2025).

zh: 《神奇四侠：初露锋芒》（2025）重启漫威第一家庭：60 年代风格的宇宙射线起源。
影片聚焦里德、苏、约翰尼与本的家庭互动，并预告吞噬者加拉图斯的降临。
作为第六阶段开篇，它把神奇四侠正式接入 MCU 主线。
en: First Steps (2025) reboots Marvel's First Family with a retro-60s cosmic-ray origin.
Family dynamics anchor the reboot, with Galactus looming as the cosmic threat.
Opening Phase Six, it welds the FF into MCU canon.

desc.zh: 身份重置后的帕克独自迎接崭新街头篇章（2026）。
desc.en: A reset Peter opens a fresh street-level chapter (2026).

zh: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》是 MCU 多元宇宙传奇中彼得·帕克的全新篇章：身份被遗忘后的蜘蛛侠重新出发。
影片将收束无路可归的伤痕，让蜘蛛侠回到街区日常。
作为第四阶段后的蜘蛛线序章，它聚焦成长的代价。
en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is Peter fresh start after the forget-spell, a new MCU chapter.
It will heal No Way Home scars and return Peter to street-level routine.
As the post-Phase-Four Spider prologue, it centers the cost of growing up.

desc.zh: 毁灭博士降临多元宇宙的集结大战（定档 2026-12-18）。
desc.en: Doctor Doom descends on the multiverse (Dec 18, 2026).

zh: 《复仇者联盟5：毁灭日》是 MCU 第六阶段的顶点：多元宇宙的康之战争燃至复仇者集结。
毁灭博士（小罗伯特·唐尼饰演）成为核心威胁，英雄们为守住所爱集结。
它把多元宇宙传奇推向最高潮，为秘密战争铺垫。
en: Avengers: Doomsday climaxes Phase Six: the Multiversal War fuels an Avengers rally.
Doctor Doom (Robert Downey Jr.) looms as the core threat.
It peaks the Multiverse Saga, setting up Secret Wars.

desc.zh: 多元宇宙传奇的终章（定档 2027-12-17）。
desc.en: The Multiversal Saga finale (Dec 17, 2027).

zh: 《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》是多元宇宙传奇的终章：所有宇宙碰撞、所有英雄与所有反派被卷进终极战场。
漫画大事件的电影化将把历代英雄与反派一同推向决战。
它是 MCU 迄今最大的跨界盛宴，宣告新纪元的开启。
en: Avengers: Secret Wars ends the Multiverse Saga: universes collide in the ultimate battlefield.
The comic event translates heroes and villains from every era into one final war.
The MCU biggest crossover yet, heralding a new era.

desc.zh: 情境喜剧外壳下的悲恸之书：旺达以悲伤改写西景镇现实。
desc.en: A sitcom-shaped grief study: Wanda rewrites Westview (2021).

zh: 《旺达幻视》（2021）以情景喜剧致敬开场，旺达在西景镇为幻视筑起魔法牢笼，最终直面丧亲之痛。
阿加莎·哈克尼斯揭开混沌魔法真相，旺达在告别中成为绯红女巫，双胞胎彩蛋埋下少年复仇者。
影片是 MCU 第四阶段的感情基石，把电视剧集拉到电影级制作，魔法侧由此翻开新页。
以情景喜剧外壳讲悲伤与控制的迷你剧，开创 MCU 流媒体叙事的类型实验先河。
幻视与旺达的爱、阿加莎的阴谋与西景镇结界层层反转，让‘绯红女巫’从配角晋升主角。
en: WandaVision (2021) opens as sitcom homage: Wanda cages Westview around Vision, then faces her grief.
Agatha exposes chaos magic; Wanda becomes the Scarlet Witch in farewell, with twins teasing Young Avengers.
It grounds Phase Four emotionally, lifts TV to film scale, and opens a new mystic page.
Sitcom skin over grief and control — the series that launched the MCU's streaming genre-lab.
Vision's love, Agatha's scheme, the Hex's reversals — it promotes Scarlet Witch from side to lead.

name.en: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

desc.zh: 盾牌的继承权之争与以赛亚·布拉德利的历史清算。
desc.en: The shield's inheritance and Isaiah Bradley's reckoning (2021).

zh: 《猎鹰与冬兵》（2021）聚焦接盾前的山姆与复出后的巴基：两人被迫合作处理碎旗者的极端运动。
以赛亚·布拉德利的悲剧揭开超级士兵历史阴暗面，山姆最终在公开演讲中接过美队之盾。
影片完成美队名号的交接仪式，把"盾牌属于谁"写成一个关于继承与信念的命题。
en: Falcon and the Winter Soldier (2021) tracks pre-shield Sam and returning Bucky, forced to handle the Flag Smashers.
Isaiah Bradley's tragedy exposes supersoldier history; Sam claims the shield in a public speech.
It completes the Cap handover — the shield as inheritance and conviction.

desc.zh: 洛基被 TVA 逮捕，一路走到时间尽头的自我救赎史诗（两季）。
desc.en: Loki, arrested by the TVA, walks to the end of time (2 seasons, 2021-23).

zh: 《洛基》（2021）从终局的逃逸节点切入：洛基被 TVA 逮捕，在时间管理局见识神圣时间线的真相。
他与变体西尔维联手寻找遗留之人，最终洛基选择坐上时间王座，成为守护多元宇宙的时间之神。
剧集是多元宇宙传奇的发动机，把洛基从诡计之神升格为叙事中心。
时间变异管理局与‘神圣时间线’首次点题多元宇宙机制，为整个 MCU 的下一阶段铺设引擎。
洛基与希尔维在时间尽头的选择打开多元宇宙，把‘自我救赎’写成一部时空史诗。
en: Loki (2021) dives from the Endgame escape branch: the TVA arrests him and reveals the Sacred Timeline.
Allied with Sylvie, he finds He Who Remains and chooses the time-throne — god of the multiverse.
The engine of the Multiverse Saga, elevating Loki from trickster to protagonist.
The TVA and sacred timeline name the multiverse rules — powering the MCU's next phase.
Loki and Sylvie's choice at time's end unleashes the multiverse — self-redemption as time epic.

desc.zh: 观察者乌阿图讲述多元宇宙的"如果"：卡特队长、至高奇异等（三季）。
desc.en: Uatu narrates the multiverse's what-ifs: Captain Carter, Strange Supreme (3 seasons).

zh: 《假如…？》（2021）以动画单元剧探索 MCU 的关键拐点：假如卡特成为美队、假如灭霸加入复仇者等。
观察者乌阿图从旁观到干预，多元宇宙的保护者团队随之成形。
它让"假如"成为正式叙事维度，为多元宇宙传奇提供想象力上限。
en: What If...? (2021) animates MCU pivot points: Peggy as Cap, Thanos joining the Avengers, and more.
The Watcher shifts from observer to interventionist, forming multiverse guardians.
It makes "what if" canon, capping the Multiverse Saga's imagination.

desc.zh: 圣诞纽约，克林特与凯特·毕肖普的师徒搭档与浪人清算。
desc.en: A NYC Christmas: Clint and Kate's mentor-partnership (2021).

zh: 《鹰眼》（2021）让退役的克林特被拖回纽约街头：昔日浪人身份的仇家追杀而至。
凯特·毕肖普以超级粉丝身份成为徒弟，两人共同对付运动服黑帮与金并的阴影。
剧集完成鹰眼名号的交棒，让克林特在家庭与使命间找到平衡。
en: Hawkeye (2021) drags retired Clint back to New York: his Ronin past comes hunting.
Fan-girl Kate Bishop becomes his partner; the Tracksuit Mafia and Kingpin loom.
It passes the Hawkeye mantle while Clint balances family and duty.

desc.zh: 多重人格马克/斯蒂文在孔苏的权柄下追猎阿米特。
desc.en: Marc/Steven's fractured minds serve Khonshu against Ammit (2022).

zh: 《月亮骑士》（2022）呈现雇佣兵马克·斯佩克特的解离人格：博物馆店员史蒂文与他共享同一具身体。
月神孔苏的复仇使命与埃及神话的对抗线，让三重心智在伦敦展开超自然之战。
剧集为 MCU 引入超级英雄的生存创伤叙事，也打开超自然街区。
en: Moon Knight (2022): mercenary Marc Spector's DID — museum clerk Steven shares his body.
Khonshu's vengeance and Egyptian myth clash across London with three minds in one.
It brings survivor-trauma heroics and the supernatural street into the MCU.

desc.zh: 泽侯贝里血统的卡玛拉以能量手环开启英雄之路。
desc.en: Kamala Khan's bangle unlocks her Zen-Whoberi legacy (2022).

zh: 《惊奇少女》（2022）讲述泽西城的巴基斯坦裔少女卡玛拉·汗：从粉丝到异人族（后改为变种人）起源。
她的家族秘密与穿越维度的手镯展开灯光魔法，最终与惊奇队长接棒。
剧集是第一代有个人刊的穆斯林英雄的银幕化，少年英雄线由此起飞。
en: Ms. Marvel (2022): Jersey City's Pakistani-American teen Kamala Khan, fangirl to hero.
Family secrets and a dimensional bangle unlock light powers, passing the Captain Marvel baton.
It screens Marvel's first Muslim solo hero — the youth-hero line takes flight.

desc.zh: 律师珍在超级人类法庭与自身伽马身份间的喜剧拉扯。
desc.en: Lawyer Jen juggles gamma life and superhuman law (2022).

zh: 《女浩克》（2022）聚焦律师珍妮弗·沃尔特斯：输血获得伽马之力后，在法庭与变身间走钢丝。
第四面墙喜剧、超人类法律部门与"浩克变体"案件构成独特的职场超英剧。
剧集以律师视角重审"英雄责任"，为 MCU 注入罕见的讽刺幽默。
en: She-Hulk (2022): attorney Jennifer Walters walks courtrooms and gamma transformations.
Fourth-wall comedy, superhuman law and Hulk-variant cases make a unique legal-superhero show.
It re-tries "hero responsibility" from a lawyer's desk with rare satire.

desc.zh: 斯克鲁人渗透危机下的神盾余晖与背叛。
desc.en: Skrull infiltration and the last days of Fury's trust (2023).

zh: 《秘密入侵》（2023）让尼克·弗瑞回归地球：斯克鲁人渗透了全球权力层，连复仇者也难以信任。
塔洛斯的牺牲与斯克鲁难民的求存真相，让"谁还能信任"成为整季的绞索。
剧集将漫画大事件压缩成谍战惊悚，也正式点燃变种人之名。
en: Secret Invasion (2023) returns Nick Fury to Earth: Skrulls have infiltrated global power.
Talos's sacrifice and the refugees' truth tighten the "who can you trust" noose all season.
It compresses the comic event into spy-thriller and names mutants aloud.

desc.zh: 格鲁特宝宝的单集短篇喜剧（两季）。
desc.en: Baby Groot shorts (2 seasons).

zh: 《我是格鲁特》（2022）以系列动画短片聚焦小格鲁特的日常：盆栽大小的宇宙历险。
每一集都是一次对"I am Groot"的重新演绎，护卫队彩蛋不断。
短片以萌系语法填补银护系列的间隙，是漫威最轻的甜品。
en: I Am Groot (2022): tiny animated shorts of Baby Groot's daily cosmic mischief.
Each episode re-performs "I am Groot" with Guardian cameos galore.
Cute-grammar filler between Guardians installments — Marvel's lightest dessert.

desc.zh: 玛雅·洛佩兹回到故乡直面金并与祖辈记忆。
desc.en: Maya Lopez returns home to face Fisk and her ancestors (2024).

zh: 《回声》（2024）让聋哑原住民英雄玛雅·洛佩兹回归俄克拉荷马的乔克托家园，逃离金并的阴影。
剧集以原住民文化为肌理，金并的复活彩蛋为夜魔侠线埋线。
它是 MCU 首个"全原住民主创"项目，街头线由此更接地气。
en: Echo (2024) returns Deaf Choctaw hero Maya Lopez to Oklahoma, fleeing Kingpin's shadow.
Indigenous culture textures the series; Kingpin's revival teases Daredevil.
The MCU's first Native-led project, grounding the street line further.

desc.zh: 阿加莎率女巫团重走巫师之路，绿巫真身揭晓。
desc.en: Agatha walks the Witches' Road; the Green Witch revealed (2024).

zh: 《女巫阿加莎》（2024）让失去力量的阿加莎·哈克尼斯集结女巫团，踏上传说中能夺回魔力的巫师之路。
比利·卡普兰（旺达之子）的身份揭晓让道路的真相反转，阿加莎在牺牲与救赎间摇摆。
剧集把旺达幻视的魔法侧织得更深，也接续少年复仇者的铺垫。
en: Agatha All Along (2024): powerless Agatha Harkness gathers a coven for the mythic Witches' Road.
Billy Kaplan's reveal flips the road's truth; Agatha swings between sacrifice and redemption.
It deepens WandaVision's mystic side and continues Young Avengers groundwork.

desc.zh: 马特与金并的政坛重逢，地狱厨房再燃战火。
desc.en: Matt and Fisk reunite in politics; Hell's Kitchen burns again (2025).

zh: 《夜魔侠：重生》（2025）让马特·默多克在律师与义警的双职间重启：金并当选纽约市长，街头重燃战火。
福吉之死的重锤与惩罚者的灰色介入，让马特在法律边界的坚持付出代价。
剧集把 Netflix 街头的血脉正式接入 MCU，夜魔侠重返主场。
en: Daredevil: Born Again (2025) reboots Matt between law and vigilante as Kingpin becomes mayor.
Foggy's death and Punisher's grey shades cost Matt his clean-line faith.
It welds Netflix street DNA into MCU canon — Daredevil home again.

desc.zh: 天才少女瑞里·威廉姆斯的战甲与魔法纠葛。
desc.en: Riri Williams' armor entangles with magic (2025).

zh: 《钢铁之心》（2025）聚焦天才少女莉莉·威廉姆斯：自研战甲、继承钢铁侠精神的新一代装甲英雄。
芝加哥的街区视角与麻省理工的学术背景交织，让"钢铁之心"成为少女版托尼斯塔克。
剧集完成托尼·斯塔克技术遗产的延续，装甲英雄线世代交接。
en: Ironheart (2025): prodigy Riri Williams builds her own armor — the next-generation iron hero.
Chicago streets meet MIT brains — Ironheart as the teen Tony Stark.
It continues Stark's tech legacy with an armored generational handoff.

desc.zh: 纵横历史的瓦坎达特工战线（动画）。
desc.en: Wakandan agents across history (animation, 2025).

zh: 《瓦坎达之眼》（2025）动画聚焦瓦坎达的"战犬"哈特特扎尔泽：游走世界回收振金武器的秘密使团。
历代黑豹的历史闪回与振金武器的大冒险，让瓦坎达的世界视角立体化。
它是瓦坎达线的历史补完，也是动画侧的又一宇宙拼图。
en: Eyes of Wakanda (2025) animates Wakanda's Hatut Zeraze — agents recovering vibranium worldwide.
Black Panther flashbacks and vibranium heists dimensionalize Wakanda's world-view.
A historical completion of Wakanda, another animated universe tile.

desc.zh: 怪物猎人聚会上的狼人夜惊（黑白特别篇）。
desc.en: Monster hunters meet a werewolf (B&W special, 2022).

zh: 《狼人之夜》（2022）特别篇以黑白恐怖片致敬：猎人集会争夺血石，狼人杰克·拉塞尔现出真身。
影片以哥特美学引入怪物宇宙，太阳神猎手与狼人的结盟埋下午夜之子种子。
特别篇让 MCU 首次触碰古典怪谈，超自然线由此开启。
en: Werewolf by Night (2022) pays homage to classic horror in black-and-white: a Bloodstone hunt.
Gothic aesthetics build a monster-verse; the alliance seeds the Midnight Sons.
The MCU's first classic-horror outing, opening its supernatural line.

name.zh: 银河护卫队：节日特别篇
name.en: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special

desc.zh: 护卫队为星爵偷圣诞礼物的假日闹剧。
desc.en: The team kidnaps an actor for Star-Lord's Christmas (2022).

zh: 《银河护卫队节日特别篇》（2022）讲述护卫队为给星爵圣诞惊喜，前往地球绑架凯文·贝肯。
短片以节日喜剧收束护卫队的家庭感，也为《银护3》的告别预演温情。
它是 MCU 最轻松的一小时，把宇宙英雄拉回地球过圣诞。
en: The Holiday Special (2022): the Guardians kidnap Kevin Bacon as a Christmas gift for Quill.
Holiday comedy caps the found-family warmth, previewing Vol. 3's farewell.
The MCU's lightest hour — cosmic heroes home for Christmas.

desc.zh: 白色幻视追寻记忆的旅程（2026-10 待播）。
desc.en: White Vision seeks his memories (Oct 2026).

zh: 《幻视探索》聚焦白幻视的记忆之旅：失去情感记忆的合成人踏上寻找自我的道路。
旺达幻视的支线延伸让幻视的人性追问成为主线，魔法与机械再次交锋。
剧集将完成幻视的"我是谁"答卷，也是魔法线的重要接续。
en: Vision Quest follows White Vision's memory quest: a synthezoid seeking identity without emotion.
WandaVision's thread extends Vision's humanity question, magic vs machine again.
It answers Vision's "who am I" — a key mystic-line continuation.

desc.zh: 1992 动画正传续作：万磁王掌校与强过化的泽诺布拉特危机。
desc.en: The TAS continuity continues: Magneto's school, Bastion's siege (2024).

zh: 《X战警97》（2024）以 90 年代动画的正统续作回归：变种人面临政府与哨兵的新一轮围剿。
琴·葛蕾的凤凰归位、镭射眼的领袖成长、以及喀拉喀瓦式变种人理想的雏形，构成这一动画史诗。
它让老一代动画迷泪目也让新观众入坑，是 MCU 多元宇宙变种人线的排头兵。
en: X-Men '97 (2024) returns as the 90s cartoon's canon sequel: mutants face new government and Sentinel pressure.
Phoenix Jean, Cyclops leading, and a Krakoa-like mutant dream shape this animated epic.
A tear-jerker for old fans and an entry for new — the vanguard of MCU mutants.

desc.zh: 另类起源的少年帕克与诺曼导师线（动画）。
desc.en: An alt-origin Peter mentored by Norman (animation, 2025).

zh: 《你的友好邻居蜘蛛侠》（2025）动画以复古画风重启彼得·帕克：诺曼·奥斯本成为他的导师。
剧集把蜘蛛侠拉回皇后区小人物叙事，多元宇宙蜘蛛格温来客串。
动画以全新导师关系打开无限可能，是最清新的蜘蛛起源之一。
en: YFNSM (2025) reboots Peter with retro art: Norman Osborn becomes his mentor instead of Stark.
It returns Peter to Queens everyman roots; Spider-Gwen drops in.
A fresh mentor-fork opens new possibilities — one of the cleanest spider origins.

desc.zh: 天才发明家与军火商，被俘后以战甲重生；从自恋天才到"爱你三千遍"的牺牲者。
desc.en: Genius arms dealer reborn in a cave as the Armored Avenger; died saving the universe.

props.actor: 小罗伯特·唐尼 Robert Downey Jr.
props.occupation: 斯塔克工业 CEO / 复仇者

zh: 托尼·斯塔克
铁人
钢铁侠 托尼·斯塔克
en: Tony Stark
Golden Avenger
Iron Man / Tony Stark

zh: 安东尼·爱德华"托尼"·斯塔克是斯塔克工业创始人霍华德·斯塔克与玛丽亚之子，出生于 1930 年纽约的工业豪门。从小展现机械天才，15 岁考入麻省理工学院，22 岁接手濒临危机的家族企业，成为"军火商王子"——也沉迷名声、女人与酒。
在海外战场被炸伤后，他利用胸前弹片的动力之心与第一台微型电弧炉，在洞穴里造出了第一套动力装甲（Mark I），以此逃脱并重获新生。回到美国后他创立"铁人计划"：装甲不仅是武器，更是他自己灵魂的外衣。
他的人生主线是一场对抗自我的战争：装甲大战（Armor Wars）中他追回流散的技术；内战中他是"注册法案"一方的领袖，与美队的信任彻底破裂；在弑神者与复仇者命运中他数次濒死——包括被阿尔蒂米斯战甲改造、注射极限病毒（Extremis）与脑机接口化。
他没有生化强化，装甲之外的力量是天才智力、亿万资产与自我修复的意志；他最大的弱点始终是酒精、骄傲与"为了对的目的做错误的决定"。
现代主线里，他从弑神、断肢与重生中一次次归来，仍站在科技与道德的交界处，成为复仇者历史里"最像凡人天才"的传奇。
en: Anthony Edward "Tony" Stark, son of Howard and Maria Stark, was born in 1930 into an industrial dynasty. A mechanical prodigy at MIT by fifteen and CEO by twenty-two, he rescued Stark Industries and became a famously reckless playboy-arms dealer.

Wounded in a battlefield cave, he built the first micro-arc reactor to power his shrapnel heart and forged the Mark I armor to escape. Reborn as Iron Man, he turned a weapon franchise into the vehicle of his own redemption.

His story is a war within himself: Armor Wars, the Civil War leadership of the registration side against Cap, and several near-deaths — Extremis rewiring his body, and the R.T. node linking his mind to every suit.
No biological superpowers — his assets are genius intellect, immense fortune and stubborn self-repair; his flaws are the same: alcohol, pride, and deciding wrong things for right reasons.
In current continuity he keeps returning from apotheosis, mutilation and rebirth — still the mortal genius standing at the edge of technology and conscience.

desc.zh: 托尼的助理、伴侣与继任 CEO，救援战甲的驾驶者。
desc.en: Stark's partner and CEO; once donned the Rescue armor.

props.actor: 格温妮丝·帕特洛 Gwyneth Paltrow

zh: 佩珀·波茨是托尼·斯塔克的助理、挚爱、妻子与最稳的锚：从打理斯塔克企业到成为「救救援」战甲的驾驶者。
《终局之战》中她穿上救援战甲参战；托尼牺牲后，她带着女儿摩根继续生活，守住他留下的世界。
佩珀把斯塔克工业从军火巨头改造成清洁能源先锋，商业头脑与温柔意志是她不穿战甲时的超能力。
救援战甲在终局之战登场，她用行动回应托尼半生的守护——这一次，换她挡在他身前。
en: Pepper Potts, Tony Stark\'s assistant and eventual wife, ran his company and piloted the Rescue armor.
She suits up for Endgame\'s final battle and carries on with daughter Morgan after Tony\'s sacrifice.
Pepper pivots Stark Industries from weapons to clean energy — business acumen and steady warmth her powers without the armor.
Rescue armor joins Endgame's battle — after Tony's lifetime of guarding her, she shields him in turn.

desc.zh: 空军中校出身的钢铁侠挚友，军方正统版装甲英雄。
desc.en: Air Force colonel in heavy armor; Tony's steadiest friend.

props.actor: 唐·钱德尔 Don Cheadle

zh: 詹姆斯·罗兹是托尼·斯塔克的挚友与空军上校：穿起战争机器战甲，成为复仇者的重火力担当。
《复联4》后他参与了《秘密入侵》《装甲战争》前的铺垫，是MCU军旅英雄的代表。
罗迪是托尼之外第一个穿上美制战甲的军人，战争机器把‘忠诚与火力’同时带进复仇者。
从《钢铁侠》到《秘密入侵》，他始终是军人与英雄之间的桥梁，也是 MCU 最稳的副手角色。
en: James Rhodes, Tony\'s best friend and an Air Force colonel, flies the War Machine armor as the Avengers\' heavy firepower.
From Endgame to Secret Invasion he carries on — the MCU\'s soldier-hero anchor.
First soldier after Tony in an American suit, War Machine brings loyalty and firepower to the Avengers.
Iron Man to Secret Invasion, he bridges soldier and hero — the MCU's steadiest second.

desc.zh: 前拳击手出身的托尼保镖，抚育蜘蛛侠的憨直管家。
desc.en: Bodyguard turned Peter's gruff guardian.

props.actor: 乔恩·法夫洛 Jon Favreau

zh: 哈皮·霍根是托尼·斯塔克的司机、保镖与挚友：从钢铁侠系列到蜘蛛侠系列始终如一的暖心绿叶。
他代理斯塔克工业、照看彼得·帕克，在《英雄无归》中与梅婶发展出情愫，也见证了她的离去。
哈皮从拳击手到斯塔克的保镖，忠诚与笨拙的平衡让他成为 MCU 最可靠的‘后勤英雄’。
他与梅婶在《英雄无归》前的情愫，以及葬礼上的克制，让这位喜剧角色也有了催泪的时刻。
en: Happy Hogan, Tony Stark\'s driver, bodyguard, and friend, warms every Iron Man and Spider-Man film he touches.
He looks after Peter and falls for May Parker — and mourns her in No Way Home.
Boxer turned Stark's bodyguard, Happy balances loyalty and clumsiness as the MCU's most dependable support.
His romance with May and restraint at her funeral give the comic figure genuinely moving beats.

name.zh: 奥比戴亚·斯坦 铁霸王

desc.zh: 托尼的商场教父，为夺战甲不惜弑主。
desc.en: Tony's father-figure who built his own suit to kill him.

props.actor: 杰夫·布里吉斯 Jeff Bridges

zh: 奥比戴亚·斯坦是托尼·斯塔克的商业导师与斯坦工业的掌舵人，暗中却与恐怖组织勾结倒卖武器。
《钢铁侠1》中他夺取方舟反应堆技术打造铁霸王战甲，最终被托尼与佩珀联手击败，坠入反应堆核心而亡。
斯坦是托尼的‘镜像导师’：同样的天才与野心，却选择用别人的技术成就自己的帝国。
铁霸王之战宣告钢铁侠系列的真正主题：英雄不是穿上战甲的人，而是选择为何而战的人。
en: Obadiah Stane, Tony Stark\'s mentor and Stark Industries\' acting head, secretly armed terrorists for profit.
He builds the Iron Monger suit in Iron Man, and falls into his own reactor core when Tony and Pepper fight back.
Stane is Tony's mirror mentor — same genius and ambition, choosing to build an empire on another's tech.
The Iron Monger duel sets Iron Man's theme — a hero isn't the suit, but the choice behind it.

desc.zh: 绝境病毒之父，满大人面具背后的复仇商人。
desc.en: Extremis creator behind the fake Mandarin.

props.actor: 盖·皮尔斯 Guy Pearce

zh: 奥尔德里奇·基里安是A.I.M.科学家与绝境病毒的创造者，曾被托尼·斯塔克放鸽子而在天台苦等，这份羞辱成了他复仇的起点。
《钢铁侠3》中他绑架小辣椒、制造满大人骗局，最终被托尼以绝境病毒反制，死在自己的造物手中。
绝境病毒能让断肢再生、人体自燃，是‘生物增强’的失控样本——他本人正是第一个把野心烧进基因的人。
他的‘满大人’骗局让恐怖主义变成商机，也点破托尼的傲慢：被你忽视的小人物，终会用你的技术反噬你。
en: Aldrich Killian, A.I.M. scientist and creator of Extremis, was once stood up on a rooftop by Tony Stark — the slight that fueled his revenge.
In Iron Man 3 he fakes the Mandarin and takes Pepper hostage, undone by his own Extremis tech.
Extremis regenerates limbs and ignites bodies — enhancement run amok, and Killian the first to burn ambition into his genes.
His fake Mandarin turns terrorism into business — and indicts Tony's arrogance: the little man you ignored returns with your own tech.

desc.zh: 独眼神盾局长，复仇者倡议的发起人，秘密入侵的老兵。
desc.en: The one-eyed director who initiated the Avengers Initiative.

props.actor: 塞缪尔·杰克逊 Samuel L. Jackson

zh: 尼古拉斯·约瑟夫·“尼克”·弗瑞，出生于大萧条时期的纽约，兄妹三人中的长子；二战岁月里，他在荷兰秘密行动中崭露头角，随“约书亚”的使命进入美军的血与火。
战后他执掌神盾局：从“秘密兵团”时代的特工网到雷神与复仇者时代的超级主管，他的单人杀手锏是“一只眼睛”——那个独眼已经成了漫威世界最著名的情报之眼。
他创办了“复仇者计划”，在九头蛇的暗影里守护世界，并在“秘密入侵”与“内战”中被认为是和平与偏执的橡皮筋——直至成为“宇宙之眼”与“无名者”。
能力：注入“无尽公式”带来的延缓衰老，加最顶级的老兵格斗、情报与指挥术；弱点是对一切抱有“绝不动摇的怀疑”——这既是世界之盾，也是他的迷雾。
现代叙事中，他仍然游走于“可见与不可见”宇宙的交叉点：死而复生、败而不亡，神盾局的颜色与黑寡妇的誓言，至今仍以他的名字为注解。
en: Nicholas Joseph "Nick" Fury, eldest of three raised in Depression-era New York, caught the eye of Lt. Sam Sawyer in a secret Holland operation and soldiered through the war and its aftermath.
Post-war he became S.H.I.E.L.D.'s father-supreme: architect of the intelligence-grid, the eye that has seen every crisis from the Howling Commandos to the Avengers.
Author of the Avengers Initiative, enemy of HYDRA, and in the endless wars the one who kept the world paranoid enough to survive; he also became the cosmic "Unseen" between realities.
The Infinity Formula slowed his aging; his craft is combat, intelligence, and absolute command; his flaw is total suspicion — the world's greatest shield and his own fog.
Through deaths and resurrections he keeps the balance of veils and vaults — the name behind S.H.I.E.L.D.'s code and the Black Widow's oath.

desc.zh: 神盾副局长，弗瑞最信任的副手。
desc.en: Fury's deputy at S.H.I.E.L.D.

props.actor: 寇碧·史莫德斯 Cobie Smulders

zh: 玛丽亚·希尔是神盾局的副局长：冷静高效的特工精英，尼克·弗瑞最信任的副手。
她在《复联4》后继续参与弗瑞的隐秘行动，于《秘密入侵》中被斯克鲁人冒充的弗瑞处决，悲壮退场。
希尔是弗瑞最锋利的执行者：冷静、高效、随时准备接手任何烂摊子。
她的猝然离世让《秘密入侵》的背叛主题有了实体重量，也让观众怀念那个‘靠谱的副局长’。
en: Maria Hill, S.H.I.E.L.D.\'s deputy director, is the cool, efficient agent Nick Fury trusts most.
She dies in Secret Invasion — shot by a Skrull posing as Fury.
Hill is Fury's sharpest operative — cool, efficient, ever ready for the next disaster.
Her abrupt death gives Secret Invasion's betrayal tangible weight — audiences mourn the reliable deputy.

desc.zh: 弗瑞的亲信干员，以美国队长收藏家闻名；死亡促成复联集结。
desc.en: Fury's aide whose death united the Avengers.

props.actor: 克拉克·格雷格 Clark Gregg

zh: 菲尔·科尔森是神盾局的王牌特工，以微笑与亲和力闻名，负责复仇者计划的日常联络。
《复联1》中他战死激励了复仇者集结，之后却在地球-199999的剧集线中奇迹归来，领导自己的特工团队对抗九头蛇等威胁。
他的过人之处在‘共情’：能记住每个特工的名字与咖啡口味，用真诚把松散团队变成家人——这正是神盾局最稀缺的武器。
从《复联1》的牺牲到神盾局特工的数季征途，科尔森证明：一个小人物也能成为整个宇宙故事的粘合剂。
en: Phil Coulson, S.H.I.E.L.D.\'s best agent, handles the Avengers with a warm smile and a sharp suit.
His death unites the Avengers in The Avengers — only for him to return in the TV series and lead his own team against HYDRA.
His superpower is empathy — names, coffee orders, sincerity that turns loose teams into family: S.H.I.E.L.D.'s rarest weapon.
From The Avengers' sacrifice to seven seasons of his own, Coulson proves a ‘small’ man can glue a universe together.

desc.zh: 瘦弱青年注射血清成为超级士兵；五十年冰封后归来，以盾牌扛起道义，最终回到过去与佩珀共舞。
desc.en: The super soldier from WWII who returned to dance with Peggy.

props.actor: 克里斯·埃文斯 Chris Evans

zh: 史蒂夫·罗杰斯
美队
美国队长 史蒂夫·罗杰斯
en: Steve Rogers
Cap
Captain America / Steve Rogers

zh: 史蒂文"史蒂夫"·罗杰斯 1922 年 9 月 28 日生于纽约，出身贫穷的爱尔兰移民家庭，在大萧条时期的布鲁克林长大。瘦弱多病的他，因纳粹在欧陆的暴行与亚洲的战火，五次报名从军被拒——直到政府让他成为"可憎小兵"的宣传画，却也把他送进了厄斯金博士的秘密实验室。
注射超级士兵血清并接受维塔射线后，他拥有了巅峰人力的体魄；随后他身着星条战衣横扫欧陆，成为传奇的"美国队长"。1945 年，在一次拯救数千战俘的迫降事故中坠入冰海，沉睡了将近六十年。
在复仇者时代苏醒后，他成为"时间错位者"：带着老式价值面对后现代的世道，先后经历五次内战的撕裂、克隆与秘密入侵的迷雾，并在近代主线里与政府、正义和"美国"本身的定义不断缠斗。
能力为血清强化的巅峰体魄：迅捷、耐力、极限连跳，加上数十年的白刃格斗与战术带领。他的弱点与伟大同源——无论社会如何变化，他只会选择"做对的事"。
年迈远征之后，他一度卸下盾牌、在山姆·威尔逊之后重返队长之位——近年主线里他是未来线与现代线之间横穿的老兵，仍然"凡人之躯，比肩神明"。
en: Steven "Steve" Rogers was born in 1922 to poor Irish immigrants in lower Manhattan, a frail youth through the Depression. Horrified by fascist atrocities, he tried to enlist and was rejected five times — until he became Dr. Erskine's experiment.

The Super-Soldier Serum and Vita-rays gave him a body at the human peak; as the star-spangled Captain America he tore through Europe — until 1945, when he crashed into the Arctic in a last-ditch rescue and slept for decades.
Awakening among the Avengers as a man out of time, he has carried vintage morality through modern cynicism — the Civil Wars, the Secret Invasion, and every battle about what "America" should mean.
Peak-human strength, speed and agility, decades of combat mastery, and unshakeable tactics; his flaw and his greatness are the same thing: he will always do what is right, whatever the world says.
After aging and handing over the shield, he returned to the mantle in present continuity — a soldier still crossing timelines, still the proof that ordinary man can stand beside gods.

desc.zh: 二战战略科学储备局特工、史蒂夫的爱人，神盾创始者之一。
desc.en: SSR agent, Steve's love, and a S.H.I.E.L.D. founder.

props.actor: 海莉·阿特维尔 Hayley Atwell

zh: 佩吉·卡特是二战时期战略科学预备队的特工，曾与史蒂夫·罗杰斯相爱。战后她参与组建神盾局，成为情报界的传奇。
她在《美队1》中痛失坠机的史蒂夫，多年后在《美队2》中与之重逢；卡特探员剧集则讲述她战后独立办案的岁月，另有美国队长卡特的全新变体。
她枪械、格斗与情报全能，是 SSR 最出色的外勤特工——在女性被轻视的年代，靠专业赢得所有人的尊重。
从剧集《特工卡特》到多元宇宙中的美国队长卡特，她证明‘盾牌属于能扛起它的人’，成为 MCU 女性英雄的先行者。
en: Peggy Carter, an SSR agent in WWII and Steve Rogers\' love, went on to help found S.H.I.E.L.D. as a legendary intelligence figure.
She loses Steve to the ice in The First Avenger, reunites decades later, and stars in Agent Carter — with an alternate Captain Carter variant across the multiverse.
Guns, hand-to-hand, and espionage — she was the SSR's finest field agent, earning respect on merit in an era that underestimated women.
From Agent Carter to Captain Carter across the multiverse, she proved the shield belongs to whoever carries it — a pioneer of MCU heroines.

desc.zh: 史蒂夫挚友坠崖后被九头蛇改造为冷血刺客，漫长赎罪后执掌新盾。
desc.en: Steve's best friend turned brainwashed assassin; now the new Cap.

props.actor: 塞巴斯蒂安·斯坦 Sebastian Stan

zh: 巴基
冬日战士
en: Bucky
White Wolf

zh: 巴基·巴恩斯是史蒂夫·罗杰斯的童年挚友，二战时期与美队并肩作战的咆哮突击队成员。他在追捕泽莫时坠入冰谷，被九头蛇捞起洗脑成冬兵。
作为冷血刺客冬兵服役数十年后，他在《美队2》《美队3》中挣扎于自我控制，终在瓦坎达被苏睿治愈，随后成为新美队山姆·威尔逊的搭档。
九头蛇的冬兵计划为他装上振金机械臂，配合百年训练，他既是顶级刺客也始终在与记忆创伤搏斗。
他的救赎线是美队故事的情感地基：从被利用的武器，到被苏睿治愈，再到山姆·威尔逊接过盾牌时的搭档。
en: Bucky Barnes, Steve Rogers\' lifelong friend, fought beside Captain America in WWII until a fall into a ravine left him in HYDRA hands — remade as the Winter Soldier.
Decades as a brainwashed assassin ended when Shuri cured him in Wakanda; he now fights beside the new Captain America, Sam Wilson.
HYDRA gave him a vibranium arm and a century of conditioning — the deadliest of assassins, forever fighting his own memory.
His redemption anchors the Captain America saga — from weapon, to healed man in Wakanda, to the Falcon's partner under the new shield.

desc.zh: 退伍空降救援兵出身猎鹰，终接盾成为新一代美国队长。
desc.en: Falcon who earned the shield and became Captain America.

props.actor: 安东尼·麦凯 Anthony Mackie

zh: 山姆·威尔逊是「猎鹰」：空军退役的无人机专家，以振金翼装飞行作战，也是史蒂夫·罗杰斯指定的接班人。
《猎鹰与冬兵》后他正式接过盾牌成为新一代美国队长，在《美队4》中以自己的方式定义这个名号。
山姆的振金翼装与红翼无人机让他成为空战大师，而他的真正特长是共情：他总能看到人的另一面。
接过盾牌后他用对话而非拳头解决冲突，《美队4》让‘美国队长’终于学会与自己的国家对话。
en: Sam Wilson, the Falcon, is a retired Air Force pararescueman flying on EXO-7 wings — and Steve Rogers\' chosen successor.
Accepting the shield in The Falcon and the Winter Soldier, he redefines Captain America on his own terms in Brave New World.
Vibranium wings and Redwing make Sam an air master; his true skill is empathy — seeing the person in everyone.
Shield in hand he favors dialogue over fists — Brave New World letting Captain America finally talk to his country.

desc.zh: 佩吉侄女、双面特工，黑市"力量掮客"。
desc.en: Peggy's niece turned power broker.

props.actor: 艾米莉·万凯普 Emily VanCamp

zh: 莎伦·卡特是佩吉·卡特的侄女：神盾局特工，曾以护士身份掩护美国队长并与之相爱。
《美队3》后她被通缉流亡，《猎鹰与冬兵》中以「权力掮客」身份操控马德里坡，灰色立场令人生畏。
莎伦继承了姑姑佩吉的特工基因，冷静、专业，能为了任务潜入最危险的黑暗。
《猎鹰与冬兵》里她以‘权力掮客’身份掌管马德里坡，从体制英雄走向灰色地带，是 MCU 最耐人寻味的转身。
en: Sharon Carter, Peggy\'s niece and S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, loved Steve Rogers while nursing him undercover.
Wanted after Civil War, she resurfaces in The Falcon and the Winter Soldier as the Power Broker of Madripoor.
Sharon inherits Aunt Peggy's agent DNA — cool, professional, willing to dive into the darkest covers.
As the Power Broker of Madripoor she trades institutional heroism for the gray — the MCU's most intriguing pivot.

desc.zh: 从追捕浩克的上将到美国总统，最终自身成为红色浩克。
desc.en: Hulk hunter turned President — and Red Hulk.

props.actor: 威廉·赫特→哈里森·福特 William Hurt / Harrison Ford

zh: 撒迪厄斯·罗斯是美国陆军上将：毕生追捕绿巨人，人称「雷霆」罗斯，主导了超级士兵与布鲁斯·班纳的恩怨。
《美队3》后他升任国务卿推动索科维亚协议；《美队4》中他以红浩克之姿失控于白宫之战，最终被捕。
罗斯将军一生追捕绿巨人，把‘班纳威胁’当成毕生事业，其偏执与军人荣誉感同样强烈。
《美队4》里他以红浩克之姿失控于白宫，把半生的怒火烧成了自己最想消灭的怪物。
en: Thaddeus "Thunderbolt" Ross, the U.S. general who hunted the Hulk for decades, oversaw the super-soldier program.
Secretary of State after Civil War, he becomes the Red Hulk in Brave New World — and is finally taken down.
General Ross hunts the Hulk as life's mission — obsession and soldier's honor burning equally hot.
Brave New World turns him into the Red Hulk rampaging at the White House — fury becoming the monster he hunted.

desc.zh: 血清副作用下的九头蛇元首，被空间宝石放逐为灵魂宝石看守者。
desc.en: Hydra's first son, exiled to guard the Soul Stone.

props.actor: 雨果·维文 Hugo Weaving

zh: 约翰·施密特是红骷髅：纳粹科学部首领，因未完成版血清而面容尽毁，却因此获得不死之身与九头蛇的创立。
他是美队的宿敌；《复联3》中他以灵魂宝石看守者身份再现，指引灭霸完成以爱换石的献祭。
红骷髅的失败源于傲慢：他追求‘完美人类’，却把自己烧成了最不完美的怪物。
《复联3》里他以灵魂宝石看守者的面目再现，用最平静的语气说出最残酷的规则。
en: Johann Schmidt, the Red Skull, led Nazi science and HYDRA — his flawed serum burned his face but made him ageless.
Captain America\'s nemesis, he reappears in Infinity War as the Soul Stone\'s keeper.
Red Skull's fall is pride — chasing the perfect human, he scorched himself into the least perfect monster.
As the Soul Stone's keeper in Infinity War, he speaks the cruelest rules in the calmest voice.

desc.zh: 索科维亚丧亲者，以离间撕裂复仇者的战术家。
desc.en: Sokovian father who broke the Avengers with words, not fists.

props.actor: 丹尼尔·布鲁赫 Daniel Brühl

zh: 赫尔穆特·泽莫是《美队3》的泽莫男爵：索科维亚人，因复仇者之战失去全家，以缜密算计离间复仇者。
《猎鹰与冬兵》中他越狱再度登场，亦正亦邪地协助猎鹰，是MCU最优雅也最危险的凡人反派。
泽莫没有超能力，却以平民之身拆散了复仇者——他的武器是情报、耐心与对英雄弱点的洞察。
从《美队3》的复仇者到《猎鹰与冬兵》的灰色盟友，他始终是 MCU 里‘最可怕的普通人’。
en: Helmut Zemo lost his family to the Sokovia battle and avenged them by splitting the Avengers apart in Civil War.
Escaping prison in The Falcon and the Winter Soldier, he plays ally and schemer in equal measure.
Zemo needs no powers — a civilian who broke the Avengers with intel, patience, and knowing heroes' weaknesses.
Civil War's saboteur to Falcon and Winter Soldier's gray ally, he stays the MCU's most dangerous ordinary man.

desc.zh: 被政府抹去的黑人超级士兵，活历史伤疤。
desc.en: The erased Black super soldier.

props.actor: 卡尔·卢普利 Carl Lumbly

zh: 以赛亚·布拉德利是《美队3》中揭露的悲剧英雄：上世纪参加过超级士兵实验的黑人士兵，战功被抹去，遭囚禁实验三十年。
他以自身经历提醒山姆·威尔逊：美国队长之名背负着未曾偿还的种族历史。
以赛亚的战绩被抹去、身体被实验，他用一生揭露超级士兵计划的种族伤痕，是漫威最沉痛的‘被遗忘的英雄’。
他把盾牌的重量交给山姆：不是荣誉，而是历史——美国队长必须直面自己未曾偿还的过去。
en: Isaiah Bradley, a Black soldier secretly given the super-soldier treatment decades ago, had his service erased — then was imprisoned and experimented on for thirty years.
His story forces Sam Wilson to confront the unrepayed racial history behind the Captain America name.
Erased from records, subjected to experiments, Isaiah exposes the serum program's racial wounds — Marvel's most searing forgotten hero.
He hands Sam the shield's true weight — not glory but history: Captain America must face his unpaid past.

desc.zh: 阿斯加德雷霆之子，从骄纵王子到独眼王者的漫长成长；风暴战斧的新主人。
desc.en: Odinson: from brash prince to one-eyed king with Stormbreaker.

props.actor: 克里斯·海姆斯沃斯 Chris Hemsworth

zh: 托尔
雷神 托尔
en: Odinson

zh: 托尔·奥丁森是九界之父奥丁与大地女神盖亚（乔德）之子，神族最强大王的血统与大地神性的双重继承者。他的诞生围绕诸神黄昏的古老循环，凡间流传着无数个版本的起源，而不变的是：他与被收养的弟弟洛基一起长大，八岁便被送入矮人国度督造雷神之锤与神族的宝物。
