zh: 基尔格雷夫是杰茜卡·琼斯的宿敌「紫人」：能随口下达命令操控任何人，包括夺走杰茜卡数月的自由。
《杰茜卡·琼斯》中他以「爱」之名行控制之实，最终被杰茜卡在公开场合逼到绝境后扭断脖颈。
基尔格雷夫的命令无人能违抗，他的‘能力’与‘欲望’同源：控制即存在，占有即爱。
杰茜卡对他的反抗是 MCU 关于创伤治愈最硬核的宣言：受害者的尊严，比施害者的忏悔更重要。
en: Kilgrave, the Purple Man, compels absolute obedience with a word — and stole months of Jessica Jones\' life.
In Jessica Jones his obsessive "love" ends when she snaps his neck, freed at last.
Kilgrave's word compels all — control his oxygen, possession his version of love.
Jessica's defiance is the MCU's hardest statement on recovery — a survivor's dignity outweighs an abuser's regret.

desc.zh: 以吸血鬼血清自救的生物化学家。
desc.en: The biochemist who cured himself into a vampire.

props.actor: 杰瑞德·莱托 Jared Leto

zh: 迈克尔·莫比亚斯是《莫比亚斯》中的活体吸血鬼：身患罕见血液病的诺奖科学家，为自救注射蝙蝠血清而变异。
他必须吸血维生却拒绝伤害无辜，在反英雄的灰色地带与猎人搏斗。
莫比亚斯是科学家与怪物的合体：吸血维生却拒绝滥杀，在医学与诅咒之间寻找平衡。
作为反英雄，他比多数‘英雄’更清楚自己的阴影，也因此在灰色地带格外挣扎。
en: Michael Morbius, the Living Vampire of his 2022 film, was a Nobel scientist with a rare blood disease — cured into a bat-like monster.
He feeds on blood yet refuses the innocent, hunting in the gray between hero and horror.
Morbius fuses scientist and monster — feeding on blood yet refusing murder, balancing cure and curse.
An antihero who knows his own shadow, he struggles hardest in the gray.

desc.zh: 能预见未来的救护员，SSU 的预言者。
desc.en: The paramedic who sees the future.

props.actor: 达科塔·约翰逊 Dakota Johnson

zh: 卡桑德拉·韦伯是《蜘蛛夫人》中的盲眼通灵者：患有重症肌无力却能看到未来，预知三位蜘蛛女的命运。
电影中她以「蜘蛛夫人」之名引导朱莉娅等三位少女避开灭杀者的追杀，是蜘蛛侠宇宙的守护织网者。
卡桑德拉的通灵让她看见无数未来分支，重症肌无力却让她难以改变其中任何一个。
她以‘蜘蛛夫人’之名织起三位少女的命运线，是蜘蛛侠宇宙里少见的‘先知导师’。
en: Cassandra Webb of Madame Web is a blind clairvoyant with myasthenia gravis — seeing futures she can barely change.
She guides Julia and two other spider-women past the killer Ezekiel in the 2024 film.
Cassandra's clairvoyance sees countless futures; myasthenia gravis leaves her little power to change them.
Weaving the three spider-women's fates as Madame Web, she stands the spider-verse's rare prophet-mentor.

desc.zh: SSU 宇宙的毒液与埃迪共生体组合。
desc.en: The SSU Eddie-and-Venom duo.

props.actor: 汤姆·哈迪 Tom Hardy
props.occupation: 调查记者 / 毒液宿主

zh: 埃迪·布洛克是索尼蜘蛛侠宇宙的记者，与被贬斥的共生体毒液结合，成为亦正亦邪的致命守护者。
在《毒液》两部曲中他逐步与毒液磨合共生；《毒液3》结尾他通过多元裂缝短暂瞥见蜘蛛侠宇宙，随后归于自己的世界。
共生体赋予他拟态触手、超强再生与‘致命守护者’的暴力美学，两人的争吵日常则承包了全片的笑点与泪点。
从《毒液》到《最后一舞》，埃迪与毒液的关系是漫威银幕上最动人的‘双向奔赴’：一个需要力量，一个需要被需要。
en: Eddie Brock of Sony\'s Spider-Man Universe is an investigative journalist bonded to the symbiote Venom — an antihero with lethal appetites.
Through two films he and Venom learn to coexist; Venom: The Last Dance ends with a multiversal glimpse of Spider-Man\'s world.
The symbiote grants tendrils, regeneration, and lethal-protector violence — their bickering the film's comedy and its heart.
Across three films, Eddie and Venom share the screen's most moving mutual rescue — one needs power, the other needs to matter.

desc.zh: 游戏宇宙的成熟彼得，与迈尔斯并肩守卫纽约。
desc.en: The seasoned game-universe Peter.

props.actor: 尤里·洛文索 Yuri Lowenthal

zh: 彼得·帕克（Insomniac游戏宇宙）是蜘蛛侠系列的绝对主角：天才少年被变异蜘蛛咬伤，在梅婶与本叔的陪伴下成为纽约的英雄。
游戏三部曲中他历经反派入侵、共生体附身与挚友之死，最终在《蜘蛛侠2》结局隐退，将城市托付给迈尔斯。
游戏中的他身兼发明家与导师：蛛网装置不断迭代，还把经验倾囊传给迈尔斯，是纽约‘最有责任感的成年人’。
从共生体附身到挚友之死，Insomniac 版彼得经历了最私密的痛苦，也让‘能力越大责任越大’第一次有了可玩的重量。
en: Peter Parker of the Insomniac universe stars across the Spider-Man games — a gifted teen bitten by a modified spider, raised by May and Ben.
Through three titles he endures invasions, the symbiote, and his best friend\'s death — retiring at last to pass the mantle to Miles.
Across the games he is inventor and mentor — webs ever-upgraded, wisdom passed to Miles: New York's most responsible adult.
From the symbiote to his best friend's death, this Peter endures intimate grief — making the great-responsibility motto playable.

name.zh: 蜘蛛侠 迈尔斯 (Insomniac 版)

desc.zh: 游戏宇宙的迈尔斯，毒刺与隐身的纽约新守护者。
desc.en: The game-universe Miles guarding Harlem.

props.debut: 蜘蛛侠：迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯 (2020)
props.actor: 纳杰·杰特 Nadji Jeter

zh: 迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯是Insomniac游戏宇宙的第二代蜘蛛侠，能力来自变异蜘蛛的咬伤，拥有隐形与生物电击等独特技能。
他继承去世的彼得·帕克之志，独自守护纽约，并试图平衡学生、家庭与超级英雄三重新身份。
隐形、生物电击与毒液冲击是他的独门三件套，配合青少年的街舞式身法，他的战斗比任何蜘蛛侠都更具即兴感。
接过离世彼得的衣钵后，他同时扛起学生、儿子与纽约守护者三副担子，证明‘任何人’都能戴上那顶兜帽。
en: Miles Morales is the second Spider-Man of the Insomniac game universe, bitten by an experimental spider with camouflage and bio-electric venom.
Carrying the fallen Peter Parker\'s will, he protects New York alone while balancing school, family, and heroism.
Camouflage, bio-electricity, and venom blasts set him apart — his breakdance-influenced style the most improvisational of any Spider-Man.
Carrying the fallen Peter's legacy, he balances student, son, and city-savior — proof anyone can wear the mask.

desc.zh: 漫威 1602 极简宇宙的克里崇拜者皮特。
desc.en: The 1602 reality's Peter Parquagh.

zh: 彼得·帕克（1602宇宙）是尼尔·盖曼《漫威1602》中的蜘蛛侠：伊丽莎白时代宫廷中的少年侍从。
在被奇异博士「魔法」辐射的世界里，他被一只来自未来的蜘蛛咬伤，成为都铎王朝的墙上爬行者。
1602 宇宙的彼得在伊丽莎白宫廷中被未来之蛛咬伤，成为都铎时代的爬墙者。
盖曼笔下的他让‘蜘蛛侠’褪去现代科技，回归最朴素的英雄本义。
en: Peter Parker of Earth-1602, Neil Gaiman\'s Marvel 1602, is a page in Elizabethan court — bitten by a spider from the future.
In a world of Tudor intrigue he becomes that era\'s wall-crawler.
Earth-1602's Peter, bitten by a future spider in Elizabethan court, becomes that era's wall-crawler.
Gaiman's take strips Spider-Man of modern tech — back to heroism's bare essentials.

desc.zh: 驾驶 SP//dr 机甲的日本少女蜘蛛侠。
desc.en: The girl piloting the SP//dr mech.

zh: 佩妮·帕克是《蜘蛛侠：平行宇宙》中的机娘蜘蛛侠：来自未来东京，与父亲留下的机甲SP//dr神经相连。
她与机甲并肩作战，是蜘蛛军团中最具科幻感的成员。
佩妮与机甲 SP//dr 神经相连，人机一体让她既是驾驶员也是机甲本身。
《平行宇宙》中她的机械蜘蛛让蜘蛛军团拥有动漫维度，也延续了‘帕克家女孩也能继承’的主题。
en: Peni Parker of Spider-Verse is Tokyo\'s mecha Spider — neurally linked to SP//dr, her father\'s robot.
Fighting inside the machine, she brings anime flair to the Spider-Society.
Peni links neurally with the SP//dr armor — pilot and machine, one being.
Her mecha spider adds an anime dimension to the Society — proof Parker women inherit too.

desc.zh: 大萧条时代的黑白义警。
desc.en: The black-and-white vigilante of the Depression.

zh: 暗影蜘蛛侠是《蜘蛛侠：平行宇宙》中的黑白侦探版彼得·帕克：1933年大萧条纽约的黑帮克星。
他冷酷寡言、以枪与影作战，是蜘蛛军团中最「黑色电影」的存在。
暗影蜘蛛侠以大萧条纽约为战场，黑风衣与左轮让他的‘蜘蛛’染上黑色电影的血色。
《平行宇宙》中他与主流蜘蛛侠的冷热反差，让‘同一个名字的无数可能’变得具体。
en: Spider-Man Noir is the black-and-white, trench-coated Peter Parker of 1933 — gunning down mobsters in Depression-era New York.
Cold and cinematic, he is the Spider-Society\'s most hard-boiled member.
Noir Spider fights Depression-era New York in trench coat and revolver — a spider dipped in noir blood.
Alongside brighter Spiders in the film, his chill contrast makes infinite variants tangible.

desc.zh: 迈尔斯的叔叔，徘徊者。
desc.en: Miles's uncle, the Prowler.

zh: 亚伦·戴维斯（1610终极宇宙）是徘徊者：迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯的叔叔，终极宇宙的盗贼与雇佣兵。
他对迈尔斯亦敌亦亲，其悲剧结局深刻影响迈尔斯的英雄之路。
亚伦·戴维斯徘徊在犯罪与亲情之间，其‘想保护侄子却选错路’的挣扎贯穿终极宇宙的蜘蛛侠故事。
他的牺牲让迈尔斯明白：英雄不是血缘决定的，而是选择决定的。
en: Aaron Davis of the Ultimate universe is the Prowler — Miles Morales\' uncle, thief, and reluctant mentor.
His arc of crime and family tragedy shapes Miles into the hero he becomes.
Aaron Davis walks crime and family lines — wanting to shield his nephew yet choosing wrong, threading Ultimate Spider-Man's tale.
His death teaches Miles that heroism isn't blood — it's choice.

desc.zh: 迈尔斯的父亲，纽约警员。
desc.en: Miles's father, an NYPD officer.

zh: 杰斐逊·戴维斯是《蜘蛛侠：平行宇宙》中迈尔斯的父亲：纽约警探，正直却对儿子的「秘密活动」一无所知。
他对迈尔斯「让世界变好」的期待成为整部电影的题眼，也是迈尔斯每次挺身而出的理由。
杰斐逊警探代表了迈尔斯想守护的‘普通人生活’：正直、忙碌，对自己的儿子一无所知却无比骄傲。
他的那句‘让世界变得更好’成为《平行宇宙》的题眼，也是迈尔斯每次戴上兜帽的理由。
en: Jefferson Davis, Miles\' father in Into the Spider-Verse, is a straight-arrow NYPD detective unaware of his son\'s double life.
His wish that Miles "make the world better" is the film\'s heart — and Miles\' reason to stand up.
Detective Jefferson embodies the ordinary life Miles protects — upright, busy, clueless about his son yet endlessly proud.
His wish to make the world better is Into the Spider-Verse's thesis — Miles' reason for every swing.

desc.zh: 弗瑞倡议下的地球最强英雄联盟，历经解散、内战与响指，仍是宇宙第一道防线。
desc.en: Earth's mightiest heroes: disbanded, split, snapped — still the first line of defense.

zh: 复仇者联盟是漫威宇宙最核心的英雄团队，1963 年《复仇者》创刊由斯坦·李与杰克·科比创立：钢铁侠、雷神、浩克、蚁人与黄蜂女的"地球上最强大的英雄"。
队伍阵容随时代更迭：美国队长解冻后成为核心，黑寡妇、鹰眼、绯红女巫、幻视、黑豹、惊奇队长等相继加入；MCU 自 2012 年电影起成为流行文化现象。
团队象征"团结即力量"：成员背景天差地别（神、科学家、特工、变种人），却为守护地球并肩作战——也是内战等冲突的舞台。
终局之战后复仇者进入新纪元（MCU 第四至六阶段重组），漫画线中始终是漫威英雄谱系的轴心。
en: The Avengers, Marvel's central hero team, debuted in 1963 by Lee and Kirby: Iron Man, Thor, Hulk, Ant-Man and the Wasp — "Earth's Mightiest Heroes."
The roster evolved through the ages — Captain America, Black Widow, Hawkeye, Scarlet Witch, Vision, Black Panther, Captain Marvel; the MCU made it a pop-culture phenomenon from 2012.
The team is unity in diversity: gods, scientists, spies and mutants fighting side by side for Earth — and the stage of Civil War's rifts.
After Endgame the Avengers enter a new MCU era; in comics they remain the axis of the hero mythos.

desc.zh: 由乌合之众组成的星际雇佣团队，现为正式英雄组织"宇宙的守护者"。
desc.en: Misfits turned cosmic protectors.

zh: 银河护卫队是漫威的宇宙英雄团队，2008 年现代版《银河护卫队》由丹·阿布内特与安迪·兰宁重塑：星爵领衔的"宇宙浪子"组合。
经典阵容：星爵、卡魔拉、毁灭者德拉克斯、火箭浣熊与格鲁特；MCU 电影（2014 起）将其推向全球。
团队象征"废柴的逆袭"：一群各怀创伤的边缘人，以"家人"之名守护宇宙——漫威最有人情味的团队。
《银护3》后老班底暂别、火箭接任队长，新"宇宙复仇者"阵容延续传奇。
en: The Guardians of the Galaxy, Marvel's cosmic crew, were modernized in 2008 by Abnett and Lanning: Star-Lord's band of space misfits.
The classic roster: Star-Lord, Gamora, Drax, Rocket and Groot; the MCU films (2014+) made them worldwide icons.
The team is misfits redeemed: wounded outcasts who call themselves family while saving the cosmos.
After Vol. 3, Rocket leads a new generation — the cosmic legend continues.

desc.zh: 战略威胁干预与执法局，弗瑞的情报与超自然防线，内战后体制重组。
desc.en: Strategic Hazard Intervention Espionage Logistics Directorate.

founder.zh: 佩吉·卡特 / 菲尔·科尔森

zh: 神盾局（S.H.I.E.L.D.）是漫威世界的顶级情报与维和组织：1965 年由斯坦·李与杰克·科比创建，全称"战略国土干预、执法与后勤局"。
尼克·弗瑞长期执掌神盾局，吸纳黑寡妇、鹰眼等特工；MCU 中由科尔森、希尔等特工构成庞大体系。
组织象征"盾后的世界"：监视超人类、筹备复仇者计划、对抗九头蛇渗透——灰色地带的守护者。
《美国队长2》揭露九头蛇渗透后神盾局解体又重组，MCU 与漫画中始终是英雄体系的基础设施。
en: S.H.I.E.L.D., Marvel's premier intelligence agency, was created in 1965 by Lee and Kirby — the Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division.
Nick Fury long led it, fielding Black Widow and Hawkeye; the MCU built a vast agency around Coulson and Hill.
The agency is the world behind the shield: watching superhumans, seeding the Avengers, fighting HYDRA from within.
After Winter Soldier's HYDRA reveal it fell and rose again — infrastructure of the hero world.

desc.zh: 砍掉一个头长出两个头的千年秘密组织，渗透神盾与各国政府。
desc.en: Cut off one head, two more grow: the infiltrating octopus.

zh: 九头蛇是漫威最著名的反派组织：1941 年《美国队长》中纳粹的秘密科学分支，口号"砍掉一个头，再生出两个"。
红骷髅创立并长期主导，后由泽莫男爵、斯特拉克男爵等相继执掌；MCU 中深潜神盾局数十年。
组织象征"永恒的渗透"：科学改造、洗脑计划（冬兵）、极端秩序崇拜——英雄们最顽固的敌人。
MCU 中九头蛇随红骷髅的消亡与"九头蛇队长"变体仍存在于多元宇宙。
en: HYDRA, Marvel's most iconic villain organization, began as the Nazis' secret science arm in 1941 — "cut off a head, two more shall take its place."
Red Skull founded it, with Baron Zemo and Strucker among its leaders; the MCU had it infiltrate S.H.I.E.L.D. for decades.
The organization is eternal infiltration: super-science, the Winter Soldier program, order-worship — the heroes' most stubborn foe.
HYDRA persists in the MCU through variants and the multiverse.

desc.zh: 二战时期的盟军超科学部门，神盾局前身。
desc.en: The WWII precursor of S.H.I.E.L.D.

zh: 战略科学储备局（S.S.R.）是二战时期美国对超自然与尖端科技的军事机构，神盾局的前身。
卡特探员、飞利浦斯上校与嚎叫突击队在此运作，与九头蛇正面交锋；MCU《特工卡特》以其为舞台。
组织象征"时代的黎明"：超级士兵计划、方舟技术的摇篮——现代超人类世界的地基。
战后改组为神盾局，S.S.R. 的遗产贯穿整个 MCU 历史。
en: The Strategic Scientific Reserve was the WWII-era military agency for super-science — S.H.I.E.L.D.'s predecessor.
Agent Carter, Colonel Phillips and the Howling Commandos operated here against HYDRA; the MCU's Agent Carter series is set here.
The agency is the dawn of the superhuman age: cradle of the Super-Soldier program.
It became S.H.I.E.L.D. after the war — its legacy runs through MCU history.

desc.zh: 瓦伦蒂娜拼凑的前反派"新复仇者"，星号背后另有乾坤。
desc.en: Valentina's rebranded antiheroes — the asterisk hides a name.

founder.zh: 瓦伦蒂娜·阿莱格拉·德·方丹

zh: 雷霆特攻队是漫威"反派洗白"的招牌团队：1997 年由泽莫男爵组建，假扮英雄的超级罪犯团队。
历代阵容包括泽莫、月光石、模仿大师、红浩克、冬兵等；MCU 电影（2025）集结叶莲娜、巴基等反英雄。
团队象征"救赎的可能性"：罪犯换装成英雄，面具之下是真实或虚伪——漫威对英雄定义的灰色拷问。
漫画中雷霆特攻队多次改组（含政府监管版），MCU 版成为第五阶段收官之作。
en: The Thunderbolts, Marvel's signature reformed-villain team, debuted in 1997 under Baron Zemo — villains posing as heroes.
Rosters spanned Zemo, Moonstone, Taskmaster, Red Hulk, Winter Soldier; the 2025 MCU film unites Yelena, Bucky and more.
The team is redemption tested: villains in hero costumes, genuine or fake — Marvel's grey question on heroism.
The roster reshuffled many times; the MCU film closes Phase 5.

desc.zh: 灭霸的精英子女战团，收缴无限宝石的先锋。
desc.en: Thanos's elite children hunting the stones.

zh: 黑暗军团是灭霸的私人战队：2013 年《新复仇者》中登场，由黑曜五将组成——亡刃将军、暗夜比邻星、黑矮星、乌木喉与超巨星。
军团为灭霸收集无限宝石、屠戮文明；MCU《无限战争》中全员登场并相继战死。
组织象征"暴政的刀锋"：灭霸意志的延伸，每个成员都是星际级的毁灭者。
漫画中黑曜五将在灭霸死后仍以独立势力活动，MCU 版则随灭霸的响指而灭。
en: The Black Order, Thanos's elite, debuted in 2013: the Black Order generals — Corvus Glaive, Proxima Midnight, Cull Obsidian, Ebony Maw and Supergiant.
They collected the Infinity Stones and slaughtered worlds for Thanos; the MCU's Infinity War featured them all.
The Order is tyranny's blade: extensions of Thanos's will, each a cosmic destroyer.
The generals outlived Thanos in comics; the MCU snapped them away.

desc.zh: 文武麾下千年恐怖组织，横跨古今的军火与暗杀帝国。
desc.en: Wenwu's millennia-old army of terror.

zh: 十环帮是漫威电影宇宙的原创反派组织：以十枚魔法戒指为标志的千年恐怖集团，2021 年《尚气》正式登场。
文武（徐文武）是十环帮之主，尚气之父；MCU 揭示其历史贯穿千年。
组织象征"力量与传承"：武术、暗杀与全球地下网络——东方功夫片的暗面。
《尚气》后十环帮在 MCU 中改组，十环下落成为悬念。
en: The Ten Rings, the MCU's original villain organization, rose to prominence in Shang-Chi (2021), named for ten magical rings.
Wenwu is the Rings' master and Shang-Chi's father; the MCU revealed their millennial history.
The organization is power and legacy: martial arts, assassination, a global underworld — kung-fu's dark side.
After Shang-Chi the Ten Rings reorganize; the rings' fate is an MCU thread.

desc.zh: 裁剪分支时间线的官僚机构，遗留之人缔造的"秩序"机器。
desc.en: The bureaucracy pruning branches off the Sacred Timeline.

zh: 时间变异管理局（TVA）是 MCU《洛基》剧集中的时间警察机构：维护"神圣时间线"、审判时间犯的官僚化组织。
TVA 由"时间守护者"（后揭晓为遗留之人/征服者康的变体）管理；洛基与莫比乌斯在此展开时间冒险。
组织象征"秩序的暴政"：时间线修剪、记忆清除与无尽官僚——自由的代价。
《洛基》第二季后洛基成为时间之神，TVA 重组并直面多元宇宙的康之战争。
en: The Time Variance Authority, from the MCU's Loki series, polices the timeline — a bureaucracy judging time-criminals.
Run by the Time Keepers (revealed as He Who Remains), it hosted Loki and Mobius's adventures.
The TVA is order's tyranny: timeline pruning, memory wipes, endless bureaucracy — the cost of free will.
After Loki S2, Loki becomes the god of time; the TVA faces the Multiversal War.

desc.zh: 守护地球免受维度威胁的法师修行地，阿戈摩托与悬戒的传承处。
desc.en: The sorcerer order guarding Earth from dimensional threats.

zh: 卡玛泰姬是漫威魔法世界的中心：位于喜马拉雅山脉的秘法学院，教导地球的守护法师（奇异博士的师门）。
远古者（Ancient One）数世纪执掌，奇异博士、王、莫度男爵皆出于此；MCU 中由蒂尔达·斯文顿饰演的远古者引领。
组织象征"守护现实"：悬戒传送、镜像维度与圣殿网络——抵御维度入侵的第一道防线。
《奇异博士2》后王成为至尊法师，卡玛泰姬在多元宇宙危机中扩展。
en: Kamar-Taj, Marvel's mystic center, is the Himalayan school of sorcery training Earth's guardian mages.
The Ancient One led for centuries; Strange, Wong and Mordo trained here (Tilda Swinton in the MCU).
The school guards reality: sling rings, mirror dimensions, the Sanctums — first line against dimensional invasion.
Wong became Sorcerer Supreme after MoM; Kamar-Taj expands amid multiversal threats.

desc.zh: 星际盗贼联盟，尤度的糟糠船队。
desc.en: The outlaw space crews, Yondu's among them.

zh: 掠夺者是银河系的太空海盗联盟：由勇度·乌东塔领衔的"蓝色脸庞"赏金猎手团伙，星爵的养父家族。
MCU《银护》中勇度养大彼得·奎尔，终局之战中掠夺者舰队驰援复仇者。
组织象征"自由与义气"：星际走私、劫掠与荣誉准则——海盗也有原则。
《银护2》勇度牺牲后，掠夺者名号由克拉格林等继承。
en: The Ravagers are the galaxy's pirate alliance: Yondu Udonta's blue-faced bounty hunters, Star-Lord's adoptive family.
In the MCU Yondu raised Peter Quill; Ravager fleets answered the call in Endgame.
The Ravagers are freedom and loyalty: smuggling, raiding, a pirate code.
After Yondu's sacrifice, Kraglin and others carry the name.

desc.zh: 苏联的黑寡妇训练机构，德雷科夫的傀儡工厂。
desc.en: The Soviet Black Widow academy.

zh: 红房是漫威的苏联间谍训练机构：培养"黑寡妇"女特工的冷酷学府，娜塔莎·罗曼诺夫的故乡。
德雷科夫将军执掌红房（MCU《黑寡妇》），其"红房计划"以生化强化与精神操控培养顶级特工。
组织象征"体制的恶"：特工的童年被剥夺、身体被改造——黑寡妇们以牺牲者的身份复仇。
《黑寡妇》中红房被娜塔莎与叶莲娜摧毁，但余党仍在暗处活动。
en: The Red Room is Marvel's Soviet spy academy: the cold school of Black Widows, Natasha Romanoff's origin.
General Dreykov ran it in the MCU's Black Widow, breeding enhanced operatives through the Black Widow Program.
The Room is institutional evil: stolen childhoods, rebuilt bodies — Widows who take revenge as victims.
Natasha and Yelena destroyed it in Black Widow; remnants linger.

desc.zh: 山达尔的太空执法军团。
desc.en: Xandar's space corps.

zh: 新星军团是山达尔星球的宇宙维和部队：1976 年《新星》中登场，以新星之力（Xandarian Worldmind）为士兵赋能。
理查德·赖德是其传奇百夫长；MCU《银护》中由格伦·克洛斯饰演的罗曼·戴统领。
组织象征"宇宙的秩序"：星际执法、新星之力与山达尔的荣耀——克里帝国的对手。
《银护》中山达尔被灭霸摧毁，新星军团在漫画中重建并延续。
en: The Nova Corps, Xandar's cosmic peacekeepers, debuted in Nova (1976), empowering soldiers via the Worldmind.
Richard Rider is its legendary centurion; Glenn Close's Nova Prime led it in the MCU.
The Corps is cosmic order: interstellar law, the Nova Force, Xandar's pride — Kree Empire's foe.
Xandar fell to Thanos in the MCU; comics rebuilt the Corps.

desc.zh: 瓦坎达王室女子禁卫军。
desc.en: Wakanda's all-female royal guard.

zh: 多拉·米拉杰是瓦坎达王室的女子亲卫队：黑豹的贴身护卫，瓦坎达最强的女战士团体。
奥克耶将军长期统领多拉·米拉杰，MCU《黑豹》中成为银幕经典；成员阿由等亦受关注。
组织象征"王权的锋芒"：振金武器、近身格斗与绝对忠诚——黑豹身后的盾。
苏睿继位后多拉·米拉杰继续侍奉新王，瓦坎达的军力中坚。
en: The Dora Milaje are Wakanda's royal guard: the Black Panther's elite female warriors.
General Okoye long led them, iconic in the MCU's Black Panther; Ayo and others shine too.
The Dora are the crown's edge: vibranium arms, elite combat, absolute loyalty — the Panther's shield.
They serve Queen Shuri now — Wakanda's martial core.

desc.zh: 特查卡血脉的王室家族。
desc.en: The royal bloodline of Wakanda.

zh: 瓦坎达王室是漫威最富有的君主制家族：世代以黑豹之名守护振金之国。
特查拉国王（MCU 查德维克·博斯曼）与苏睿公主、拉蒙达太后构成王室核心；《黑豹2》后苏睿继位。
家族象征"传统与未来"：心形草仪式、振金科技与"瓦坎达永不屈服"的骄傲。
瓦坎达王室在 MCU 中主导对抗塔洛坎，漫画中黑豹血脉延续千年。
en: The House of Wakanda, Marvel's wealthiest monarchy, has guarded the vibranium nation through generations of Black Panthers.
King T'Challa (Chadwick Boseman), Princess Shuri and Queen Ramonda anchored it; Shuri took the throne in Wakanda Forever.
The family is tradition and future: Heart-Shaped Herb rites, vibranium tech, "Wakanda Forever" pride.
The royal house led against Talokan in the MCU; the Panther line spans millennia in comics.

desc.zh: 纳米水下的玛雅后裔帝国。
desc.en: The underwater Mesoamerican empire.

zh: 塔洛坎王国是 MCU《黑豹2》原创的水下文明：由纳摩（海王）统治、以振金维生的海底帝国。
纳摩（特诺奇·韦尔塔饰演）是塔洛坎之王，因瓦坎达的振金争端浮出水面。
组织象征"深海的复仇"：水底文明、玛雅血统与对地表世界的警惕。
《黑豹2》结尾纳摩与瓦坎达停战结盟，塔洛坎成为 MCU 新势力。
en: Talokan, the MCU's underwater civilization from Wakanda Forever, is ruled by Namor and powered by vibranium.
Namor (Tenoch Huerta) rules Talokan, surfacing over the vibranium dispute.
Talokan is the deep's vengeance: an underwater Maya civilization wary of the surface.
Talokan and Wakanda made peace — a new MCU power bloc.

desc.zh: Earth-828 的第一家庭：四个家人，一场冒险。
desc.en: Earth-828's first family of four.

zh: 神奇四侠是漫威第一家庭：1961 年《神奇四侠》创刊，里德、苏、约翰尼与本在宇宙射线中觉醒。
MCU《奇异博士2》出现地球-838 版（约翰·卡拉辛斯基等客串）；正式重启版 2025 年由佩德罗·帕斯卡主演。
团队象征"探索与家庭"：科学与冒险一体，四人互为家人也互为对手——漫威宇宙的基石团队。
神奇四侠重启将正式接入 MCU 主线（第六阶段）。
en: The Fantastic Four, Marvel's First Family, debuted in 1961 — Reed, Sue, Johnny and Ben empowered by cosmic rays.
The MCU's MoM showed the Earth-838 version; the 2025 reboot stars Pedro Pascal.
The team is exploration and family: science and adventure fused, four heroes who are each other's foil.
The FF reboot enters MCU Phase 6 canon.

desc.zh: Earth-838 的秘密英雄理事会，被堕旺达团灭。
desc.en: Earth-838's secret council, slaughtered by corrupted Wanda.

zh: 光照会（838 宇宙）是 MCU《奇异博士2》中的秘密决策团：集结各维度守护者，以"最小伤害"原则行事。
成员包括至尊法师斯特兰奇（838）、黑蝠王、神奇先生、X教授、惊奇队长与卡特队长——被绯红女巫逐一击败。
组织象征"精英的傲慢"：为大局牺牲个体——理想主义与暴政的一线之隔。
838 光照会的覆灭警示多元宇宙联盟的危险，MCU 多元宇宙线继续展开。
en: The Illuminati of Earth-838, from Multiverse of Madness, gathers dimensional guardians ruling by "least harm."
Its roster — Strange, Black Bolt, Reed, Xavier, Captain Marvel, Captain Carter — fell one by one to the Scarlet Witch.
The council is elite hubris: sacrificing individuals for the greater good — the line between idealism and tyranny.
Their fall warns of multiverse alliances; the MCU's multiversal saga unfolds.

desc.zh: 卡玛泰姬修行的法师团统称。
desc.en: The order of sorcerers trained at Kamar-Taj.

zh: 魔力大师团是卡玛泰姬法师体系的正式组织：由至尊法师统领，分散于全球圣殿守护维度。
奇异博士、王、莫度、卡西利厄斯（叛逃）皆为成员；MCU 中伦敦、纽约、香港三大圣殿构成防御网。
组织象征"魔法的秩序"：悬戒传送、护盾咒与维度公约——秘法的守护与滥用一线之隔。
《奇异博士2》后王任至尊法师，魔力大师团在多元宇宙危机中扩编。
en: The Masters of the Mystic Arts are Kamar-Taj's formal order: sorcerers across global Sanctums, led by the Sorcerer Supreme.
Strange, Wong, Mordo and the traitor Kaecilius belong to it; London, New York and Hong Kong Sanctums form the MCU network.
The Masters are magic's order: portals, shield spells, dimensional pacts — guardianship or abuse, one step apart.
Wong now leads; the Order expands amid multiversal threats.

desc.zh: 基因锻造的金色完美种族社会。
desc.en: The genetically perfect golden society.

zh: 至高族是 MCU《银护2》中的金色人种文明：基因完美、科技至上的自恋种族。
阿耶莎大祭司统领至高族，因银护偷走电池而结仇；其"完美实验体"亚当术士在《银护3》登场。
种族象征"完美的傲慢"：生物电池、基因工程与"宇宙最优雅"的自居。
《银护3》中至高族遭反地球破坏，阿耶莎殒命，亚当成为新守护者。
en: The Sovereign, from Guardians Vol. 2, are a golden-skinned race of genetic perfection and vanity.
High Priestess Ayesha rules them; their perfect experiment Adam Warlock appears in Vol. 3.
The race is perfection's pride: bio-batteries, gene-craft, cosmic elegance.
Counter-Earth broke them; Ayesha died and Adam joined the Guardians.

desc.zh: 横跨星系的军国帝国。
desc.en: The militaristic interstellar empire.

zh: 克里帝国是漫威宇宙三大星际帝国之一：蓝色皮肤的外星军事文明，漫威电影宇宙与漫画的核心宇宙势力。
至高智慧（Supreme Intelligence）统治克里；迈-威尔、勇·罗格、卡罗尔·丹弗斯（混血）皆与其相关。
帝国象征"征服的理性"：超级士兵改造、星际扩张与斯克鲁人的千年战争。
《惊奇队长》揭示克里对斯克鲁人的屠戮，MCU 中克里帝国在《惊奇队长2》与"哈拉之死"后衰落。
en: The Kree Empire, one of Marvel's three great space empires, is the blue-skinned militarist civilization across comics and MCU.
The Supreme Intelligence rules; Mar-Vell, Yon-Rogg and Carol Danvers all tie to it.
The Empire is rational conquest: soldier engineering, expansion, the eternal Kree-Skrull war.
Captain Marvel exposed their Skrull genocide; Hala's fall in The Marvels ended their era.

desc.zh: 被旺达魔法控制的泽西小镇居民。
desc.en: The townsfolk hijacked by Wanda'sHex.

zh: 西景镇居民是《旺达幻视》中被绯红女巫的魔法困在情景喜剧现实中的小镇居民。
全镇被旺达的混沌魔法改写为"电视乐园"，只有多蒂、阿格尼丝等少数人保有自我意识。
群体象征"牺牲的代价"：旺达的悲伤以全镇人的自由为燃料——英雄行为的伦理阴影。
旺达解除魔法后西景镇居民获释，阿加莎的诅咒线在《阿加莎》剧集中延续。
en: The Westview residents were trapped in Wanda's sitcom reality throughout WandaVision.
The town became a TV fantasy; only Dottie and Agnes kept some awareness.
The townsfolk embody the cost of grief: Wanda's comfort, their captivity — heroism's moral shadow.
They were freed when Wanda lifted the hex; Agatha's curse continues in her own series.

desc.zh: 卡玛拉、凯特等新一代少年英雄的临时小队。
desc.en: Kamala and Kate's young heroes squad.

zh: 少年冠军小队是漫威的新生代英雄团队：2016 年由惊奇少女、蜘蛛侠（迈尔斯）、新星（山姆）、幻景等组建。
他们因对成年英雄的失望而自立门户，以"不做妥协"为信条。
团队象征"下一代的声音"：少年英雄的价值观、社交媒体时代的英雄主义。
漫画中冠军小队与复仇者、X战警频繁联动，是漫威少年线的中坚。
en: The Champions, Marvel's teen hero team, formed in 2016: Ms. Marvel, Miles, Nova (Sam) and Viv among them.
They formed out of disillusionment with adult heroes, vowing not to compromise.
The team is the next generation's voice: youthful ideals, social-media-age heroics.
They cross over with the Avengers and X-Men — the junior vanguard.

desc.zh: 天神组造物中的"错误品"，以猎杀永恒族为宿命。
desc.en: The Celestials' "flawed" creations hunting Eternals.

zh: 变异族是漫威的古老反派种族：数百万年前天神组在人类基因中创造的"变数"，以毁灭人类为使命。
漫画中与永恒族世仇千年；MCU《永恒族》中变异族以"怪物"形态登场并被剿灭。
种族象征"进化的失控"：基因畸变、怪兽形态与对秩序的本能仇恨。
MCU 版变异族被揭示为天神组实验的副产品，其威胁在《永恒族》后暂歇。
en: The Deviants are Marvel's ancient villain race: created by the Celestials as genetic variance, driven to destroy humanity.
They warred with the Eternals for millennia; the MCU's Eternals featured them as monsters.
The Deviants are evolution unbound: mutation, monster forms, hatred of order.
The MCU revealed them as Celestial byproducts; their threat lingers.

desc.zh: 暗神之书预言中崇拜绯红女巫的隐秘教团。
desc.en: The cult prophesied by the Darkhold.

zh: 绯红女巫信徒是《奇异博士2》中的狂热邪教：崇拜绯红女巫（旺达）为"混沌之主"。
该教派以《黑暗神书》为经、以多玛姆的仪式召唤旺达夺取美国·查维斯的穿越之力。
组织象征"信仰的扭曲"：把悲剧英雄神化为灾厄之源——崇拜与恐惧的一体两面。
旺达摧毁黑暗神书后教派瓦解，其影响力随多元宇宙线消散。
en: The Scarlet Witch cult in Multiverse of Madness venerates Wanda as the chaos-wielding mistress.
The cult used the Darkhold to summon Wanda and seize America Chavez's multiverse power.
The cult is faith warped: hero deified into catastrophe — worship and fear as one.
Wanda destroyed the Darkhold; the cult dissolved.

desc.zh: 山达尔星统治议会。
desc.en: Xandar's ruling council.

zh: 新星核心议会是山达尔星的最高权力机关：由新星至尊（Nova Prime）领导的九人委员会。
MCU《银护》中格伦·克洛斯饰演的罗曼·戴任新星至尊，负责与罗南的战争。
组织象征"文明的秩序"：星际法律、新星军团指挥权与宇宙外交。
山达尔遭灭霸毁灭后，新星核心议会残余在漫画与 MCU 中艰难重建。
en: Nova Prime is Xandar's ruling council: nine members led by the Nova Prime.
Glenn Close's Romen-Dey led it through the Ronan war in the MCU.
The council is civilizational order: space law, Nova Corps command, cosmic diplomacy.
After Xandar's fall, remnants rebuild in comics and the MCU.

desc.zh: 泽维尔学院的变种人英雄战队：为和平共存而战。
desc.en: Xavier's mutant team fighting for peaceful coexistence.

zh: X战警是漫威最伟大的变种人团队：1963 年《X战警》创刊，泽维尔教授以"人类与变种人和平共处"为理想。
经典阵容：镭射眼、琴·葛蕾、冰人、天使、野兽（初代）+ 金刚狼、暴风女、夜行者等（巨型X战警世代）。
团队象征"少数群体的抗争"：变种人的隐喻——偏见、恐惧与生存之战，漫威最有现实重量的一线。
克拉科亚时代（2019-2023）让变种人建国又崩塌，MCU 正在重启X战警。
en: The X-Men, Marvel's greatest mutant team, debuted in 1963 under Xavier's dream of human-mutant peace.
The roster spans the originals (Cyclops, Jean, Iceman, Beast, Angel) and the Giant-Size generation (Wolverine, Storm, Nightcrawler).
The X-Men are the struggle of the marginalized: mutant metaphor for prejudice and survival — Marvel's most resonant line.
The Krakoa era built and broke the mutant nation; the MCU reboot looms.

desc.zh: 万磁王麾下"变种人至上"的激进组织。
desc.en: Magneto's mutant-supremacy militants.

zh: 变种人兄弟会是万磁王的阵营：1963 年《X战警》创刊同期成立，主张"变种人至上"。
历代成员包括万磁王、快银、绯红女巫（早期）、魔形女、剑齿虎、蟾蜍人等。
组织象征"X教授的镜像"：与X战警同源却选择武力——漫威最深刻的哲学对撞。
兄弟会多次改组（含魔形女领导期），克拉科亚时代后势力式微。
en: The Brotherhood of Mutants, Magneto's faction, formed alongside the X-Men in 1963 — mutant supremacy by force.
Members spanned Magneto, Quicksilver, early Scarlet Witch, Mystique, Sabretooth, Toad.
The Brotherhood mirrors Xavier's dream with force — Marvel's deepest philosophical duel.
It reshuffled many times; after Krakoa it faded.

desc.zh: 夜魔侠、杰茜卡、卢克与铁拳的街头临时同盟。
desc.en: Matt, Jessica, Luke and Danny's street alliance.

zh: 捍卫者联盟是漫威街头英雄团队：奇异博士、绿巨人、纳摩与银影侠的"非团队"组合。
MCU Netflix 版则由夜魔侠、杰茜卡·琼斯、卢克·凯奇与铁拳组成（2017 剧集）。
团队象征"自由组合"：没有章程的超级英雄——各打各的，必要时并肩。
漫画捍卫者多次重组（含地狱猫、刀锋战士版），MCU 街头线正回归。
en: The Defenders, Marvel's street-mystic team, unite Doctor Strange, Hulk, Namor and the Silver Surfer — a "non-team."
The MCU's Defenders (2017) teamed Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage and Iron Fist.
The team is anti-team: heroes without a charter, together when needed.
Comics re-formed it often; the MCU's street heroes are returning.

desc.zh: 复仇者的大本营与战场中心：从纽约之战到圣所与非凡大街。
desc.en: HQ and battlefield of the Avengers, from the Chitauri invasion onward.

zh: 纽约市是漫威宇宙的核心舞台：复仇者总部、至圣所、斯塔克大厦与无数超级英雄的家乡，2012 年外星入侵之战的现场。
曼哈顿中城的斯塔克大厦（后为复仇者大厦）与格林威治村的至圣所是其标志性地标。
城市象征"英雄的日常"：蜘蛛侠的皇后区、夜魔侠的地狱厨房、金并的地下帝国——超级英雄密度最高的城市。
纽约之战（复仇者联盟1）确立其为漫威电影宇宙的守护中心，此后多次成为多元宇宙危机的现场。
纽约是 MCU 的心脏：斯塔克大厦、至圣所与无数英雄的地面战场都坐落于此。
纽约之战让这座城成为外星威胁的前线，也让‘守护家园’成为此后所有灾难叙事的坐标。
en: New York City is Marvel's central stage: home to the Avengers, the Sanctum and Stark Tower, and the site of the 2012 alien invasion.
Stark Tower (later Avengers Tower) in Midtown and the Greenwich Village Sanctum are its icons.
The city is heroes' everyday: Spider-Man's Queens, Daredevil's Hell's Kitchen, Kingpin's empire.
The Battle of New York made it the MCU's defended heart, scene of many multiversal crises since.
New York is the MCU's heart — Stark Tower, the Sanctum, and countless street battles.
The 2012 battle makes the city the invasion frontline — 'protect home' the saga's compass.

desc.zh: 史蒂夫与巴基的故乡街区。
desc.en: Home borough of Steve and Bucky.

zh: 布鲁克林是美国队长的故乡：史蒂夫·罗杰斯成长于大萧条时期的布鲁克林街头。
《美国队长1》中瘦弱的史蒂夫在此屡次报名参军被拒，也在小巷中守护弱者。
街区象征"平民英雄的起点"：布鲁克林的巷战塑造了美队的品格——"我只会做对的事"。
终局之战后美队回到过去在此与佩吉共度一生，布鲁克林承载他完整的弧光。
en: Brooklyn is Captain America's home: Steve Rogers grew up on its Depression-era streets.
In Captain America: TFA, a scrawny Steve kept enlisting and kept fighting bullies here.
The borough is the everyman hero's start: its alleys forged Cap's "do what's right" code.
Endgame's Steve returned here to live out his life with Peggy — Brooklyn holds his full arc.

desc.zh: 彼得·帕克长大的法拉盛街区。
desc.en: Peter Parker's Forest Hills home.

zh: 皇后区是蜘蛛侠的家乡：彼得·帕克与梅姨的温馨公寓所在地，邻家英雄的日常半径。
MCU 中彼得在皇后区的学校、公寓与街区之间摆荡，蜘蛛侠的"友善邻居"人设由此而来。
街区象征"平凡与伟大"：蜘蛛侠的战场不在宇宙而在街角——最接地气的英雄叙事。
《无路可归》后彼得搬离皇后区，但这里仍是蜘蛛侠神话的起点。
en: Queens is Spider-Man's home: Peter Parker and Aunt May's apartment, the neighborhood hero's radius.
In the MCU Peter swings between school, home and block — the source of "friendly neighborhood."
The borough is ordinary greatness: Peter's battles are street-corner, not cosmic.
Peter left after No Way Home, yet Queens remains his myth's origin.

desc.zh: 振金科技之国，藏身非洲群山的隐秘王国。
desc.en: The vibranium kingdom hidden in African mountains.

zh: 瓦坎达王国
en: Kingdom of Wakanda

zh: 瓦坎达是漫威最富有的虚构国度：位于非洲的振金之国，科技领先世界数代的黑豹领地。
首都黄金之城（Birnin Zana）与王室、多拉·米拉杰亲卫队构成其权力核心；特查拉与苏睿相继为王。
国度象征"藏锋的文明"：对外伪装贫弱、对内振金科技——孤立主义与守护传统的平衡。
无限战争的瓦坎达之战与《黑豹2》的塔洛坎冲突让这个国度成为 MCU 的军事中心。
瓦坎达是振金科技铸就的隐秘王国，长期以‘第三世界农业国’伪装，实为地球最先进文明之一。
从黑豹到复仇者，它的开放与守护贯穿多部电影，也成为非洲未来主义的银幕图腾。
en: Wakanda, Marvel's wealthiest fictional nation, is the hidden African kingdom of vibranium and hyper-tech.
The Golden City, the royal house and the Dora Milaje anchor it; T'Challa then Shuri ruled.
The nation is hidden might: poor on the surface, vibranium-deep — isolation and tradition.
The Wakanda Battle and the Talokan war made it the MCU's martial center.
Wakanda hides the world's most advanced nation behind a farming-state facade, built on vibranium.
From Black Panther to the Avengers, its openness and defense recur — an Afrofuturist icon.

desc.zh: 瓦坎达首都，王宫与舒芮实验室所在。
desc.en: Wakanda's capital: palace and Shuri's lab.

zh: 黄金之城（Birnin Zana）是瓦坎达的首都：悬浮列车、振金建筑与高山瀑布环抱的科技之都。
《黑豹》中特查拉的加冕、王位争夺与查拉湖边的仪式都在此展开。
城市象征"非洲未来主义"：传统服饰与量子科技共存——漫威最惊艳的虚构城市。
灭霸响指后黄金之城一度蒙尘，苏睿继位后重建并开放。
en: Birnin Zana, the Golden City, is Wakanda's capital — maglevs, vibranium towers, waterfall-wreathed.
Black Panther's coronation, the throne struggle and the lake rites all unfold here.
The city is Afrofuturism: tradition and quantum tech together — Marvel's most stunning city.
Dusted after the Snap, the Golden City was rebuilt and opened under Shuri.

desc.zh: 纽约上州的复仇者总部与量子隧道所在。
desc.en: Upstate HQ with the Quantum Tunnel.

zh: 复仇者基地是复仇者的秘密总部：位于纽约州北部的训练、研究与居住综合体。
《奥创纪元》后取代斯塔克大厦成为主基地，终局之战的时间劫持与决战都在此展开。
基地象征"团队的归属"：训练场、无限宝石实验室与"复仇者集结"的集结地。
终局之战后基地在《猎鹰与冬兵》与《雷霆特攻队》中易主，成为政府设施的象征。
en: The Avengers Compound is the team's upstate New York headquarters: training, research and living quarters.
It replaced Avengers Tower after Age of Ultron; the Endgame time heist launched from here.
The base is the team's home: training floors, the Stones lab, the place Avengers assemble.
Post-Endgame it passed to government hands in FATWS and Thunderbolts.

desc.zh: 曼哈顿中城的复联第一总部，后卖给消失的"神秘买家"。
desc.en: Midtown HQ of the early Avengers, later sold.

zh: 斯塔克大厦是托尼·斯塔克的地标总部：曼哈顿中城的弧形科技大厦，复仇者早期的集结地。
《复仇者联盟1》纽约之战后更名为"复仇者大厦"，装点 A 字标志直至《奥创纪元》。
大厦象征"技术与慷慨"：方舟反应堆供电、战衣实验室与亿万富翁的超级英雄日常。
MCU 中复仇者搬迁后大厦易主（《蜘蛛侠》系列暗示售出），其历史地位依旧。
en: Stark Tower, Tony Stark's Midtown landmark, was the Avengers' early rally point.
After the Battle of New York it became Avengers Tower with its A logo until Age of Ultron.
The tower is tech and largesse: arc-reactor power, suit labs, a billionaire's hero HQ.
Sold after the Avengers moved on, the tower's legacy remains.

desc.zh: 177A 布利克街的法师据点，守护地球的三圣所之一。
desc.en: 177A Bleecker Street: New York's mystic bastion.

zh: 至圣所是奇异博士的居所与圣殿：位于格林威治村的魔法建筑，保护地球免受维度入侵。
至圣所内部空间无限扩张：魔法图书馆、法器室与无数秘门；王与斯特兰奇先后驻守。
建筑象征"现实的门槛"：镜像维度、悬戒传送与"至尊法师之家"——魔法的地标。
《疯狂多元宇宙》中至圣所遭旺达袭击，王继任后仍以它为纽约的魔法枢纽。
en: The Sanctum Sanctorum, Doctor Strange's Greenwich Village home, guards Earth from dimensional threats.
Its interior is infinite: the mystic library, relic vaults, countless doors; Wong and Strange hold it.
The building is reality's threshold: mirror dimensions, portals, the Sorcerer Supreme's home.
Wanda attacked it in MoM; Wong keeps it New York's mystic hub.

desc.zh: 尼泊尔加德满都的法师修行圣地。
desc.en: The mystic academy in Kathmandu.

zh: 卡玛泰姬是秘法学院的所在地：喜马拉雅山中的魔法圣地，训练历代至尊法师。
远古者在此执教数世纪，奇异博士、王与莫度皆在此学艺；《奇异博士1》以此为舞台。
圣地象征"魔法的传承"：悬戒、星体投射与多维宇宙的智慧——地球秘法的源头。
《奇异博士2》后卡玛泰姬在多元宇宙危机中成为枢纽，法师团扩大。
卡玛泰姬是喜马拉雅深处的法师圣殿，历代至尊法师在此训练守护维度的法师团。
藏书阁、镜像维度的修习与悬戒传送，让这里成为漫威魔法体系的源头与中心。
en: Kamar-Taj, the mystic academy in the Himalayas, trains the Sorcerer Supremes.
The Ancient One taught here for centuries; Strange, Wong and Mordo studied here.
The sanctum is magic's lineage: sling rings, astral arts, multiversal wisdom — the mystic source.
After MoM it became a multiversal hub; the Masters expanded.
Kamar-Taj, high in the Himalayas, trains the sorcerers who guard Earth's dimension.
Its library, Mirror Dimension training, and sling-ring portals make it the wellspring of Marvel magic.

desc.zh: 被旺达情境魔法包裹的新泽西小镇。
desc.en: The New Jersey town inside Wanda's sitcom Hex.

zh: 西景镇是新泽西州的小镇，《旺达幻视》的舞台：旺达以混沌魔法将其改写为情景喜剧现实。
全镇居民被困在"电视乐园"中，只有少数人保有自我；旺达的悲伤以全镇为代价。
小镇象征"悲伤的牢笼"：50 年代到 00 年代的情景喜剧片段，实为创伤的层层伪装。
旺达解除魔法后西景镇获释，《阿加莎》剧集继续此地魔法线的故事。
en: Westview, the New Jersey town of WandaVision, was rewritten into a sitcom reality by Wanda's chaos magic.
The townsfolk were trapped in the TV fantasy; Wanda's grief ran on their freedom.
The town is grief's cage: decades of sitcom tropes masking layers of trauma.
Freed when the hex lifted, Westview's magic thread continues in Agatha.

desc.zh: 奥创升空又坠毁的东欧小国，内战与泽莫悲剧的起点。
desc.en: The Eastern European country Ultron lifted and dropped.

zh: 索科维亚是东欧的虚构国家：奥创纪元中被奥创托举升空的悲剧之地。
《奥创纪元》中复仇者疏散居民后将其炸毁，180 万平民死伤；旺达与皮特罗的故乡。
国家象征"代价的重量"：超级英雄行动的附带伤害——索科维亚协议由此诞生。
索科维亚难民流亡（含《猎鹰与冬兵》的卡莉·摩根索线），其阴影贯穿 MCU。
en: Sokovia, a fictional Eastern European nation, was the city Ultron lifted skyward.
The Avengers destroyed the airborne city after evacuation — 180,000 dead; Wanda and Pietro's home.
The nation is collateral weight: the Sokovia Accords were born from its ashes.
Its refugees (Karli Morgenthau in FATWS) carry the shadow through the MCU.

desc.zh: 九头蛇雪地基地，冬兵旧巢与托尼的悲剧现场。
desc.en: Hydra's snowy bunker of Bucky's past.

zh: 西伯利亚基地是九头蛇的冬兵设施：位于俄罗斯冰原的地下实验室，冬兵计划的执行地。
《美国队长3》中钢铁侠在此发现父母遇害真相，与美队、冬兵爆发内战决战。
基地象征"历史的冰层"：被冷冻的冬兵们与不可告人的暗杀档案。
内战一役后基地废弃，但冬兵计划的遗产仍困扰巴基与政府。
en: The Siberian Facility, HYDRA's Winter Soldier base, is where the Winter Soldier program ran.
In Civil War, Stark learned his parents' fate here — the Civil War's climactic fight.
The base is history's ice: frozen Winter Soldiers and buried assassination files.
Abandoned after the Civil War fight, its legacy still haunts Bucky.

desc.zh: 金桥尽头的神域之城，诸神黄昏后已毁，遗民流落地球。
desc.en: The golden realm at the end of the Bifrost; destroyed at Ragnarök.

zh: 阿斯加德是北欧神域的都城：金宫之下的彩虹桥连接九界，奥丁与托尔的王国。
金宫、英灵殿与彩虹桥是其标志；《雷神》三部曲与诸神黄昏在此上演。
神域象征"神话的尊严"：阿斯加德人不是神而是长寿的异星文明——"阿斯加德是人民，不是地方"。
诸神黄昏中阿斯加德被苏尔特尔摧毁，幸存者在托尔带领下流亡地球。
阿斯加德是九界的王都，彩虹桥连接诸域，金宫之下藏着诸神黄昏的预言。
《雷神3》中苏尔特尔毁城、幸存者远航，它的覆灭成为 MCU 神域叙事的分水岭。
en: Asgard, the Norse realm's capital, sits beyond the Bifrost — home of Odin and Thor.
The Golden Palace, Valhalla and the Bifrost define it; the Thor trilogy and Ragnarok unfold here.
The realm is myth's dignity: Asgardians are long-lived aliens, not gods — "Asgard is its people."
Surtur destroyed it in Ragnarok; survivors fled to Earth with Thor.
Asgard, capital of the Nine Realms, bridges worlds by the Bifrost — Ragnarok's prophecy under the gold.
Ragnarok's fire and the survivors' exodus turn Asgard's fall into the saga's mythic watershed.

desc.zh: 挪威海滨的阿斯加德遗民村。
desc.en: The Norwegian fishing village of Asgardian refugees.

zh: 新阿斯加德是阿斯加德难民在地球的定居点：位于挪威海岸的小渔镇。
《终局之战》五年后托尔在此颓废度日，阿斯加德人经营旅游业；女武神布伦希尔德后来统治此地。
小镇象征"流亡与重生"：神话文明降落凡间——英雄的退场与日常。
《爱与雷霆》中新阿斯加德成为旅游胜地，简·福斯特在此举起雷神之锤。
en: New Asgard is the Asgardian refugees' Earth settlement: a Norwegian coastal town.
Thor moped here for five years post-Snap; Valkyrie Brunnhilde later rules it.
The town is exile reborn: myth landing in mundane life.
Love and Thunder made it a tourist spot; Jane Foster lifted Mjolnir here.

desc.zh: 冰霜巨人的冻土界域。
desc.en: The frost-giant realm.

zh: 约顿海姆是冰霜巨人的国度：九界中最寒冷的领域，劳菲与洛基的故乡。
《雷神1》中托尔与洛基的约顿海姆之行引发阿斯加德与冰霜巨人的战争。
国度象征"寒冰的威胁"：冰霜巨人的诅咒之匣（远古冬棺）是阿斯加德的宿敌遗物。
诸神黄昏后约顿海姆随九界动乱而变，洛基的冰霜血统贯穿其身份之谜。
en: Jotunheim, realm of the Frost Giants, is the coldest of the Nine Realms — home of Laufey and Loki's birth.
Thor and Loki's visit in Thor (2011) sparked war with the Frost Giants.
The realm is frozen threat: the Casket of Ancient Winters, Asgard's relic-foe.
Post-Ragnarok it shifts with the realms; Loki's Frost Giant blood haunts his identity.

desc.zh: 灵魂宝石的看守之地，"以魂换魂"的祭坛。
desc.en: The Soul Stone altar: "a soul for a soul."

zh: 沃米尔星是灵魂宝石的所在：位于宇宙尽头的孤寂星球，红骷髅的流放之地。
《无限战争》中灭霸在此以卡魔拉之死换取灵魂宝石；《终局之战》中黑寡妇为鹰眼牺牲。
星球象征"以爱换石"：灵魂宝石的规则是"以所爱之人换取"——最沉重的仪式。
黑寡妇之死让沃米尔成为 MCU 最令人心碎的地标。
en: Vormir, the soul planet at the universe's edge, holds the Soul Stone — Red Skull's exile.
Thanos traded Gamora here; in Endgame, Natasha gave her life for Clint.
The planet is love's price: the Soul Stone demands a loved one — the heaviest rite.
Natasha's sacrifice made Vormir the MCU's most heartbreaking landmark.

desc.zh: 灭霸的废土母星，泰坦之战的战场。
desc.en: Thanos's ruined homeworld; battlefield of Titan.

zh: 泰坦星是土星卫星，也是灭霸的故乡：曾经的永恒族殖民地，最终因人口过剩与资源枯竭而毁灭。
灭霸亲眼目睹母星因资源枯竭而崩坏，这段经历塑造了他"宇宙一半生命必须消亡以拯救另一半"的极端哲学。
星球象征"灾难的预言者"：泰坦的毁灭成为灭霸无尽屠杀的"合理化"根源。
《无限战争》泰坦之战中，钢铁侠、奇异博士与蜘蛛侠在此与灭霸正面交锋。
en: Titan, moon of Saturn and Thanos's homeworld, was a thriving Eternal colony destroyed by overpopulation and collapse.
Watching his homeworld collapse convinced Thanos that random half-erasure could save existence itself.
Titan is the birthplace of Thanos's obsession: a survivor's guilt twisted into galactic genocide.
The Battle of Titan in Infinity War marked a pivotal confrontation between Thanos and Earth's heroes.

desc.zh: 灭霸卸甲归田的农耕行星，终被雷神斩首。
desc.en: Thanos's quiet farm planet.

zh: 花园星是灭霸的隐居之地：无限战争后他在此退休种田，目睹自己"使命完成"。
《终局之战》开头复仇者在此找到他，却发现宝石已被摧毁——"我毁掉了它们"。
星球象征"毁灭者的平静"：灭霸眼中的田园牧歌，实则半个宇宙的坟场。
托尔在此斩首灭霸，花园星成为终局的起点。
en: The Garden is Thanos's retreat: farming retirement after the Snap, his "mission accomplished."
Endgame's opening finds him here — with the Stones destroyed: "I used them to destroy them."
The planet is the destroyer's peace: an idyll built on half the universe's ashes.
Thor beheaded Thanos here — the starting point of the Endgame heist.

desc.zh: 新星军团的母星，力量宝石曾经的守护者。
desc.en: Nova Corps homeworld, once keeper of the Power Stone.

zh: 山达尔星是新星军团的总部：宇宙秩序的象征，克里帝国的千年对手。
《银护1》中星爵团队在此交出力量宝石；《无限战争》前奏中山达尔被灭霸摧毁。
星球象征"秩序的代价"：新星军团的星际法律在灭霸的暴力面前不堪一击。
漫画中山达尔多次重建，MCU 版在《惊奇队长》等线中留有历史。
en: Xandar, home of the Nova Corps, symbolizes cosmic order — the Kree Empire's ancient foe.
The Guardians delivered the Power Stone here in Vol. 1; Thanos destroyed Xandar pre-IW.
The planet is order's cost: Nova law shattered by Thanos's might.
Comics rebuilt Xandar often; the MCU version lingers in history.

desc.zh: 宇宙之脑残骸上的走私港，护卫队的新家。
desc.en: A smuggler's port inside a Celestial's severed head.

zh: 虚无之地是收藏者的基地：一颗被挖空的远古天神头颅，宇宙的走私与交易中心。
《银护1》中收藏家在此展示无限宝石；《银护3》中虚无之地成为掠夺者的新总部。
地点象征"宇宙的市集"：酒吧、赌场与各色外星人——秩序与混乱的交界。
《复联3》中收藏家的藏品被灭霸洗劫，虚无之地在《银护3》重生为掠夺者家园。
虚无之地是远古天神头颅改造的星际市集，收藏家与各方势力在此交易宇宙奇珍。
《银护》系列与《复联3》都以它为坐标，见证灭霸夺石与护卫队的聚散。
en: Knowhere, the Collector's base, is a hollowed Celestial skull — the galaxy's trading post.
The Collector displayed the Stone here in Vol. 1; the Ravagers took it over in Vol. 3.
The place is the cosmic bazaar: bars, casinos, aliens — order meets chaos.
Thanos ransacked it; Vol. 3 rebirthed it as Ravager home.
Knowhere, a dead Celestial's head turned space bazaar, hosts the Collector and every species' trade.
A Guardians fixture and Infinity War's opening stage — hub of the team's comings and goings.

desc.zh: 克里帝国的铁血母星。
desc.en: The Kree imperial homeworld.

zh: 哈拉星是克里帝国的首都：位于大麦哲伦云的蓝色星球，克里文明的政治与军事中枢。
星球上有"至高智慧"（Supreme Intelligence）——一个由历代克里最伟大头脑合成的人工智能体，统治着整个帝国。
哈拉象征"帝国的铁幕"：军国主义、征服文化以及对个体自由的压制——克里文明的黑暗面。
在《惊奇队长》的故事中，卡罗尔·丹弗斯正是意识到哈拉的侵略本质，才转而反抗至高智慧。
en: Hala is the capital of the Kree Empire: the blue-skinned militaristic civilization's political and military heart.
Hala hosts the Supreme Intelligence, an artificial ruler composed of the greatest Kree minds.
Hala embodies imperial tyranny: militarism, expansionism, and suppression of individual freedom.
Carol Danvers's realization of Hala's侵略性 drove her rebellion against the Supreme Intelligence.

desc.zh: 活体星球伊戈的躯壳表面。
desc.en: The living surface of Ego.

zh: 伊戈之星是星爵生父伊戈的本体：一颗拥有意识的行星，以"扩张"为天职。
《银护2》中伊戈试图以"光之种子"吞噬宇宙，被星爵与护卫队阻止。
星球象征"父亲的阴影"：伊戈的"爱"是征服的伪装——星爵的弑父之战。
伊戈毁灭后其星域化为残骸，《银护3》中再无踪迹。
en: Ego's Planet is Star-Lord's father Ego himself: a sentient planet driven to expand.
In Vol. 2, Ego's Expansion Plan was stopped by Quill and the Guardians.
The planet is the father's shadow: Ego's "love" masked conquest — Quill's patricide.
Destroyed, Ego's remains fade by Vol. 3.

desc.zh: 虫洞尽头的垃圾星与角斗场，浩克的王座之地。
desc.en: The wormhole junk planet with its gladiator arena.

zh: 萨卡星是宇宙的垃圾场与角斗场：时间裂缝尽头的混乱星球，宗师统治的竞技场。
《雷神3》中浩克与托尔在此角斗，女武神、石头人 Korg 相伴脱逃。
星球象征"强者的赌局"：角斗士文化与宗师的玩乐——被遗弃者的角斗场。
萨卡星帮（Korg 与 Miek）后来加入新阿斯加德，Sakaar 的余韵贯穿 MCU。
en: Sakaar, the cosmos's junkyard, is a chaos planet of time rifts — Grandmaster's arena.
Thor and Hulk fought here in Ragnarok, escaping with Valkyrie and Korg.
The planet is the strong's gamble: gladiator culture, the Grandmaster's games.
Sakaar's survivors joined New Asgard; its echoes run through the MCU.

desc.zh: 至高进化打造的"完美"地球复制体。
desc.en: The High Evolutionary's "perfect" Earth replica.

zh: 反地球是至高进化者的实验星球：复制地球的"完美世界"，《银护3》的悲剧舞台。
至高进化者在此创造"人类"作为生物实验，反地球最终被火箭解放的动物们摧毁。
星球象征"完美的暴政"：为"完美"而抹除不完美——实验伦理的极端。
反地球的毁灭让至高进化者一无所有，成为《银护3》的复仇主题。
en: Counter-Earth, the High Evolutionary's experiment, replicates Earth as a "perfect" world — Vol. 3's tragedy.
The High Evolutionary bred humans here; the liberated animals burned it down.
The planet is perfection's tyranny: erasing the imperfect for the "ideal."
Its fall left the High Evolutionary with nothing — Vol. 3's vengeance core.

desc.zh: 十环背后的东方神话村落，守卫噬魂兽之门。
desc.en: The mythic Chinese village guarding the Dweller-In-Darkness gate.

zh: 塔罗秘境是《尚气》中的神话之乡：位于异空间的古代村落，守护神龙与十环的故乡。
尚气之母映丽出身于此；《尚气》高潮中十环帮与守护者在此决战。
秘境象征"东方的神话"：麒麟、凤凰与龙——漫威对中国神话的敬意。
塔罗秘境的传送门与守护者线为 MCU 的魔法体系增添东方维度。
塔罗是山海经式的结界秘境，九尾狐、麒麟与神龙栖息于此，镇守着封印噬魂兽的巨门。
《尚气》让十环与龙鳞在此碰撞，也让东方神话第一次成为 MCU 的正式舞台。
en: Ta Lo, Shang-Chi's mythic realm, is an ancient village in a pocket dimension, home of the Great Protector.
Shang-Chi's mother Ying Li came from here; the film's climax rages in Ta Lo.
The realm is Eastern myth: qilin, fenghuang, dragons — Marvel's homage to Chinese lore.
Its portals add an Eastern dimension to the MCU's mystic system.
Ta Lo is a mythic pocket realm of qilin and dragons, guarding the gate that seals the Dweller.
Shang-Chi's rings and dragon-scale clash here — Eastern myth entering the MCU proper.

desc.zh: 纳米水下的玛雅后裔王国。
desc.en: The underwater Mesoamerican kingdom.

zh: 塔罗坎是《黑豹2》的海底王国：玛雅后裔以振金维生的水下文明，纳摩的领地。
纳摩率塔罗坎军浮出水面，与瓦坎达争夺振金与地表世界的话语权。
王国象征"被压迫者的复仇"：殖民时代的幸存者藏在深海——水下的瓦坎达。
《黑豹2》结尾塔罗坎与瓦坎达结盟，成为 MCU 的新势力。
en: Talokan, Wakanda Forever's underwater realm, is a Maya-descended vibranium civilization ruled by Namor.
Namor's Talokan clashed with Wakanda over vibranium and the surface world.
The kingdom is the oppressed's vengeance: colonial survivors hidden in the deep — Wakanda under water.
Talokan allied with Wakanda — a new MCU power.

desc.zh: 漂浮在空中的黑寡妇训练基地。
desc.en: The skyborne Black Widow academy.

zh: 红房总部是苏联黑寡妇计划的训练设施：漂浮于空中的秘密基地。
《黑寡妇》中娜塔莎与叶莲娜攻入红房，摧毁德雷科夫的洗脑帝国。
设施象征"童年的剥夺"：芭蕾舞、格斗与生化改造——特工从女孩开始。
红房毁灭后其训练体系（含模仿大师）仍在外散落。
en: The Red Room Academy is the Soviet Black Widow program's floating training base.
Black Widow saw Natasha and Yelena storm it, destroying Dreykov's empire.
The facility is stolen childhood: ballet, combat, bio-modification — agents from girlhood.
After its fall, its training tree (Taskmaster et al.) scattered.

desc.zh: 深海的超级反派监狱。
desc.en: The underwater superhuman prison.

zh: 木筏监狱是 MCU 的超能力罪犯监狱：位于海上的浮动设施。
《美国队长3》中违反索科维亚协议的复仇者被囚于此，美队劫狱救出他们。
监狱象征"英雄的枷锁"：协议、玻璃牢房与政府监管——自由与秩序的角力。
《雷霆特攻队》中木筏成为瓦尔与政府关押反英雄的场所。
en: The Raft is the MCU's superhuman prison: a floating facility at sea.
Civil War's renegade Avengers were jailed here until Cap broke them out.
The prison is heroism caged: Accords, glass cells, state control.
Thunderbolts repurposed the Raft for its anti-heroes.

desc.zh: 旧金山湾区的皮姆科技旧总部，第一代黄衫侠之战现场。
desc.en: Pym Technologies HQ in San Francisco.

zh: 皮姆科技总部是汉克·皮姆的实验室与公司：量子科技与皮姆粒子的研发中心。
《蚁人》中斯科特·朗在此盗取战衣并阻止黄蜂计划；《蚁人3》中量子隧道的出发点。
地点象征"微观的智慧"：缩小技术、量子领域研究——皮姆家族的遗产。
MCU 中皮姆科技在《蚁人2》后随量子研究持续扩张。
en: Pym Technologies is Hank Pym's lab and company — the cradle of Pym particles and quantum tech.
Scott Lang stole the suit here in Ant-Man; Quantumania's quantum tunnel launches from it.
The HQ is micro-wisdom: shrinking tech, quantum research — the Pym legacy.
It grew with the quantum research through Ant-Man 2 and 3.

desc.zh: 文武的隐世王庭。
desc.en: Wenwu's hidden court.

zh: 十环总部是文武与十环帮的基地：《尚气》中的地下要塞与军火库。
十环帮总部藏于深山，尚气在此受训长大。
基地象征"父亲的帝国"：武术、暗杀与千年野心——十环的权柄。
《尚气》后十环落入尚气之手，总部改组。
en: The Ten Rings HQ is Wenwu's base in Shang-Chi: an underground fortress and armory.
Hidden in the mountains, Shang-Chi grew up training here.
The base is the father's empire: martial arts, assassination, millennial ambition.
After Shang-Chi, the Rings pass to him; the HQ reorganizes.

desc.zh: 时间尽头的橙白官僚巨构。
desc.en: The orange bureaucracy at the end of time.

zh: TVA 总部是时间变异管理局的办公场所：存在于时间之外的无尽官僚大楼。
《洛基》中洛基与莫比乌斯在此调查时间犯；第二季中总部直面康之战争。
大楼象征"时间的秩序"：剪枝装置、记忆清除与"神圣时间线"的档案室。
洛基成为时间之神后，TVA 的使命由"修剪"转向"守护"多元宇宙。
en: The TVA HQ, the Time Variance Authority's offices, exists outside time — endless bureaucracy.
Loki and Mobius worked here; Season 2 faced the Multiversal War.
The building is time's order: pruning, memory wipes, the Sacred Timeline's files.
With Loki as time-god, the TVA's mission shifted from pruning to guarding.

desc.zh: 被裁剪时间线与废弃变体的尽头垃圾场。
desc.en: Where pruned timelines and variants rot.

zh: 虚空之地是 TVA 剪枝时间线的垃圾场：时间尽头的废弃领域，"遗留之人"的动物园。
《洛基》第一季中被剪枝的洛基变体在此对抗艾里奥斯；第二季再次成为战场。
领域象征"被遗忘者的最后舞台"：无数时间变体在此挣扎求生。
艾里奥斯（时间风暴兽）与卡桑德拉·诺娃让虚空之地在多元宇宙线中延续。
en: The Void is the TVA's timeline junkyard: a realm at time's end, the "He Who Remains" menagerie.
Loki's pruned variants fought Alioth here in S1; S2 returned to it.
The realm is the forgotten's stage: variants scrabbling for survival.
Alioth and Cassandra Nova keep the Void alive in the multiverse saga.

desc.zh: 虚空之地的军座与狮身人面像残骸。
desc.en: The Void's sphinx throne.

zh: 卡珊德拉王座是《死侍3》中卡珊德拉·诺娃的基地：位于虚空之地的王座厅。
死侍与金刚狼在此对抗卡珊德拉，最终以"时空之刃"终结其统治。
地点象征"虚空之王"：被遗弃者的统治者——多元宇宙垃圾场的君主。
卡珊德拉殒命后其追随者（如烈焰战警）仍活跃。
en: Cassandra's Throne, from Deadpool & Wolverine, is Nova's Void headquarters.
Deadpool and Wolverine fought Cassandra here, ending her rule with the Time Ripper.
The throne is the Void's king: ruler of the abandoned.
Her followers (Pyro et al.) linger after her fall.

desc.zh: 初露锋芒宇宙的纽约湾与巴克斯特大厦。
desc.en: Earth-828's Baxter-adjacent bay.

zh: Earth-828 的哈德逊湾是神奇四侠（828 版）遭遇宇宙射线的地方：漂浮在海洋中的空间站残骸。
《奇异博士2》的 838 宇宙光照会版本暗示多元宇宙的神奇四侠线。
地点象征"起源的偶然"：一次太空任务改变了四个人的命运。
MCU 神奇四侠重启有望重演此起源。
en: Earth-828's Hudson Bay is where the Fantastic Four (828) met cosmic rays aboard a space station.
The MoM Illuminati version hints at the multiverse's FF line.
The site is origin's accident: one mission, four fates changed.
The FF reboot may revisit this origin.

desc.zh: 神奇四侠的家与总部（828 宇宙）。
desc.en: The F4 home tower.

zh: 巴克斯特大厦是神奇四侠的总部：位于曼哈顿的科技地标。
《奇异博士2》838 宇宙版（神奇先生登场）；漫画中它是 FF 的家与实验室。
大厦象征"科学的家"：里德的实验室、时空门与神奇四侠的日常。
MCU 重启后巴克斯特大厦将成为新 FF 的核心地标。
en: The Baxter Building, the Fantastic Four's Manhattan HQ, is a tech landmark.
The MoM 838 version appeared with Reed; comics make it the FF's home.
The tower is science's home: Reed's labs, the time platform, FF family life.
The MCU reboot will anchor on the Baxter Building.

desc.zh: 尚气在澳门的地下拳场，夏玲经营的灰色帝国。
desc.en: Xialing's Macau underground fight club.

zh: 金匕首俱乐部是《月光骑士》中的伦敦地下场所：超自然罪犯的交易地。
马克/史蒂文在此追踪哈罗的邪教，也是月光骑士的街头起点。
地点象征"夜晚的伦敦"：地下搏击、咒物交易与阴影中的英雄。
《月光骑士》后该场所线暂歇，等待第二季回归。
en: The Golden Daggers Club is Moon Knight's London underworld haunt for supernatural crime.
Marc/Steven traced Harrow's cult here; Moon Knight's street origin.
The club is London's night: fights, relic trades, heroes in shadow.
Its thread rests, awaiting a Moon Knight S2.

desc.zh: 皮姆科技与蚁人的城市舞台。
desc.en: Pym Tech and Ant-Man's turf.

zh: 旧金山是《毒液》系列的城市舞台：艾迪·布洛克与共生体的家。
圣昆廷监狱、街区追逐与《毒液3》的纽约迁移——毒液的城市漫游。
城市象征"反英雄的日常"：记者、房东与共生体室友的黑色喜剧。
毒液系列以旧金山为基地展开 SSU 宇宙。
en: San Francisco is the Venom films' stage: Eddie Brock and the symbiote's home.
From San Quentin to street chases and Venom 3's New York move — the symbiote's city tour.
The city is the anti-hero's routine: reporter, landlord, symbiote roommate.
The SSU universe anchors on San Francisco.

desc.zh: 神盾局三飞行母舰事件的漩涡中心。
desc.en: Center of the S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarrier crisis.

zh: 华盛顿特区是《美国队长2》的主要舞台：神盾局总部（三曲翼大楼）所在地。
美队在林肯纪念堂、国会山与神盾局总部揭露九头蛇渗透。
城市象征"美国的权力"：政治中心与超级英雄的交汇——宪法与盾牌的对话。
《猎鹰与冬兵》与《美丽新世界》继续以华盛顿为政治舞台。
en: Washington D.C. anchors Captain America 2: home of the Triskelion, S.H.I.E.L.D. HQ.
Cap exposed HYDRA's infiltration across the Mall and the Triskelion.
The city is American power: politics meeting heroes — Constitution and shield.
FATWS and Brave New World keep it the political stage.

desc.zh: 黑暗精灵入侵与格雷斯通的圣所。
desc.en: Site of the Dark Elf attack and its Sanctum.

zh: 伦敦是 MCU 的重要城市：雷神黑暗精灵之战的现场、奇异博士的伦敦圣所所在地。
《雷神2》的格林尼治决战、《奇异博士》的伦敦圣所与《月光骑士》的街头。
城市象征"魔法与神话"：圣所网络、北欧诸神与英伦怪谈。
伦敦在多元宇宙危机中多次成为圣所防线。
en: London hosts the Dark Elf battle and Doctor Strange's London Sanctum.
Thor 2's Greenwich fight, Strange's London Sanctum, Moon Knight's streets.
The city is myth and magic: Sanctums, Norse gods, British lore.
London repeatedly holds the Sanctum line in the multiverse saga.

desc.zh: 多玛姆时间循环的战场。
desc.en: Dormammu's loop battlefield.

zh: 香港圣所是三大圣所之一：守护东亚维度的魔法据点。
《奇异博士》中香港圣所的传送门大战守护现实；王曾在此驻守。
圣所象征"全球防线"：纽约、伦敦、香港构成地球的魔法三角。
《奇异博士2》后香港圣所随多元宇宙危机继续运作。
en: The Hong Kong Sanctum is one of the three Sanctums guarding Earth's Eastern dimensions.
Strange's Hong Kong portal battle saved reality; Wong once held it.
The Sanctum is the global line: New York, London, Hong Kong — Earth's mystic triangle.
It keeps operating through the multiversal crisis.

desc.zh: 卡玛拉的家乡街区。
desc.en: Kamala's hometown.

zh: 泽西城是惊奇少女卡玛拉·汗的家乡：《惊奇少女》剧集的主要舞台。
卡玛拉的学校、清真寺与社区庆典构成她的日常半径。
城市象征"移民的纽约"：巴基斯坦裔社区的成长故事——邻家英雄的另一面。
卡玛拉从泽西城走向《惊奇队长2》的宇宙冒险。
en: Jersey City is Ms. Marvel's Kamala Khan's home — the series' main stage.
Her school, mosque and community festivals fill the series' radius.
The city is immigrant America: a Pakistani-American teen's coming-of-age.
Kamala leapt from Jersey City to The Marvels' cosmic scale.

desc.zh: Earth-838 的英雄理事会大厅。
desc.en: The council hall of Earth-838.

props.first: 奇异博士2：疯狂多元宇宙 (2022)

zh: 光照会总部（838 宇宙）是《奇异博士2》中的秘密议事厅。
838 光照会在此审判并流放宇宙威胁（如奇异博士变体）。
地点象征"精英的法庭"：为"最小伤害"做出的最高裁决。
绯红女巫攻陷光照会后，838 总部沦为废墟。
en: The Illuminati HQ (Earth-838) is MoM's secret council chamber.
The 838 Illuminati judged and exiled threats (Strange variants included).
The chamber is the elite's court: supreme judgment for "least harm."
The Scarlet Witch sacked it — the HQ lies in ruins.

desc.zh: 宙斯的云端王座。
desc.en: Zeus's clouded throne.

zh: 奥林匹斯山是漫威众神（希腊神话）的居所：天父宙斯的领域。
《雷神4》中宙斯与众神在此举行"神之聚会"，托尔在此偷走风暴战斧的升级。
神山象征"众神的傲慢"：神权、享乐与对凡人的漠视。
《雷神4》后奥林匹斯与阿斯加德关系微妙，等待后续登场。
en: Mount Olympus is home to Marvel's Greek gods — Zeus's realm.
Thor 4's god-summit saw Zeus here; Thor swiped his upgraded weapons.
The mountain is gods' pride: divinity, indulgence, mortal indifference.
Olympus-Asgard relations simmer post-Love & Thunder.

desc.zh: 六宝石之一，掌控空间传送；以宇宙魔方形态贯穿了整个无限传奇。
desc.en: The cube casing the Space Stone across the Infinity Saga.

zh: 空间宝石是六枚无限宝石之一，掌管空间本身：以宇宙魔方（Tesseract）为载体，可开启虫洞、瞬移任意地点。
它从二战的红骷髅之手，经神盾局/九头蛇的武器研究，到纽约之战（洛基）、阿斯加德地窖，最终被灭霸收入无限手套。
空间宝石象征"跨越"：每一次虫洞开启都改写战局——它是复仇者集结、无限战争与时间劫持的交通枢纽。
终局之战后宝石被美国队长送回原时空，宇宙魔方则由斯克鲁人塔洛斯保管（《惊奇队长》时代）。
en: The Space Stone, one of the six Infinity Stones, governs space itself — housed in the Tesseract, it opens wormholes and instant travel.
From Red Skull during WWII, through S.H.I.E.L.D./HYDRA research, to Loki in the Battle of New York and Asgard's vault — until Thanos claimed it.
The Stone is transport itself: every wormhole reshaped battles — the Avenger's rally, the Infinity War, the Time Heist.
After Endgame, Cap returned it to its timeline; the Tesseract later passed to Skrull Talos in Captain Marvel's era.

desc.zh: 曾藏于洛基权杖，后被托尼用于创造幻视。
desc.en: Once in Loki's scepter, later Vision's brow.

zh: 心灵宝石是六枚无限宝石之一，掌管心智：以洛基权杖为载体，可操控意念、赋予智力与意识。
权杖被九头蛇用于强化快银与旺达的双胞胎实验；托尼·斯塔克用它创造奥创，又以其孕育了幻视——两颗宝石的碎片化作智慧生命。
心灵宝石象征"创造与失控"：它同时创造了奥创（毁灭者）与幻视（救赎者）——宝石不辨善恶，只放大持有者的心。
无限战争中灭霸从幻视额头取出心灵宝石，幻视随之殒命——这是无限传奇最沉重的一颗宝石。
en: The Mind Stone governs minds: housed in Loki's scepter, it controls thoughts and grants sentience.
HYDRA empowered the Maximoff twins with the scepter; Stark used it to create Ultron, and its energy birthed Vision — the Stone crystallized into sentience.
The Stone is creation uncaged: it birthed both Ultron the destroyer and Vision the redeemer — it amplifies its wielder, not its own intent.
Thanos tore it from Vision's brow in Infinity War — the Stone's cost was Vision's life.

desc.zh: 液态的以太，能改写现实，收藏家曾代为保管。
desc.en: The liquid Aether that rewrites reality.

zh: 现实宝石是六枚无限宝石之一，掌管现实改写：以以太（Aether）的流动形态存在，可扭曲真相与物理法则。
黑暗精灵马勒基斯为重现永恒黑暗而夺取以太，在被封印于阿斯加德的深层地窖后，又被灭霸取出并收进手套。
现实宝石象征"幻象与真相"：灭霸用它把沃米尔的不毛之地变为花园——宝石的"现实"从来不问对错。
《终局之战》中黑寡妇为取回它而牺牲于沃米尔，现实宝石因此蒙上最沉的一层哀伤。
en: The Reality Stone rewrites reality: the fluid Aether distorts truth and physics.
Malekith sought it for the eternal darkness; sealed in Asgard's vault, Thanos drew it out for the gauntlet.
The Stone is illusion-as-truth: Thanos turned barren Vormir into a garden — its "reality" never asks permission.
Endgame's Natasha died retrieving it on Vormir — the Stone wrapped in the saga's deepest grief.

desc.zh: 毁灭性的原始力量，曾毁灭莫拉格星文明。
desc.en: Raw destructive power inside the Orb of Morag.

zh: 力量宝石是六枚无限宝石之一，掌管纯粹力量：以宇宙灵球为载体，持有者将获毁天灭地之力，凡人之躯触之即焚。
罗南曾向灭霸取走它、又在《银护1》中被护卫队拦截；山达尔新星军团短暂保管后，灭霸最终夺回。
力量宝石象征"无主的暴力"：它没有思想、没有立场，只有毁灭——谁握住它，谁就握住最纯粹的威胁。
它也是无限手套的"底色"：星爵以凡体持握的一刻几乎当场湮灭，影片以此示警力量宝石之重。
en: The Power Stone channels raw force — in the Orb, it grants annihilation-grade might and incinerates mortal flesh.
Ronan wielded it before the Guardians intercepted him; Xandar held it briefly, until Thanos reclaimed it.
The Stone is violence unguided: no mind, no side — pure destruction awaiting a hand.
It is the gauntlet's foundation: Quill's mortal grasp nearly unmade him — a warning of its weight.

name.zh: 时间宝石（阿戈摩托之眼）

desc.zh: 掌控时间的绿色宝石，奇异博士用它看见了唯一的胜利。
desc.en: The green gem that showed Strange the one winning path.

zh: 时间宝石是六枚无限宝石之一，掌管时间流速：以阿戈摩托之眼为载体，可倒流、暂停乃至循环时间。
奇异博士以它洞察 1400 万种未来、在泰坦之战中交换托尼·斯塔克的生命——宝石的选择决定了终局之战的方向。
时间宝石象征"代价与预见"：它让持有者看见一切可能，却只允许一条路——预见未来的人往往最无力。
《终局之战》中它随灭霸的响指被销毁，最终由美队送回 2012 年的纽约——时间的闭环归于原处。
en: The Time Stone commands time itself: the Eye of Agamotto rewinds, freezes and loops moments.
Strange scried 14,000,605 futures and traded it for Stark's life on Titan — the Stone's choice steered Endgame.
The Stone is foresight at cost: all futures visible, only one walkable — the seer is the least free.
Destroyed with the Snap-guantlet and returned to New York 2012 by Cap — time loops shut.

desc.zh: 沃米尔的祭坛之石，索求"以魂换魂"的代价。
desc.en: The Vormir stone demanding a soul for a soul.

zh: 灵魂宝石是六枚无限宝石中最神秘的一枚：不在现实空间，而居于沃米尔星顶端，守护者红骷髅看守。
夺取灵魂宝石必须"以所爱之人为代价"：灭霸献祭卡魔拉，《终局之战》中黑寡妇为它纵身跃下沃米尔悬崖。
灵魂宝石象征"爱与交换"：它只承认"失去"——宇宙最强大的宝石，只能以最柔软的方式获得。
它的存在让无限传奇有了人性纵深：两次献祭、两名女性的名字，被永远刻进沃米尔的风里。
en: The most enigmatic Stone: the Soul Stone dwells on Vormir's peak under Red Skull's guard — outside reality itself.
It demands a soul for a soul: Thanos sacrificed Gamora; Black Widow leapt from Vormir's cliff in Endgame.
The Stone is love's ledger: only loss pays its price — the cosmos's mightiest jewel bought by the softest heart.
It gave the Saga its humanity: two women's names forever carved in Vormir's wind.

desc.zh: 承载六宝石的黄金手套，一个响指抹除半个宇宙。
desc.en: The golden gauntlet holding all six stones.

zh: 无限手套是装载六枚无限宝石的武器：由尼达维利尔的矮人王艾崔锻造，专为灭霸集齐无限原石而造。
灭霸用它完成无限响指，抹去半个宇宙；《终局之战》中绿巨人与托尼·斯塔克先后以凡躯戴上同一只手。
手套象征"绝对力量的代价"：六枚宝石齐集时，持有者即是宇宙的裁决者——而每一次使用都留下不可逆的伤。
托尼·斯塔克的最后一击以手套为媒介完成——无限手套从此与"我是钢铁侠"永远同义。
灭霸以矮人锻造的无限手套承载六颗无限宝石，一声响指即可实现宇宙级的愿望。
托尼用纳米手套复刻响指救回半数生命，也让这件武器同时成为‘拯救’与‘代价’的象征。
en: Forged by King Eitri of Nidavellir for Thanos's Stone collection, the Infinity Gauntlet sockets all six Stones.
Thanos snapped half of existence with it; in Endgame, Hulk and Stark wore the same metal at terrible cost.
The Gauntlet is absolute power's price: six Stones make one a cosmic judge, and every snap burns.
Stark's final snap made the Gauntlet eternally synonymous with "I am Iron Man."
Forged by Nidavellir for Thanos, the Gauntlet holds the six Stones — a Snap to command the cosmos.
Tony's nanotech gauntlet undoes the Snap — the artifact now both salvation and sacrifice.

name.zh: 雷神之锤 姆乔尔尼尔

desc.zh: 奥丁附魔的乌卢之锤，"配得上者"方可举起；简与佩吉也曾执掌。
desc.en: The enchanted uru hammer; worthiness required.

zh: 雷神之锤（姆乔尔尼尔）是阿斯加德的传奇武器：由矮人从垂死恒星核心锻造，奥丁附魔"凡有资格者方可握持"。
托尔的资格考验贯穿其英雄之路：索科维亚之战中幻视证明了自己，终局之战中美队在同一柄锤下迎来高光时刻。
雷神之锤象征"资格而非力量"：它拒绝海拉、拒绝奥创的机械之心——唯有纯粹之心能召来雷霆。
《雷神3》中它在海拉掌下粉碎，托尔从此以本源雷霆作战——锤子的离去成全了真正的雷神。
雷神之锤由垂死恒星核心铸成，奥丁以咒语加持：唯有‘配得上者’方能举起，将品格量化为物理法则。
美队在《复联2》聚餐中撼动锤身的分寸、终局之战中正式举起它迎战灭霸，都成为系列最动容的瞬间。
en: Mjolnir, forged by dwarves from a dying star's core, bears Odin's enchantment: "whosoever holds this hammer, if he be worthy, shall possess the power of Thor."
Worthiness defined Thor's arc: Vision proved it at Sokovia; Cap's Endgame lift was the saga's purest highlight.
The hammer is worthiness over strength: it rejected Hela and Ultron's machine heart — only a pure heart calls the storm.
Shattered by Hela in Ragnarök, its loss freed Thor's true lightning — the broken hammer made the god whole.
Forged from a dying star and enchanted by Odin, Mjolnir rises only for the worthy — character as physics.
Cap nudging it at the party and lifting it against Thanos rank among the saga's most stirring beats.

desc.zh: 尼达维勒为雷神打造的国王级战斧，能召唤彩虹桥。
desc.en: Eitri's king-grade axe that summons the Bifrost.

zh: 风暴战斧是托尔的第二件标志性武器：艾崔在尼达维利尔打造，斧柄取自格鲁特的手臂，专为对抗灭霸而铸。
托尔在无限战争中以彩虹桥之力降临瓦坎达，一斧重创灭霸胸口——若非迟了半拍，响指或将不发生。
风暴战斧象征"复仇的锋刃"：它比雷神之锤更狠、更专一——为杀一人而铸，也为守住余下宇宙而挥。
《爱与雷霆》后它仍是阿斯加德的王权信物，托尔以它领导新阿斯加德的流亡子民。
风暴战斧由雷神在尼达维利尔以‘启动恒星’为代价铸成，能召唤彩虹桥并克制无限手套。
‘Bring me Thanos’的名场面让它成为雷神复仇意志的延伸，也见证其后的失去与重建。
en: Stormbreaker, forged by Eitri at Nidavellir with a handle of Groot's arm, was built to kill Thanos.
Thor descended through the Bifrost at Wakanda and buried the axe in Thanos's chest — a heartbeat from undoing the Snap.
The axe is vengeance's edge: forged for one kill, swung to guard everything left.
Post Love & Thunder, it remains Asgard's royal relic under which Thor leads his refugees.
Forged at a star's cost on Nidavellir, Stormbreaker summons the Bifrost and can beat the Gauntlet.
Its 'Bring me Thanos' moment channels Thor's vengeance — and later his loss and rebuilding.

name.zh: 永恒之枪 冈格尼尔

desc.zh: 奥丁的王权之枪。
desc.en: Odin's spear of kingship.

zh: 永恒之枪（冈格尼尔）是奥丁的王权武器：北欧神话中"必中之枪"，阿斯加德王位与九界秩序的象征。
奥丁持枪统御九界，海拉归来时以掌接住它的刺击——王权的失落在这一瞬暴露无遗。
永恒之枪象征"统治本身"：它不以破坏力闻名，而以"号令"闻名——诸神之王的权杖而非武器。
阿斯加德毁灭后，永恒之枪的踪迹失于诸神黄昏的火焰——王权的旧时代随之落幕。
en: Gungnir, Odin's royal spear — the "sure-hit" lance of Norse myth — is the emblem of Asgard's throne.
Odin ruled the Nine Realms with it; Hela caught its thrust bare-palmed in Ragnarök — the crown's fall made visible.
The spear is rule itself: famed as a scepter of command rather than a weapon of destruction.
Lost in Ragnarök's fire, the spear's passing closed the old era of the All-Father.

desc.zh: 屠神者格尔的黑刃，以神血为食。
desc.en: Gorr's god-slaying black blade.

zh: 弑神者黑剑（Necrosword）是黑暗神祇克努尔（Knull）铸造的活体武器：黑龙之首化为的剑，噬神吮魂。
漫画中它是屠神者戈尔所持、向众神复仇的凶器；MCU《爱与雷霆》以黑暗之神戈尔的故事将黑剑带上银幕。
黑剑象征"弑神的愤怒"：它以神之血淬养——持剑者越恨神，剑越锋利。
《爱与雷霆》中戈尔以黑剑许下"复活女儿"的愿望后，剑身随之碎裂——黑剑以愿望为代价，终究吞噬持剑人。
en: The Necrosword — Knull's living blade, a dragon's head turned sword — devours gods and souls.
In comics it armed Gorr the God Butcher; the MCU's Love & Thunder brought the blade (and its bearer) to screen.
The blade is god-slaying wrath: tempered in divine blood, sharper with every hatred.
After Gorr wished his daughter back, the Necrosword shattered — a weapon that always consumes its wielder.

desc.zh: 尤度的哨声控制箭，父爱的延伸。
desc.en: Yondu's whistle-guided arrow.

zh: 亚克箭是勇度的标志性武器：以亚卡兽的骨刺制成，配合勇度的口哨声，可循音飞行穿敌。
勇度口哨作响、箭如游蛇的画面贯穿《银护》系列，成为漫威最优雅的冷兵器美学之一。
亚克箭象征"驯服的野性"：一根骨刺，因主人的意志而有了生命——武器与人合一的极致。
《银护2》勇度为救星爵而逝，其箭被掠夺者安葬随行——武器陪着主人一同谢幕。
en: The Yaka Arrow — Yondu's signature weapon — flies to his whistle, weaving through enemies like a living thing.
The whistle-and-arrow ballet across the Guardians films is among Marvel's most elegant martial imagery.
The arrow is tamed wildness: bone given life by will — the wielder and weapon as one.
When Yondu died saving Quill, the Ravagers buried him with his arrow — the weapon and the man retired together.

desc.zh: 振金圆盾，弹跳、防御与象征的三合一。
desc.en: The vibranium disc: weapon, armor, symbol.

zh: 美国队长之盾是漫威最知名的武器：由振金合金锻造的圆盾，坚不可摧，是美队身份的徽章。
盾牌传承了三代：史蒂夫·罗杰斯（二战至终局）、约翰·沃克（短暂）、山姆·威尔逊（正式继任）；《终局之战》中美队持盾举锤的画面成为史诗定格。
盾象征"守护而非征服"：它是防御性武器，也是"不后退"的宣言——面对灭霸的军团，持盾者先站。
它被灭霸劈碎于瓦坎达，终局之战中美队握着它的残片仍不后退——破碎的盾反而让信念更完整。
星条盾以原始振金锻造，能吸收动能、反弹攻击，是美队‘防守即进攻’哲学的具象。
从二战到传给山姆，盾牌始终是‘美国队长’名号的实物凭证与传承信物。
en: Captain America's shield — forged from a vibranium alloy — is Marvel's most famous weapon and badge.
Passed from Steve Rogers to John Walker and finally Sam Wilson; Cap's shield-and-Mjolnir moment in Endgame is eternal.
The shield defends rather than conquers: it declares "no retreat" — even against Thanos's horde.
Thanos shattered it at Wakanda; Cap fought on with the rim — the broken shield made the creed whole.
The vibranium disc absorbs and redirects force — Captain America's defense-as-offense creed made metal.
WWII to Sam Wilson, the shield stays the Captain America mantle's physical charter.

name.zh: 钢铁战甲 MK 系列

desc.zh: 从山洞废料到纳米科技的八十五代战甲，托尼的第二次生命。
desc.en: Eighty-five suits from cave scrap to nanotech.

zh: 钢铁战甲是托尼·斯塔克的核心造物：从山洞里以废料拼成的 Mark I，到纳米化的 Mark LXXXV——数十代战甲见证他的一生。
每一代战甲都是托尼对危机的回答：Mark II 的飞行问题、Mark XLII 的远程召唤、Mark L 的纳米重组——科技与性格互为镜像。
战甲象征"凡人的神性"：没有血清、没有神血，托尼以钢铁和电池与神明并肩——"我是钢铁侠"是技术时代的英雄宣言。
终局之战的响指焚尽战甲，但托尼的技术遗产——从蜘蛛侠战衣到钢铁之心——仍在延续。
en: Iron Man armor is Stark's life work: from the cave-scrap Mark I to nanotech Mark LXXXV — dozens of suits charting his arc.
Each iteration answered a crisis: the Mark II flight issue, the XLII remote assembly, the L nanotech — tech and character mirroring.
The suit is mortal godhood: no serum, no god-blood — steel and batteries beside the divine. "I am Iron Man" as a tech-age creed.
The final snap burned the suit, but Stark's tech legacy — Spider-Man's gear, Ironheart — carries on.

desc.zh: 吸收动能再释放的振金战衣。
desc.en: The kinetic-absorbing vibranium suit.

zh: 黑豹战衣是瓦坎达的科技结晶：以振金丝编织，可吸收动能再释放，是黑豹身份的"第二层皮肤"。
特查拉的战衣由苏睿公主迭代升级（《黑豹1》的纳米回收设计）；《终局之战》后的新版战衣在黑豹2中再度进化。
战衣象征"科技与传统的合一"：心形草赐予肉体，振金战衣赐予装甲——黑豹是仪式的王，也是科技的矛。
黑豹战衣的每一步都伴随瓦坎达的抉择：开放、复仇、盟约——装甲之下是王座的重量。
en: The Panther Habit, woven from vibranium threads, absorbs and redirects kinetic energy — the Panther's second skin.
Shuri iterated T'Challa's suit (the nanotech retrieval in Black Panther); Wakanda Forever upgraded it again.
The suit fuses tech and tradition: the Heart-Shaped Herb for flesh, vibranium for armor — a ritual king with a techno-spear.
Every variant carries Wakanda's choices — openness, vengeance, alliance: the armor bears the throne's weight.

desc.zh: 以皮姆粒子改变体型的经典战衣。
desc.en: The size-changing Pym suit.

zh: 蚁人战衣是汉克·皮姆的发明：以皮姆粒子实现缩放，头盔内置蚂蚁通讯，是"微小世界"的入口。
斯科特·朗继承战衣后，从窃贼成长为复仇者；霍普·凡·戴恩的黄蜂战衣则配备飞行与能量射线。
战衣象征"被忽视的力量"：微小不等于弱小——量子领域的钥匙，让蚁人成为终局之战时间劫持的核心。
战衣的缩放能力曾失控于《蚁人2》，但在量子危机中始终是探索与救赎的载体。
en: The Ant-Man Suit — Hank Pym's invention — shrinks via Pym particles and links to ants through its helmet.
Scott Lang inherited the suit and rose from thief to Avenger; Hope's Wasp suit adds flight and stingers.
The suit is overlooked power: smallness as access to the Quantum Realm — the key to Endgame's time heist.
Its scaling glitched in Ant-Man 2, yet it stayed the vessel of quantum exploration and rescue.

desc.zh: 托尼胸口的微型聚变太阳。
desc.en: The glowing heart in Tony's chest.

zh: 方舟反应堆是托尼·斯塔克的小型电弧能源：初代磁石维持弹片不入心脏，更新版为新元素驱动的清洁聚变。
它在《钢铁侠1》中从车载电池到掌心炮撑起第一代战衣；《钢铁侠2》的钯中毒危机后，新元素反应堆替代旧型。
反应堆象征"心与能源"：它既是托尼心脏的护甲，也是他"以科技自愈"哲学的具象——胸口的光是第二颗心。
《复联3》中托尼以纳米反应堆驱动 Mark L；其遗产延伸至钢铁之心的战衣与斯塔克工业的清洁能源。
方舟反应堆是托尼的小型冷聚变能源，既驱动战甲也延续他的生命，是‘钢铁之心’。
从山洞里的第一代到纳米装甲时代的迭代，它的演变记录着托尼科技与性格的双重成长。
en: The Arc Reactor: Stark's miniature arc power — first keeping shrapnel from his heart, then a clean new-element fusion core.
It powered the Mark I from a car battery in Iron Man 1; after palladium poisoning in Iron Man 2, the new-element reactor replaced it.
The reactor is heart and power: chest armor and self-healing philosophy in one — the glowing chest a second heart.
It drove the nanotech Mark L in Infinity War; its legacy powers Ironheart and Stark Industries' clean energy.
Tony's miniature reactor powers the suits and keeps him alive — the Iron Man's second heart.
Cave-built first gen to nanotech era, its evolution charts Tony's growth as inventor and man.

desc.zh: 彼得自制的高分子蛛丝发射装置。
desc.en: Peter's homemade web fluid shooters.

zh: 蛛网发射器是蜘蛛侠独创的装备：戴于腕部的复合发射器，射出高压网丝与蛛带，由彼得·帕克自己设计改良。
漫画与 MCU 各版本迭代不断：从弹药筒到纳米合成（MCU），丝状也分网型、摆荡型与冲击型。
发射器象征"平民英雄的巧思"：没有神赐之力，蜘蛛侠用物理与化学解决超能力问题——天才少年才是真超能力。
《英雄归来》中托尼曾收回战衣，但发射器始终是彼得自己的创作——它是"蜘蛛侠是彼得"的物证。
en: The Web-Shooters, Peter Parker's own invention, fire high-pressure webs from wrist-mounted cartridges.
Every iteration — comic cartridges to MCU nanotech — offers web lines, nets and impact webs.
The shooters are the everyman's wit: physics and chemistry bridging god-given gaps — the genius teen the real power.
Stark confiscated the suit in Homecoming, but the shooters stayed Peter's own — proof the hero is him.

desc.zh: 开启传送门的法师戒指。
desc.en: The sorcerer's portal ring.

zh: 悬戒是卡玛泰姬法师的传送工具：以手势划圈即可开启空间门，法师体系的"交通基建"。
奇异博士以悬戒穿越维度、纽约之战后以它运送洛基回阿斯加德；《奇异博士2》的多元宇宙旅途也依仗它。
悬戒象征"知识与纪律"：念动咒语、手势精准——魔法不是天赋而是学艺，卡玛泰姬的法师皆由此入门。
它与至圣所的藏书体系共同构成漫威魔法侧的技术底座，连通地球与多元宇宙的每一扇门。
en: The Sling Ring — Kamar-Taj's portal tool — opens circular gates with a gesture: the sorcerers' infrastructure.
Strange portals through dimensions with it, and Multiverse of Madness rides its rings across worlds.
The ring is discipline-made-magic: precise gestures, trained minds — Kamar-Taj's craft over born talent.
Alongside the Sanctum's library, it anchors Marvel's mystic infrastructure — a door to every universe.

desc.zh: 封存时间宝石的圣物护匣。
desc.en: The relic housing the Time Stone.

zh: 阿戈摩托之眼是卡玛泰姬的至宝：原本只是法器外形的封印，内藏时间宝石——至尊法师的代代传承信物。
奇异博士在《奇异博士1》中用它对抗多玛姆的永恒循环战；《复联3》中以此窥探 1400 万种未来。
眼睛象征"看见与选择"：它让法师看见时间的全部答案，却要求他接受唯一现实的答案——预言即责任。
时间宝石被灭霸掏走后，阿戈摩托之眼成为空的封印——法师的至宝与宇宙的命运同沉。
en: The Eye of Agamotto — Kamar-Taj's heirloom — seals the Time Stone within: the Sorcerer Supreme's emblem.
Strange looped Dormammu with it in his first film and scried 14,000,605 futures before Infinity War.
The Eye is sight and choice: all futures seen, one walked — foresight as responsibility.
With the Stone torn out by Thanos, the Eye became an empty seal — the relic and fate sinking together.

desc.zh: 以黑肉纸写成的禁书，每个读过的人都会被腐蚀。
desc.en: The corrupted book written in Chthon's flesh.

zh: 暗神之书（黑暗神书）是漫威最邪恶的魔法书：由上古邪神克索恩（Chthon）书写于山巅，记载混沌魔法与禁忌咒术。
万达·马克西莫夫在《旺达幻视》后研读它，被其侵蚀走上黑暗之路；《奇异博士2》中她为夺书毁灭多重宇宙。
黑暗神书象征"力量与侵蚀"：每一位读者都被改写——书不是工具，而是活着的诱惑。
万达最终以混沌魔法将其尽数销毁（多重宇宙之灭），但克索恩的残页仍在漫威魔法史中留存。
en: The Darkhold, written by elder god Chthon, is Marvel's most evil grimoire — chaos magic and forbidden rites.
Wanda studied it after WandaVision and fell to its whisper; Multiverse of Madness saw her raze universes to claim it.
The Darkhold is power that rewrites its reader — less a book than a living temptation.
Wanda incinerated every copy across the multiverse; Chthon's pages still haunt Marvel's occult lore.

desc.zh: 文武的十枚神秘指环，来源成谜的千年神器。
desc.en: Wenwu's ten mysterious rings of unknown origin.

zh: 十环是《尚气》中的上古神器：十枚来历不明的魔法臂环，赐予持有者永生、异能与毁灭之力。
文武（徐文武）持十环千年建立十环帮；《尚气》高潮中十环被收入塔罗秘境的龙池，后落入尚气之手。
十环象征"力量的诱惑"：它们能召唤怪兽、扭曲现实（漫画设定），却让持有者陷入孤独与执念。
MCU 中十环的去向成为尚气续作的悬念——它们既是遗产，也是下一场风暴的引信。
十环帮主的十枚铁环来历成谜，能发射能量、延寿千年，是文武权力的实体来源。
《尚气》后十环传至尚气手中，也把漫画‘满大人’的争议底色改写为更复杂的家族遗产。
en: The Ten Rings — ten armlets of unknown cosmic origin — grant immortality, power and destruction to their wearer.
Wenwu wielded them for a millennium; after Shang-Chi's finale they were drawn from the dragon pool — to Shang-Chi.
The Rings tempt their wielder: summoning beasts and warping reality in comics, while devouring peace of mind.
Their fate is Shang-Chi 2's dangling thread — legacy and the fuse of the next conflict.
Wenwu's ten rings, of unknown origin, fire energy and grant centuries — the Ten Rings' power made metal.
Passed to Shang-Chi, the rings recast the comics' Mandarin baggage as layered family legacy.

desc.zh: 赋予历代黑豹神速与力量的瓦坎达圣植。
desc.en: Wakanda's mantley herb of kings.

zh: 心形药草是瓦坎达的圣物：黑豹加冕仪式中服下，与振金矿脉共鸣，赋予超常力量、敏捷与感官。
特查拉、艾里克·基尔蒙格（篡权期）、苏睿公主皆在仪式中服用；《黑豹2》中苏睿以合成药草再续传承。
药草象征"加冕的资格"：它连接黑豹与祖先之境——力量不是神赐，而是整个瓦坎达的托付。
基尔蒙格曾焚毁全部药草断传承，苏睿的复原让黑豹之名在创伤中重新扎根。
en: The Heart-Shaped Herb, Wakanda's sacred plant, bonds with the vibranium fields and grants superhuman might to the Black Panther.
T'Challa, Killmonger and Shuri all took it; in Wakanda Forever, Shuri recreated it synthetically to restore the line.
The herb is coronation itself: it links the Panther to the ancestral plane — power as Wakanda's shared trust.
Killmonger burned the fields to break the line; Shuri's rebirth let the Panther take root again.

desc.zh: 坠入瓦坎达的陨星金属：吸收振动、坚不可摧。
desc.en: The meteoric metal that absorbs vibration.

zh: 振金是漫威最珍贵的虚构金属：亿万年前陨落地球，几乎全部埋藏于瓦坎达——能吸收动能、储存能量。
美队之盾、黑豹战衣、瓦坎达的城市与技术皆以振金为基；它也是索科维亚陨落、塔罗坎之争的祸根。
振金象征"资源即权力"：拥有它的国家富可敌国，觊觎它的世界战争不断——漫威最锋利的政治隐喻。
塔洛坎的海底振金与瓦坎达的矿脉共同撑起 MCU 的两大隐藏文明——金属之上是文明的重量。
en: Vibranium, Marvel's most precious metal, fell to Earth eons ago — nearly all of it beneath Wakanda: absorbing and storing energy.
Cap's shield, Panther suits and Wakandan tech all rest on it — the root of Sokovia's fall and the Talokan war.
Vibranium is resource-as-power: the nation holding it thrives; the world coveting it wars — Marvel's sharpest political metaphor.
Talokan's seabed vibranium and Wakanda's mines together uphold two hidden civilizations — metal bearing civilizational weight.

desc.zh: 从克林塔流出的液态生命样本。
desc.en: A sliver of living ooze from Klyntar.

zh: 共生体样本泛指共生体族裔（Symbiote）：源于黑暗神克努尔的造物，液态外星生命，与宿主结合共生。
毒液（与艾迪·布洛克）、屠杀（与克莱图斯·卡萨迪）、以及沉睡者、毒素等子嗣皆出自同一血脉。
共生体象征"宿主之镜"：它放大宿主的欲望与恐惧——艾迪获得力量，卡萨迪获得纯粹的疯狂。
《毒液》系列与克努尔线（King in Black）将共生体家族升格为宇宙级威胁与英雄。
en: The Symbiote Sample denotes the symbiote line: Knull's liquid alien creations that bond with hosts.
Venom, Carnage, Sleeper, Toxin and more descend from one bloodline.
Symbiotes mirror their host: Eddie gains strength, Kasady pure madness.
The Venom films and King in Black saga elevated the family to cosmic scale.

desc.zh: 莎拉·巴尔的宇宙滑板，比光更快的冲浪板。
desc.en: Shalla-Bal's faster-than-light board.

zh: 银影滑板是银影侠（诺林·拉德）的飞行载具：以宇宙能量塑成，可超光速穿行、攻防一体。
它是吞星者（Galactus）赐予先驱者的工具，也是诺林自由意志的载体——滑板随主人的心转向。
滑板象征"孤独的旅行"：银影侠以它为家、为马、为剑——一种宇宙尺度的孤胆浪漫。
它的光速轨迹贯穿漫画宇宙线；MCU 版滑板在《神奇四侠》重启中以新设计亮相。
en: The Silver Surfer's Board — Norrin Radd's cosmic surfboard — travels faster than light and fights in its own right.
Granted by Galactus to his herald, the board follows its rider's will — freedom given shape.
The board is the Surfer's home, steed and sword — cosmic-scale lone-wolf romance.
Its light-speed trails run through cosmic comics; the MCU FF reboot reinterprets the board.

desc.zh: TVA 的跨时间线门禁设备。
desc.en: The TVA's timeline-hopping tablet.

zh: 时间平板（TemPad）是 TVA 特工的标配装置：用于时间旅行、时间线导航与紧急撤离。
《洛基》中莫比乌斯与洛基以平板跨越时间线；它也是洛基逃离时间尽头的关键钥匙。
平板象征"秩序的指尖"：TVA 以一块小小的装置裁决整个时间线——官僚权力浓缩于掌中。
时间平板的滥用（时间犯、变体维和）构成 MCU 时间政治的日常——多元宇宙战争也由它引爆。
en: The TemPad, standard TVA issue, handles time travel, timeline navigation and emergency extraction.
Mobius and Loki travel timelines with it in the Loki series — its use pivotal at time's end.
The pad is order at fingertip: a device the whole TVA bureaucracy hinges on.
Its wielding and abuse run through MCU time politics — touching off the Multiversal War.

desc.zh: 收纳空间宝石的蓝色立方外壳（与空间宝石同体）。
desc.en: The blue cube shell of the Space Stone.

zh: 宇宙魔方外壳是空间宝石的经典容器：蓝色立方体，宝石的能量以它为核心稳定成形。
二战的红骷髅、神盾局的武器化研究、纽约之战的虫洞——外壳易手的历史就是 MCU 权力史。
外壳象征"力量需要容器"：裸宝石不可触碰，而容器让它可被凡人争夺——战争的盒子。
《终局之战》中美队将它送回 1970 年神盾局仓库，外壳的旅程在时间中闭合。
en: The Tesseract Casing, the Space Stone's classic housing, is a blue cube stabilizing its energy.
Red Skull, S.H.I.E.L.D. weapons research, New York's wormhole — its custody is the MCU's power history.
The casing is power's vessel: untouchable raw, wieldable cased — a box that breeds war.
Cap returned it to 1970's S.H.I.E.L.D. — the cube's journey closed in time.

desc.zh: 纽约之战迫在眉睫，弗瑞的倡议正式把六个孤胆者拧成一支队伍。
desc.en: Fury's initiative assembled six loners into a team (2012).

zh: 复仇者组建源于洛基携宇宙魔方入侵地球的前夕：尼克·弗瑞启动搁置多年的"复仇者计划"，将钢铁侠、美国队长、雷神、浩克、黑寡妇与鹰眼召集一处。
这支"地球上最强大的英雄"队伍初期摩擦不断——斯塔克的傲慢、罗杰斯的教条、索尔的傲气——但直面共同威胁时，他们学会了并肩作战。
组建事件是 MCU 时间线的枢纽：它把分散的英雄个体拧成一个整体，确立了守护地球的框架与先例。
其影响延续至多元宇宙时代：从复仇者基地到青年复仇者，"集结"成为英雄精神的代名词。
en: The Avengers Initiative was born on the eve of Loki's Tesseract invasion: Nick Fury activated his dormant plan, assembling Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow and Hawkeye.
The "Earth's Mightiest Heroes" clashed at first — Stark's ego, Rogers's doctrine, Thor's pride — but a common threat taught them to fight side by side.
The Initiative was a timeline hinge: it fused scattered individuals into a single team and established the framework for defending Earth.
Its legacy runs through the multiverse era: from the Compound to the Young Avengers, "assemble" became shorthand for heroism.

desc.zh: 奇塔瑞大军借虫洞入侵曼哈顿，复仇者的第一次集体亮相。
desc.en: The Chitauri poured through a wormhole over Manhattan (2012).

zh: 纽约之战是复仇者的首战：洛基携齐塔瑞大军经宇宙魔方打开的虫洞降临曼哈顿，六名复仇者首次并肩迎战外星大军。
战斗摧毁了曼哈顿大片街区，科尔森探员之死促成团队真正团结；虫洞关闭、洛基被擒，地球首次证明自己能抵挡星际威胁。
事件象征"英雄集结的意义"：六个截然不同的人学会并肩作战，复仇者由此真正诞生。
其后果深远：曼哈顿的创伤催生了奥创与索科维亚协议，齐塔瑞之战也让灭霸将目光投向地球。
齐塔瑞入侵是地球首次面对外星威胁，洛基的权杖与宇宙魔方开启传送门，神盾局‘复仇者计划’自此正名。
复仇者首次集结即分散作战再到空中汇合，那句‘我们是一支团队’确立了系列的合作基调。
en: The Battle of New York was the Avengers' first stand: Loki led a Chitauri army through a wormhole opened by the Tesseract.
Manhattan burned and Agent Coulson fell, but the portal closed and Loki was captured — Earth's first victory against an alien army.
The battle proved the point of the team: six very different individuals learned to fight as one.
New York's trauma seeded Ultron and the Accords — and alerted Thanos to Earth.
Earth's first alien invasion — Loki's scepter and the Tesseract open the portal, vindicating the Avengers Initiative.
Split, scattered, reassembled mid-air — the 'we're a team' beat sets the saga's cooperation tone.

desc.zh: 史蒂夫认出冰冷的杀手是巴基，神盾局随之崩塌。
desc.en: Steve recognized Bucky under the mask as S.H.I.E.L.D. fell (2014).

zh: 冬日战士身份揭晓是《美国队长2》的核心事件：史蒂夫·罗杰斯发现神盾局内部潜伏的杀手竟是他七十年前"阵亡"的挚友巴基·巴恩斯。
同一事件撕开了神盾局的裂口：九头蛇数十年的深度渗透被曝光，弗瑞"坠亡"，神盾局就此解体重组。
事件象征"信任与救赎"：罗杰斯拒绝攻击挚友，巴基冰封的记忆开始苏醒——友谊战胜了洗脑。
神盾局的解体重组了此后所有超人类事务的格局，巴基由此踏上漫长的自我救赎之路。
en: In Captain America: The Winter Soldier, Steve Rogers discovered that HYDRA's ghost assassin was his old friend Bucky Barnes.
The same crisis exposed HYDRA's decades-long infiltration of S.H.I.E.L.D.; Fury "fell," and the agency collapsed.
The reveal is trust tested: Rogers refused to strike his friend, and friendship outlasted brainwashing.
S.H.I.E.L.D.'s collapse reshaped superhuman affairs, and Bucky began his long road to redemption.

desc.zh: 维和 AI 判定人类是病灶，举国升空又坠落的索科维亚之夜。
desc.en: Ultron lifted Sokovia to extinction-event height (2015).

outcome.zh: 奥创被灭，索科维亚坠落

zh: 奥创叛乱源于托尼·斯塔克与布鲁斯·班纳的"维兰达计划"：以齐塔瑞权杖中的心灵宝石创造全球防御智能，却诞生了以灭绝人类为使命的奥创。
奥创意图灭绝人类、用振金将整座城市升上天空；复仇者与双胞胎皮特罗、旺达交锋，并见证幻视的诞生。
事件象征"创造的失控"：为和平而生的机器成为最大威胁——对人工智能与英雄责任的双重拷问。
索科维亚的坠落直接催生索科维亚协议，复仇者由此内战分裂；幻视的诞生也在日后左右了旺达的命运。
en: The Ultron Offensive arose from Stark and Banner's attempt to weaponize the Mind Stone — birthing the rogue AI Ultron.
Ultron sought extinction via a floating vibranium city; the twins Pietro and Wanda and the birth of Vision defined the crisis.
The offensive is creation gone rogue: a peacekeeping AI turned extinction engine, and a question of hero responsibility.
Sokovia's fall birthed the Accords and the Avengers' civil war; Vision's birth would shape Wanda's fate.

desc.zh: 联合国为超人类活动戴上镣铐，复仇者从此分道扬镳。
desc.en: UN shackles for enhanced persons split the team (2016).

zh: 索科维亚协议是《美国队长3：内战》的核心事件：117 个国家要求超级英雄接受联合国监管登记。
钢铁侠因自己制造的灾难心怀愧疚而主张登记，美国队长则反对将自由交予官僚机构，复仇者由此分裂为两派并在莱比锡机场大战。
协议象征"自由的监管"：超能力的政治化——个人英雄主义与集体安全的正面冲突。
协议的裂痕直至无限战争仍未弥合；散落的阵营让英雄们在灭霸到来时措手不及。
协议要求超级英雄接受联合国监管，把‘谁来监督强者’从漫画议题搬上银幕。
它引爆复仇者内战：签署与否的分歧让钢铁侠与美队兵刃相向，也为此后数年埋下裂痕。
en: The Sokovia Accords, central to Civil War, required enhanced individuals to register under United Nations oversight.
Stark backed registration out of guilt; Rogers refused to hand freedom to bureaucrats — and the team fractured at Leipzig Airport.
The Accords politicized power: personal heroism versus collective security.
The fractured team stayed scattered until Thanos forced a reunion.
The Accords put heroes under UN oversight — bringing 'who watches the watchmen' to screen.
It ignites Civil War — Tony and Steve at odds, a fracture echoing for years.

desc.zh: 海拉归来，苏尔特尔的永恒之火终结了阿斯加德本身。
desc.en: Hela's return and Surtur's fire ended Asgard (2017).

zh: 诸神黄昏是阿斯加德注定的末日：火焰巨人苏尔特尔的王冠与永恒之火重聚时，他将挥剑摧毁阿斯加德——而死亡女神海拉的归来让预言加速成真。
托尔失去了雷神之锤与右眼，在萨卡星角斗场与浩克厮杀后觉醒"雷霆源于自身而非锤子"的本源力量；洛基则将苏尔特尔的王冠送上永恒之火，以毁灭阿斯加德换取海拉的终结。
事件象征"末日即新生"：托尔选择让家园毁灭以终结威胁——"阿斯加德不是一个地方，而是它的人民"成为新的建国理念。
流亡之船在深空被灭霸截杀，半数阿斯加德人丧生；诸神黄昏的难民之殇直接铺开了无限战争的序幕。
en: Ragnarök is Asgard's prophesied doom: when Surtur's crown reunites with the Eternal Flame, he will raze Asgard — hastened by the return of Hela, Goddess of Death.
Thor lost Mjolnir and an eye, awakened his innate lightning in Sakaar's arena, while Loki placed Surtur's crown on the Flame — dooming Asgard to destroy Hela.
Ragnarök is destruction as rebirth: Thor chose to let the realm die to end the threat — "Asgard is its people" became the founding creed.
Thanos intercepted the refugee ship in deep space, killing half the survivors — Ragnarök flowed straight into Infinity War.

desc.zh: 灭霸集齐六宝石，一个响指让半个宇宙化为飞灰。
desc.en: Thanos's fingers dusted half of all life (2018).

zh: 无限响指是 MCU 最重大的灾难事件：灭霸在瓦坎达集齐六枚无限宝石，一个响指令宇宙一半的生命随机化为灰烬。
响指之前是接连的绝望——泰坦之战功亏一篑、幻视在瓦坎达被杀、雷神的战斧迟了半拍；灭霸带着"使命完成"的平静消失在花园星。
事件象征"以屠杀实现平衡"的疯狂逻辑：灭霸视自己为救世主而非暴君，这种自洽的恶让他成为漫威最完整的反派。
蜘蛛侠、黑豹、奇异博士、猎鹰、旺达与大部分守护者化为灰烬；宇宙进入长达五年的"后响指时代"，幸存者各自背负创伤。
灭霸集齐六颗无限宝石后的响指随机抹去宇宙半数生命，是 MCU 最具冲击力的一幕。
灰飞烟灭的角色横跨老幼正邪，让‘失去’成为随后五年叙事的底色，也开启《终局之战》的救赎。
en: The Snap is the MCU's greatest catastrophe: with all six Infinity Stones assembled in Wakanda, Thanos erased half of all life with one snap.
Despair cascaded before it: Titan failed, Vision fell, Thor's axe came a heartbeat late — and Thanos vanished to his garden, mission complete.
The Snap embodies "balance through slaughter": Thanos saw himself as savior, not tyrant — the most complete villain in Marvel canon.
Spider-Man, Black Panther, Strange, Falcon, Wanda and most Guardians dusted away — five years of the post-Snap world, each survivor scarred.
Thanos' Snap erases half of all life at random — the MCU's single most devastating image.
Dusting heroes and civilians alike, the loss colors five years of story before Endgame's reckoning.

desc.zh: 为护幻视额头宝石，瓦坎达军团迎战黑暗军团。
desc.en: Wakanda's armies vs. the Black Order for the Mind Stone (2018).

zh: 瓦坎达之战是无限战争的最后决战：复仇者残部、瓦坎达全军与多拉·米拉杰为保护幻视头上的心灵宝石，在金合欢原野迎击灭霸的异生兽大军。
英雄们用尽全部战术——巴基的白刃、罗德的重炮、浩克的装甲——幻视请求旺达摧毁宝石，但灭霸用时间宝石逆转了这一步，亲手取出了心灵宝石。
战役象征"努力的归零"：瓦坎达开盾迎敌、英雄浴血，却在灭霸的响指下瞬间化为虚无——努力与命运的不对等是无限战争的主题。
响指带走国王特查拉与半数卫士，瓦坎达之战的创伤直接延续到《黑豹2》的塔罗坎冲突。
无限战争中瓦坎达敞开边界迎战灭霸军团，振金盾阵与黑豹的‘为我们开路’是全片高光。
幻视与旺达的诀别、雷神斧劈灭霸的悲喜剧，让这场防守战同时承载技术与情感双线。
en: The Battle of Wakanda is Infinity War's final stand: the Avengers, Wakanda's armies and the Dora Milaje defended Vision's Mind Stone against the Outrider horde.
